```cpp
    Eigen::Vector3f tcw = Eigen::Vector3f::Zero();

bool EnsureDirectory(const string& path) {
    if (path.empty()) {
        return false;
    }
    struct stat info {};
    if (stat(path.c_str(), &info) == 0 && S_ISDIR(info.st_mode)) {
        return true;
    }

    string partial;
    size_t start = 0;
    if (!path.empty() && path[0] == '/') {
        partial = "/";
        start = 1;
    }

    while (start <= path.size()) {
        size_t sep = path.find('/', start);
        string segment = path.substr(start, sep - start);
        if (!segment.empty()) {
            if (!partial.empty() && partial.back() != '/') {
                partial += "/";
            }
            partial += segment;
            if (stat(partial.c_str(), &info) != 0) {
                if (mkdir(partial.c_str(), 0755) != 0 && errno != EEXIST) {
                    cerr << "Failed to create directory: " << partial << " (" << strerror(errno) << ")" << endl;
                    return false;
                }
            } else if (!S_ISDIR(info.st_mode)) {
                cerr << "Path exists but is not a directory: " << partial << endl;
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (sep == string::npos) {
            break;
        }
        start = sep + 1;
    }
    return true;
}

void LoadImages(const string& image_path, const string& timestamp_file, ImageSequence& sequence) {
    ifstream fTimes(timestamp_file);
    if (!fTimes.is_open()) {
        throw runtime_error("Cannot open timestamp file: " + timestamp_file);
    }

    sequence.image_paths.reserve(5000);
    sequence.timestamps.reserve(5000);

    string line;
    while (getline(fTimes, line)) {
        if (line.empty()) {
            continue;
        }
        stringstream ss(line);
        string token;
        ss >> token;
        if (token.empty()) {
            continue;
        }
        double t = 0.0;
        try {
            t = stod(token) / 1e9;
        } catch (const std::exception&) {
            continue;
        }
        sequence.image_paths.push_back(image_path + "/" + token + ".png");
        sequence.timestamps.push_back(t);
    }
}

LoadedImuData LoadImuData(const string& csv_path) {
    ifstream f(csv_path);
    if (!f.is_open()) {
        throw runtime_error("Cannot open IMU file: " + csv_path);
    }

    LoadedImuData data;
    data.timestamps.reserve(5000);
    data.acc.reserve(5000);
    data.gyro.reserve(5000);
    data.raw_samples.reserve(5000);

    string line;
    while (getline(f, line)) {
        if (line.empty() || line[0] == '#') {
            continue;
        }
        vector<double> values;
        values.reserve(7);
        string token;
        stringstream ss(line);
        while (getline(ss, token, ',')) {
            if (!token.empty()) {
                try {
                    values.push_back(stod(token));
                } catch (const std::exception&) {
                    values.clear();
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (values.size() != 7) {
            continue;
        }

        double timestamp = values[0] / 1e9;
        Eigen::Vector3d gyro(values[1], values[2], values[3]);
        Eigen::Vector3d acc(values[4], values[5], values[6]);

        data.timestamps.push_back(timestamp);
        data.acc.emplace_back(static_cast<float>(acc.x()), static_cast<float>(acc.y()), static_cast<float>(acc.z()));
        data.gyro.emplace_back(static_cast<float>(gyro.x()), static_cast<float>(gyro.y()), static_cast<float>(gyro.z()));

        RawImuSample sample;
        sample.timestamp = timestamp;
        sample.acc = acc;
        sample.gyro = gyro;
        data.raw_samples.push_back(sample);
    }

    return data;
}

ORB_SLAM3::Map* SelectBestMap(ORB_SLAM3::Atlas* atlas) {
    if (!atlas) {
        return nullptr;
    }
    vector<ORB_SLAM3::Map*> maps = atlas->GetAllMaps();
    if (maps.empty()) {
        return atlas->GetCurrentMap();
    }

    ORB_SLAM3::Map* best = nullptr;
    size_t max_kf = 0;
    for (auto* map : maps) {
        if (!map) {
            continue;
        }
        size_t count = map->GetAllKeyFrames().size();
        if (count > max_kf) {
            best = map;
            max_kf = count;
        }
    }
    return best ? best : atlas->GetCurrentMap();
}

vector<PoseInfo> ExtractPoses(ORB_SLAM3::Map* map) {
    vector<PoseInfo> poses;
    if (!map) {
        return poses;
    }
    vector<ORB_SLAM3::KeyFrame*> keyframes = map->GetAllKeyFrames();
    poses.reserve(keyframes.size());
    for (auto* kf : keyframes) {
        if (!kf || kf->isBad()) {
            continue;
        }
        PoseInfo info;
        info.keyframe = kf;
        info.timestamp = kf->mTimeStamp;
        poses.push_back(info);
    }
    sort(poses.begin(), poses.end(), [](const PoseInfo& a, const PoseInfo& b) {
        return a.timestamp < b.timestamp;
    });
    for (size_t i = 0; i < poses.size(); ++i) {
        poses[i].pose_id = static_cast<int>(i);
    }
    return poses;
}

vector<CameraObservationRecord> BuildObservations(const vector<PoseInfo>& poses) {
    vector<CameraObservationRecord> records;
    unordered_map<ORB_SLAM3::MapPoint*, int> landmark_ids;
    int next_landmark_id = 0;

    for (const auto& pose : poses) {
        if (!pose.keyframe) {
            continue;
        }
        const auto vp_map_points = pose.keyframe->GetMapPointMatches();
        const auto& keypoints = pose.keyframe->mvKeysUn;
        for (size_t idx = 0; idx < vp_map_points.size(); ++idx) {
            auto* mp = vp_map_points[idx];
            if (!mp || mp->isBad()) {
                continue;
            }
            if (idx >= keypoints.size()) {
                continue;
            }
            const auto [it, inserted] = landmark_ids.emplace(mp, next_landmark_id);
            if (inserted) {
                ++next_landmark_id;
            }

            CameraObservationRecord rec;
            rec.pose_id = pose.pose_id;
            rec.landmark_id = it->second;
            rec.pixel = Eigen::Vector2f(keypoints[idx].pt.x, keypoints[idx].pt.y);
            rec.Rcw = pose.keyframe->GetRotation();
            rec.tcw = pose.keyframe->GetTranslation();
            rec.landmark_w = mp->GetWorldPos();
            rec.fx = pose.keyframe->fx;
            rec.fy = pose.keyframe->fy;
            rec.cx = pose.keyframe->cx;
            rec.cy = pose.keyframe->cy;
            rec.sigma = 1.0f;
            records.push_back(rec);
        }
    }
    return records;
}

vector<ImuMeasurementRecord> SliceImuSegment(double t_start,
                                             double t_end,
                                             const vector<RawImuSample>& samples) {
    vector<ImuMeasurementRecord> segment;
    if (samples.empty() || t_end <= t_start) {
        return segment;
    }

    const auto comp = [](const RawImuSample& sample, double value) {
        return sample.timestamp < value;
    };
    size_t idx = 0;
    auto it = lower_bound(samples.begin(), samples.end(), t_start, comp);
    if (it == samples.begin()) {
        idx = 0;
    } else if (it == samples.end()) {
        idx = samples.size() - 1;
    } else {
        idx = static_cast<size_t>(distance(samples.begin(), it));
        if (samples[idx].timestamp > t_start && idx > 0) {
            --idx;
        }
    }

    double last_time = t_start;
    Eigen::Vector3d last_acc = samples[idx].acc;
    Eigen::Vector3d last_gyro = samples[idx].gyro;

    for (; idx < samples.size() && samples[idx].timestamp <= t_end; ++idx) {
        double current = samples[idx].timestamp;
        if (current < last_time) {
            continue;
        }
        double dt = current - last_time;
        if (dt > 1e-9) {
            segment.push_back({dt, last_acc, last_gyro});
            last_time = current;
        }
        last_acc = samples[idx].acc;
        last_gyro = samples[idx].gyro;
    }

    if (last_time < t_end) {
        double dt = t_end - last_time;
        if (dt > 1e-9) {
            segment.push_back({dt, last_acc, last_gyro});
        }
    }

    return segment;
}

vector<ImuEdgeRecord> BuildImuEdges(const vector<PoseInfo>& poses,
                                    const vector<RawImuSample>& samples) {
    vector<ImuEdgeRecord> edges;
    if (poses.size() < 2) {
        return edges;
    }

    edges.reserve(poses.size());
    for (size_t i = 1; i < poses.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& prev_pose = poses[i - 1];
        const auto& curr_pose = poses[i];
        vector<ImuMeasurementRecord> meas = SliceImuSegment(prev_pose.timestamp, curr_pose.timestamp, samples);
        if (meas.empty()) {
            continue;
        }
        ImuEdgeRecord edge;
        edge.pose_i = prev_pose.pose_id;
        edge.pose_j = curr_pose.pose_id;
        edge.start_time = prev_pose.timestamp;
        edge.end_time = curr_pose.timestamp;
        edge.measurements = std::move(meas);
        edges.push_back(std::move(edge));
    }
    return edges;
}

PriorRecord BuildPrior(const PoseInfo& pose) {
    PriorRecord prior;
    prior.pose_id = pose.pose_id;
    if (pose.keyframe) {
        prior.Rp = pose.keyframe->GetRotation();
        prior.tp = pose.keyframe->GetTranslation();
    }
    prior.sigma << 0.05f, 0.05f, 0.05f, 0.01f, 0.01f, 0.01f;
    return prior;
}

template <typename Derived>
void WriteVectorJson(ostream& os, const Eigen::MatrixBase<Derived>& v) {
    os << "[";
    for (int i = 0; i < v.size(); ++i) {
        os << v(i);
        if (i + 1 < v.size()) {
            os << ", ";
        }
    }
    os << "]";
}

void WriteMatrix3Json(ostream& os, const Eigen::Matrix3f& m) {
    os << "[";
    for (int r = 0; r < 3; ++r) {
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) {
            os << m(r, c);
            if (r != 2 || c != 2) {
                os << ", ";
            }
        }
    }
    os << "]";
}

void WriteCameraObservations(const string& filepath,
                             const vector<CameraObservationRecord>& records) {
    ofstream os(filepath);
    if (!os.is_open()) {
        throw runtime_error("Failed to open output file: " + filepath);
    }
    os << fixed << setprecision(9);
    os << "{\n  \"observations\": [\n";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < records.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& rec = records[i];
        os << "    {\n";
        os << "      \"pose_id\": " << rec.pose_id << ",\n";
        os << "      \"landmark_id\": " << rec.landmark_id << ",\n";
        os << "      \"pixel\": ";
        WriteVectorJson(os, rec.pixel);
        os << ",\n";
        os << "      \"Rcw\": ";
        WriteMatrix3Json(os, rec.Rcw);
        os << ",\n";
        os << "      \"tcw\": ";
        WriteVectorJson(os, rec.tcw);
        os << ",\n";
        os << "      \"landmark_w\": ";
        WriteVectorJson(os, rec.landmark_w);
        os << ",\n";
        os << "      \"intrinsics\": [" << rec.fx << ", " << rec.fy << ", " << rec.cx << ", " << rec.cy << "],\n";
        os << "      \"sigma_pixel\": " << rec.sigma << "\n";
        os << "    }";
        if (i + 1 < records.size()) {
            os << ",";
        }
        os << "\n";
    }
    os << "  ]\n}\n";
}

void WriteImuEdges(const string& filepath, const vector<ImuEdgeRecord>& edges) {
    ofstream os(filepath);
    if (!os.is_open()) {
        throw runtime_error("Failed to open output file: " + filepath);
    }
    os << fixed << setprecision(9);
    os << "{\n  \"imu_edges\": [\n";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < edges.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& edge = edges[i];
        os << "    {\n";
        os << "      \"pose_i\": " << edge.pose_i << ",\n";
        os << "      \"pose_j\": " << edge.pose_j << ",\n";
        os << "      \"start_time\": " << edge.start_time << ",\n";
        os << "      \"end_time\": " << edge.end_time << ",\n";
        os << "      \"measurements\": [\n";
        for (size_t j = 0; j < edge.measurements.size(); ++j) {
            const auto& meas = edge.measurements[j];
            os << "        {\n";
            os << "          \"dt\": " << meas.dt << ",\n";
            os << "          \"acc\": ";
            WriteVectorJson(os, meas.acc);
            os << ",\n";
            os << "          \"gyro\": ";
            WriteVectorJson(os, meas.gyro);
            os << "\n";
            os << "        }";
            if (j + 1 < edge.measurements.size()) {
                os << ",";
            }
            os << "\n";
        }
        os << "      ]\n";
        os << "    }";
        if (i + 1 < edges.size()) {
            os << ",";
        }
        os << "\n";
    }
    os << "  ]\n}\n";
}

void WritePoses(const string& filepath, const vector<PoseInfo>& poses) {
    ofstream os(filepath);
    if (!os.is_open()) {
        throw runtime_error("Failed to open output file: " + filepath);
    }
    os << fixed << setprecision(9);
    os << "{\n  \"poses\": [\n";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < poses.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& pose = poses[i];
        Eigen::Matrix3f Rcw = pose.keyframe ? pose.keyframe->GetRotation() : Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity();
        Eigen::Vector3f tcw = pose.keyframe ? pose.keyframe->GetTranslation() : Eigen::Vector3f::Zero();
        os << "    {\n";
        os << "      \"pose_id\": " << pose.pose_id << ",\n";
        os << "      \"timestamp\": " << pose.timestamp << ",\n";
        os << "      \"Rcw\": ";
        WriteMatrix3Json(os, Rcw);
        os << ",\n";
        os << "      \"tcw\": ";
        WriteVectorJson(os, tcw);
        os << "\n";
        os << "    }";
        if (i + 1 < poses.size()) {
            os << ",";
        }
        os << "\n";
    }
    os << "  ]\n}\n";
}

void WriteSummary(const string& filepath,
                  size_t pose_count,
                  size_t observation_count,
                  size_t imu_edge_count,
                  size_t prior_count,
                  const string& dataset_path) {
    ofstream os(filepath);
    if (!os.is_open()) {
        throw runtime_error("Failed to open output file: " + filepath);
    }
    os << "{\n";
    os << "  \"dataset\": \"" << dataset_path << "\",\n";
    os << "  \"pose_count\": " << pose_count << ",\n";
    os << "  \"observation_count\": " << observation_count << ",\n";
    os << "  \"imu_edge_count\": " << imu_edge_count << ",\n";
    os << "  \"prior_count\": " << prior_count << "\n";
    os << "}\n";
}

void PrintUsage(const char* prog) {
    cerr << "Usage: " << prog << " path_to_vocabulary path_to_settings path_to_sequence "
         << "path_to_times_file output_directory\n";
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc != 6) {
        PrintUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    string voc_path = argv[1];
    string settings_path = argv[2];
    string sequence_path = argv[3];
    string times_file = argv[4];
    string output_dir = argv[5];

    try {
        ImageSequence sequence;
        LoadImages(sequence_path + "/mav0/cam0/data", times_file, sequence);
        if (sequence.image_paths.empty()) {
            throw runtime_error("No images found for sequence.");
        }

        LoadedImuData imu_data = LoadImuData(sequence_path + "/mav0/imu0/data.csv");
        if (imu_data.timestamps.empty()) {
            throw runtime_error("No IMU data found for sequence.");
        }

        const vector<double>& imu_times = imu_data.timestamps;
        const vector<cv::Point3f>& vAcc = imu_data.acc;
        const vector<cv::Point3f>& vGyro = imu_data.gyro;

        ORB_SLAM3::System SLAM(voc_path, settings_path, ORB_SLAM3::System::IMU_MONOCULAR, false);
        float image_scale = SLAM.GetImageScale();

        int first_imu = 0;
        while (first_imu < static_cast<int>(imu_times.size()) && imu_times[first_imu] <= sequence.timestamps.front()) {
            first_imu++;
        }
        first_imu = max(0, first_imu - 1);

        vector<ORB_SLAM3::IMU::Point> vImuMeas;
        vImuMeas.reserve(200);

        for (size_t ni = 0; ni < sequence.image_paths.size(); ++ni) {
            const string& image_file = sequence.image_paths[ni];
            cv::Mat im = cv::imread(image_file, cv::IMREAD_UNCHANGED);
            if (im.empty()) {
                cerr << "Failed to load image: " << image_file << endl;
                continue;
            }
            if (image_scale != 1.f) {
                int width = static_cast<int>(im.cols * image_scale);
                int height = static_cast<int>(im.rows * image_scale);
                cv::resize(im, im, cv::Size(width, height));
            }

            double tframe = sequence.timestamps[ni];
            vImuMeas.clear();
            if (ni > 0) {
                while (first_imu < static_cast<int>(imu_times.size()) && imu_times[first_imu] <= tframe) {
                    vImuMeas.emplace_back(
                        vAcc[first_imu].x, vAcc[first_imu].y, vAcc[first_imu].z,
                        vGyro[first_imu].x, vGyro[first_imu].y, vGyro[first_imu].z,
                        imu_times[first_imu]);
                    first_imu++;
                }
            }

            SLAM.TrackMonocular(im, tframe, vImuMeas);
        }

        SLAM.Shutdown();

        ORB_SLAM3::Atlas* atlas = SLAM.GetAtlas();
        ORB_SLAM3::Map* best_map = SelectBestMap(atlas);
        if (!best_map) {
            throw runtime_error("No map data available after running ORB-SLAM3.");
        }

        vector<PoseInfo> poses = ExtractPoses(best_map);
        if (poses.empty()) {
            throw runtime_error("No valid keyframes found in map.");
        }
        vector<CameraObservationRecord> observations = BuildObservations(poses);
        vector<ImuEdgeRecord> imu_edges = BuildImuEdges(poses, imu_data.raw_samples);
        vector<PriorRecord> priors = {BuildPrior(poses.front())};

        if (!EnsureDirectory(output_dir)) {
            throw runtime_error("Cannot create output directory: " + output_dir);
        }

        WritePoses(output_dir + "/poses.json", poses);
        WriteCameraObservations(output_dir + "/camera_observations.json", observations);
        WriteImuEdges(output_dir + "/imu_edges.json", imu_edges);
        WritePriors(output_dir + "/priors.json", priors);
        WriteSummary(output_dir + "/summary.json",
                     poses.size(),
                     observations.size(),
                     imu_edges.size(),
                     priors.size(),
                     sequence_path);

        cout << "Export completed. Output directory: " << output_dir << endl;
        cout << "Poses: " << poses.size()
             << ", Observations: " << observations.size()
             << ", IMU edges: " << imu_edges.size()
             << ", Priors: " << priors.size() << endl;
    } catch (const exception& ex) {
        cerr << "Error: " << ex.what() << endl;
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}
```

修复结构化绑定问题：


```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <cerrno>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>

#include <Eigen/Dense>

using namespace std;

namespace {

struct ImageSequence {
    vector<string> image_paths;
    vector<double> timestamps;
};

struct RawImuSample {
    double timestamp = 0.0;
    Eigen::Vector3d acc = Eigen::Vector3d::Zero();
    Eigen::Vector3d gyro = Eigen::Vector3d::Zero();
};

struct LoadedImuData {
    vector<double> timestamps;
    vector<cv::Point3f> acc;
    vector<cv::Point3f> gyro;
    vector<RawImuSample> raw_samples;
};

struct PoseInfo {
    ORB_SLAM3::KeyFrame* keyframe = nullptr;
    int pose_id = -1;
    double timestamp = 0.0;
};

struct CameraObservationRecord {
    int pose_id = -1;
    int landmark_id = -1;
    Eigen::Vector2f pixel = Eigen::Vector2f::Zero();
    Eigen::Matrix3f Rcw = Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity();
    Eigen::Vector3f tcw = Eigen::Vector3f::Zero();
    Eigen::Vector3f landmark_w = Eigen::Vector3f::Zero();
    float fx = 0.0f;
    float fy = 0.0f;
    float cx = 0.0f;
    float cy = 0.0f;
    float sigma = 1.0f;
};

struct ImuMeasurementRecord {
    double dt = 0.0;
    Eigen::Vector3d acc = Eigen::Vector3d::Zero();
    Eigen::Vector3d gyro = Eigen::Vector3d::Zero();
};

struct ImuEdgeRecord {
    int pose_i = -1;
    int pose_j = -1;
    double start_time = 0.0;
    double end_time = 0.0;
    vector<ImuMeasurementRecord> measurements;
};

struct PriorRecord {
    int pose_id = -1;
    Eigen::Matrix3f Rp = Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity();
    Eigen::Vector3f tp = Eigen::Vector3f::Zero();
    Eigen::Matrix<float,6,1> sigma = Eigen::Matrix<float,6,1>::Constant(1.0f);
};

bool EnsureDirectory(const string& path) {
    if (path.empty()) {
        return false;
    }
    struct stat info {};
    if (stat(path.c_str(), &info) == 0 && S_ISDIR(info.st_mode)) {
        return true;
    }

    string partial;
    size_t start = 0;
    if (!path.empty() && path[0] == '/') {
        partial = "/";
        start = 1;
    }

    while (start <= path.size()) {
        size_t sep = path.find('/', start);
        string segment = path.substr(start, sep - start);
        if (!segment.empty()) {
            if (!partial.empty() && partial.back() != '/') {
                partial += "/";
            }
            partial += segment;
            if (stat(partial.c_str(), &info) != 0) {
                if (mkdir(partial.c_str(), 0755) != 0 && errno != EEXIST) {
                    cerr << "Failed to create directory: " << partial << " (" << strerror(errno) << ")" << endl;
                    return false;
                }
            } else if (!S_ISDIR(info.st_mode)) {
                cerr << "Path exists but is not a directory: " << partial << endl;
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (sep == string::npos) {
            break;
        }
        start = sep + 1;
    }
    return true;
}

void LoadImages(const string& image_path, const string& timestamp_file, ImageSequence& sequence) {
    ifstream fTimes(timestamp_file);
    if (!fTimes.is_open()) {
        throw runtime_error("Cannot open timestamp file: " + timestamp_file);
    }

    sequence.image_paths.reserve(5000);
    sequence.timestamps.reserve(5000);

    string line;
    while (getline(fTimes, line)) {
        if (line.empty()) {
            continue;
        }
        stringstream ss(line);
        string token;
        ss >> token;
        if (token.empty()) {
            continue;
        }
        double t = 0.0;
        try {
            t = stod(token) / 1e9;
        } catch (const std::exception&) {
            continue;
        }
        sequence.image_paths.push_back(image_path + "/" + token + ".png");
        sequence.timestamps.push_back(t);
    }
}

LoadedImuData LoadImuData(const string& csv_path) {
    ifstream f(csv_path);
    if (!f.is_open()) {
        throw runtime_error("Cannot open IMU file: " + csv_path);
    }

    LoadedImuData data;
    data.timestamps.reserve(5000);
    data.acc.reserve(5000);
    data.gyro.reserve(5000);
    data.raw_samples.reserve(5000);

    string line;
    while (getline(f, line)) {
        if (line.empty() || line[0] == '#') {
            continue;
        }
        vector<double> values;
        values.reserve(7);
        string token;
        stringstream ss(line);
        while (getline(ss, token, ',')) {
            if (!token.empty()) {
                try {
                    values.push_back(stod(token));
                } catch (const std::exception&) {
                    values.clear();
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (values.size() != 7) {
            continue;
        }

        double timestamp = values[0] / 1e9;
        Eigen::Vector3d gyro(values[1], values[2], values[3]);
        Eigen::Vector3d acc(values[4], values[5], values[6]);

        data.timestamps.push_back(timestamp);
        data.acc.emplace_back(static_cast<float>(acc.x()), static_cast<float>(acc.y()), static_cast<float>(acc.z()));
        data.gyro.emplace_back(static_cast<float>(gyro.x()), static_cast<float>(gyro.y()), static_cast<float>(gyro.z()));

        RawImuSample sample;
        sample.timestamp = timestamp;
        sample.acc = acc;
        sample.gyro = gyro;
        data.raw_samples.push_back(sample);
    }

    return data;
}

ORB_SLAM3::Map* SelectBestMap(ORB_SLAM3::Atlas* atlas) {
    if (!atlas) {
        return nullptr;
    }
    vector<ORB_SLAM3::Map*> maps = atlas->GetAllMaps();
    if (maps.empty()) {
        return atlas->GetCurrentMap();
    }

    ORB_SLAM3::Map* best = nullptr;
    size_t max_kf = 0;
    for (auto* map : maps) {
        if (!map) {
            continue;
        }
        size_t count = map->GetAllKeyFrames().size();
        if (count > max_kf) {
            best = map;
            max_kf = count;
        }
    }
    return best ? best : atlas->GetCurrentMap();
}

vector<PoseInfo> ExtractPoses(ORB_SLAM3::Map* map) {
    vector<PoseInfo> poses;
    if (!map) {
        return poses;
    }
    vector<ORB_SLAM3::KeyFrame*> keyframes = map->GetAllKeyFrames();
    poses.reserve(keyframes.size());
    for (auto* kf : keyframes) {
        if (!kf || kf->isBad()) {
            continue;
        }
        PoseInfo info;
        info.keyframe = kf;
        info.timestamp = kf->mTimeStamp;
        poses.push_back(info);
    }
    sort(poses.begin(), poses.end(), [](const PoseInfo& a, const PoseInfo& b) {
        return a.timestamp < b.timestamp;
    });
    for (size_t i = 0; i < poses.size(); ++i) {
        poses[i].pose_id = static_cast<int>(i);
    }
    return poses;
}

vector<CameraObservationRecord> BuildObservations(const vector<PoseInfo>& poses) {
    vector<CameraObservationRecord> records;
    unordered_map<ORB_SLAM3::MapPoint*, int> landmark_ids;
    int next_landmark_id = 0;

    for (const auto& pose : poses) {
        if (!pose.keyframe) {
            continue;
        }
        const auto vp_map_points = pose.keyframe->GetMapPointMatches();
        const auto& keypoints = pose.keyframe->mvKeysUn;
        for (size_t idx = 0; idx < vp_map_points.size(); ++idx) {
            auto* mp = vp_map_points[idx];
            if (!mp || mp->isBad()) {
                continue;
            }
            if (idx >= keypoints.size()) {
                continue;
            }
            const auto result = landmark_ids.emplace(mp, next_landmark_id);
            if (result.second) {
                ++next_landmark_id;
            }
            const auto& it = result.first;

            CameraObservationRecord rec;
            rec.pose_id = pose.pose_id;
            rec.landmark_id = it->second;
            rec.pixel = Eigen::Vector2f(keypoints[idx].pt.x, keypoints[idx].pt.y);
            rec.Rcw = pose.keyframe->GetRotation();
            rec.tcw = pose.keyframe->GetTranslation();
            rec.landmark_w = mp->GetWorldPos();
            rec.fx = pose.keyframe->fx;
            rec.fy = pose.keyframe->fy;
            rec.cx = pose.keyframe->cx;
            rec.cy = pose.keyframe->cy;
            rec.sigma = 1.0f;
            records.push_back(rec);
        }
    }
    return records;
}

vector<ImuMeasurementRecord> SliceImuSegment(double t_start,
                                             double t_end,
                                             const vector<RawImuSample>& samples) {
    vector<ImuMeasurementRecord> segment;
    if (samples.empty() || t_end <= t_start) {
        return segment;
    }

    const auto comp = [](const RawImuSample& sample, double value) {
        return sample.timestamp < value;
    };
    size_t idx = 0;
    auto it = lower_bound(samples.begin(), samples.end(), t_start, comp);
    if (it == samples.begin()) {
        idx = 0;
    } else if (it == samples.end()) {
        idx = samples.size() - 1;
    } else {
        idx = static_cast<size_t>(distance(samples.begin(), it));
        if (samples[idx].timestamp > t_start && idx > 0) {
            --idx;
        }
    }

    double last_time = t_start;
    Eigen::Vector3d last_acc = samples[idx].acc;
    Eigen::Vector3d last_gyro = samples[idx].gyro;

    for (; idx < samples.size() && samples[idx].timestamp <= t_end; ++idx) {
        double current = samples[idx].timestamp;
        if (current < last_time) {
            continue;
        }
        double dt = current - last_time;
        if (dt > 1e-9) {
            segment.push_back({dt, last_acc, last_gyro});
            last_time = current;
        }
        last_acc = samples[idx].acc;
        last_gyro = samples[idx].gyro;
    }

    if (last_time < t_end) {
        double dt = t_end - last_time;
        if (dt > 1e-9) {
            segment.push_back({dt, last_acc, last_gyro});
        }
    }

    return segment;
}

vector<ImuEdgeRecord> BuildImuEdges(const vector<PoseInfo>& poses,
                                    const vector<RawImuSample>& samples) {
    vector<ImuEdgeRecord> edges;
    if (poses.size() < 2) {
        return edges;
    }

    edges.reserve(poses.size());
    for (size_t i = 1; i < poses.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& prev_pose = poses[i - 1];
        const auto& curr_pose = poses[i];
        vector<ImuMeasurementRecord> meas = SliceImuSegment(prev_pose.timestamp, curr_pose.timestamp, samples);
        if (meas.empty()) {
            continue;
        }
        ImuEdgeRecord edge;
        edge.pose_i = prev_pose.pose_id;
        edge.pose_j = curr_pose.pose_id;
        edge.start_time = prev_pose.timestamp;
        edge.end_time = curr_pose.timestamp;
        edge.measurements = std::move(meas);
        edges.push_back(std::move(edge));
    }
    return edges;
}

PriorRecord BuildPrior(const PoseInfo& pose) {
    PriorRecord prior;
    prior.pose_id = pose.pose_id;
    if (pose.keyframe) {
        prior.Rp = pose.keyframe->GetRotation();
        prior.tp = pose.keyframe->GetTranslation();
    }
    prior.sigma << 0.05f, 0.05f, 0.05f, 0.01f, 0.01f, 0.01f;
    return prior;
}

template <typename Derived>
void WriteVectorJson(ostream& os, const Eigen::MatrixBase<Derived>& v) {
    os << "[";
    for (int i = 0; i < v.size(); ++i) {
        os << v(i);
        if (i + 1 < v.size()) {
            os << ", ";
        }
    }
    os << "]";
}

void WriteMatrix3Json(ostream& os, const Eigen::Matrix3f& m) {
    os << "[";
    for (int r = 0; r < 3; ++r) {
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) {
            os << m(r, c);
            if (r != 2 || c != 2) {
                os << ", ";
            }
        }
    }
    os << "]";
}

void WriteCameraObservations(const string& filepath,
                             const vector<CameraObservationRecord>& records) {
    ofstream os(filepath);
    if (!os.is_open()) {
        throw runtime_error("Failed to open output file: " + filepath);
    }
    os << fixed << setprecision(9);
    os << "{\n  \"observations\": [\n";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < records.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& rec = records[i];
        os << "    {\n";
        os << "      \"pose_id\": " << rec.pose_id << ",\n";
        os << "      \"landmark_id\": " << rec.landmark_id << ",\n";
        os << "      \"pixel\": ";
        WriteVectorJson(os, rec.pixel);
        os << ",\n";
        os << "      \"Rcw\": ";
        WriteMatrix3Json(os, rec.Rcw);
        os << ",\n";
        os << "      \"tcw\": ";
        WriteVectorJson(os, rec.tcw);
        os << ",\n";
        os << "      \"landmark_w\": ";
        WriteVectorJson(os, rec.landmark_w);
        os << ",\n";
        os << "      \"intrinsics\": [" << rec.fx << ", " << rec.fy << ", " << rec.cx << ", " << rec.cy << "],\n";
        os << "      \"sigma_pixel\": " << rec.sigma << "\n";
        os << "    }";
        if (i + 1 < records.size()) {
            os << ",";
        }
        os << "\n";
    }
    os << "  ]\n}\n";
}

void WriteImuEdges(const string& filepath, const vector<ImuEdgeRecord>& edges) {
    ofstream os(filepath);
    if (!os.is_open()) {
        throw runtime_error("Failed to open output file: " + filepath);
    }
    os << fixed << setprecision(9);
    os << "{\n  \"imu_edges\": [\n";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < edges.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& edge = edges[i];
        os << "    {\n";
        os << "      \"pose_i\": " << edge.pose_i << ",\n";
        os << "      \"pose_j\": " << edge.pose_j << ",\n";
        os << "      \"start_time\": " << edge.start_time << ",\n";
        os << "      \"end_time\": " << edge.end_time << ",\n";
        os << "      \"measurements\": [\n";
        for (size_t j = 0; j < edge.measurements.size(); ++j) {
            const auto& meas = edge.measurements[j];
            os << "        {\n";
            os << "          \"dt\": " << meas.dt << ",\n";
            os << "          \"acc\": ";
            WriteVectorJson(os, meas.acc);
            os << ",\n";
            os << "          \"gyro\": ";
            WriteVectorJson(os, meas.gyro);
            os << "\n";
            os << "        }";
            if (j + 1 < edge.measurements.size()) {
                os << ",";
            }
            os << "\n";
        }
        os << "      ]\n";
        os << "    }";
        if (i + 1 < edges.size()) {
            os << ",";
        }
        os << "\n";
    }
    os << "  ]\n}\n";
}

void WritePriors(const string& filepath, const vector<PriorRecord>& priors) {
    ofstream os(filepath);
    if (!os.is_open()) {
        throw runtime_error("Failed to open output file: " + filepath);
    }
    os << fixed << setprecision(9);
    os << "{\n  \"priors\": [\n";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < priors.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& prior = priors[i];
        os << "    {\n";
        os << "      \"pose_id\": " << prior.pose_id << ",\n";
        os << "      \"Rp\": ";
        WriteMatrix3Json(os, prior.Rp);
        os << ",\n";
        os << "      \"tp\": ";
        WriteVectorJson(os, prior.tp);
        os << ",\n";
        os << "      \"sigma\": ";
        WriteVectorJson(os, prior.sigma);
        os << "\n";
        os << "    }";
        if (i + 1 < priors.size()) {
            os << ",";
        }
        os << "\n";
    }
    os << "  ]\n}\n";
}

void WritePoses(const string& filepath, const vector<PoseInfo>& poses) {
    ofstream os(filepath);
    if (!os.is_open()) {
        throw runtime_error("Failed to open output file: " + filepath);
    }
    os << fixed << setprecision(9);
    os << "{\n  \"poses\": [\n";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < poses.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& pose = poses[i];
        Eigen::Matrix3f Rcw = pose.keyframe ? pose.keyframe->GetRotation() : Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity();
        Eigen::Vector3f tcw = pose.keyframe ? pose.keyframe->GetTranslation() : Eigen::Vector3f::Zero();
        os << "    {\n";
        os << "      \"pose_id\": " << pose.pose_id << ",\n";
        os << "      \"timestamp\": " << pose.timestamp << ",\n";
        os << "      \"Rcw\": ";
        WriteMatrix3Json(os, Rcw);
        os << ",\n";
        os << "      \"tcw\": ";
        WriteVectorJson(os, tcw);
        os << "\n";
        os << "    }";
        if (i + 1 < poses.size()) {
            os << ",";
        }
        os << "\n";
    }
    os << "  ]\n}\n";
}

void WriteSummary(const string& filepath,
                  size_t pose_count,
                  size_t observation_count,
                  size_t imu_edge_count,
                  size_t prior_count,
                  const string& dataset_path) {
    ofstream os(filepath);
    if (!os.is_open()) {
        throw runtime_error("Failed to open output file: " + filepath);
    }
    os << "{\n";
    os << "  \"dataset\": \"" << dataset_path << "\",\n";
    os << "  \"pose_count\": " << pose_count << ",\n";
    os << "  \"observation_count\": " << observation_count << ",\n";
    os << "  \"imu_edge_count\": " << imu_edge_count << ",\n";
    os << "  \"prior_count\": " << prior_count << "\n";
    os << "}\n";
}

void PrintUsage(const char* prog) {
    cerr << "Usage: " << prog << " path_to_vocabulary path_to_settings path_to_sequence "
         << "path_to_times_file output_directory\n";
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc != 6) {
        PrintUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    string voc_path = argv[1];
    string settings_path = argv[2];
    string sequence_path = argv[3];
    string times_file = argv[4];
    string output_dir = argv[5];

    try {
        ImageSequence sequence;
        LoadImages(sequence_path + "/mav0/cam0/data", times_file, sequence);
        if (sequence.image_paths.empty()) {
            throw runtime_error("No images found for sequence.");
        }

        LoadedImuData imu_data = LoadImuData(sequence_path + "/mav0/imu0/data.csv");
        if (imu_data.timestamps.empty()) {
            throw runtime_error("No IMU data found for sequence.");
        }

        const vector<double>& imu_times = imu_data.timestamps;
        const vector<cv::Point3f>& vAcc = imu_data.acc;
        const vector<cv::Point3f>& vGyro = imu_data.gyro;

        ORB_SLAM3::System SLAM(voc_path, settings_path, ORB_SLAM3::System::IMU_MONOCULAR, false);
        float image_scale = SLAM.GetImageScale();

        int first_imu = 0;
        while (first_imu < static_cast<int>(imu_times.size()) && imu_times[first_imu] <= sequence.timestamps.front()) {
            first_imu++;
        }
        first_imu = max(0, first_imu - 1);

        vector<ORB_SLAM3::IMU::Point> vImuMeas;
        vImuMeas.reserve(200);

        for (size_t ni = 0; ni < sequence.image_paths.size(); ++ni) {
            const string& image_file = sequence.image_paths[ni];
            cv::Mat im = cv::imread(image_file, cv::IMREAD_UNCHANGED);
            if (im.empty()) {
                cerr << "Failed to load image: " << image_file << endl;
                continue;
            }
            if (image_scale != 1.f) {
                int width = static_cast<int>(im.cols * image_scale);
                int height = static_cast<int>(im.rows * image_scale);
                cv::resize(im, im, cv::Size(width, height));
            }

            double tframe = sequence.timestamps[ni];
            vImuMeas.clear();
            if (ni > 0) {
                while (first_imu < static_cast<int>(imu_times.size()) && imu_times[first_imu] <= tframe) {
                    vImuMeas.emplace_back(
                        vAcc[first_imu].x, vAcc[first_imu].y, vAcc[first_imu].z,
                        vGyro[first_imu].x, vGyro[first_imu].y, vGyro[first_imu].z,
                        imu_times[first_imu]);
                    first_imu++;
                }
            }

            SLAM.TrackMonocular(im, tframe, vImuMeas);
        }

        SLAM.Shutdown();

        ORB_SLAM3::Atlas* atlas = SLAM.GetAtlas();
        ORB_SLAM3::Map* best_map = SelectBestMap(atlas);
        if (!best_map) {
            throw runtime_error("No map data available after running ORB-SLAM3.");
        }

        vector<PoseInfo> poses = ExtractPoses(best_map);
        if (poses.empty()) {
            throw runtime_error("No valid keyframes found in map.");
        }
        vector<CameraObservationRecord> observations = BuildObservations(poses);
        vector<ImuEdgeRecord> imu_edges = BuildImuEdges(poses, imu_data.raw_samples);
        vector<PriorRecord> priors = {BuildPrior(poses.front())};

        if (!EnsureDirectory(output_dir)) {
            throw runtime_error("Cannot create output directory: " + output_dir);
        }

        WritePoses(output_dir + "/poses.json", poses);
        WriteCameraObservations(output_dir + "/camera_observations.json", observations);
        WriteImuEdges(output_dir + "/imu_edges.json", imu_edges);
        WritePriors(output_dir + "/priors.json", priors);
        WriteSummary(output_dir + "/summary.json",
                     poses.size(),
                     observations.size(),
                     imu_edges.size(),
                     priors.size(),
                     sequence_path);

        cout << "Export completed. Output directory: " << output_dir << endl;
        cout << "Poses: " << poses.size()
             << ", Observations: " << observations.size()
             << ", IMU edges: " << imu_edges.size()
             << ", Priors: " << priors.size() << endl;
    } catch (const exception& ex) {
        cerr << "Error: " << ex.what() << endl;
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}
```

## 当前流程说明

### 1. 正在做什么

从 ORB-SLAM3 处理 MH01 数据集，提取因子图优化所需的中间数据：

```
EuRoC MH01 数据集
    ↓
ORB-SLAM3 Monocular-Inertial 前端处理
    ↓
提取关键帧、地图点、IMU 原始数据
    ↓
转换为硬件模块所需的因子格式（JSON）
```

### 2. 生成的文件及用途

根据 `summary.json`，已生成：
- 254 个关键帧（poses）
- 70,298 个相机观测（observations）
- 253 条 IMU 边（imu_edges）
- 1 个先验约束（prior）

#### `poses.json` — 关键帧位姿
```json
{
  "pose_id": 0,
  "timestamp": 1403636585.513555527,
  "Rcw": [...],  // 旋转矩阵（相机到世界）
  "tcw": [...]   // 平移向量（相机到世界）
}
```
用途：提供每个关键帧的 6DoF 位姿，用于构建因子图。

#### `camera_observations.json` — 相机观测
```json
{
  "pose_id": 0,
  "landmark_id": 0,
  "pixel": [154.57, 118.82],      // 像素坐标
  "Rcw": [...],                   // 相机位姿
  "tcw": [...],
  "landmark_w": [...],            // 地标点世界坐标
  "intrinsics": [fx, fy, cx, cy], // 相机内参
  "sigma_pixel": 1.0              // 观测噪声
}
```
用途：构建视觉因子，连接 pose 和 landmark。

#### `imu_edges.json` — IMU 原始数据
```json
{
  "pose_i": 0,
  "pose_j": 1,
  "start_time": ...,
  "end_time": ...,
  "measurements": [
    {"dt": 0.005, "acc": [...], "gyro": [...]},
    ...
  ]
}
```
用途：提供相邻关键帧间的原始 IMU 测量，用于 GTSAM 预积分生成 IMU 因子。

#### `priors.json` — 先验约束
```json
{
  "pose_id": 0,
  "Rp": [...],  // 先验旋转
  "tp": [...],  // 先验平移
  "sigma": [...] // 不确定性（6DoF）
}
```
用途：为第一个关键帧提供先验，固定坐标系。

### 3. 下一步：接入硬件链路

这些 JSON 文件可以：

1. 解析 JSON → 构造 C++ 结构体
   ```cpp
   // 解析后构造
   ORBSLAM3Exporter::ObservationInput obs_input;
   ORBSLAM3Exporter::ImuEdgeInput imu_input;
   ORBSLAM3Exporter::PriorInput prior_input;
   ```

2. 通过 `ORBSLAM3Exporter` 添加到因子图
   ```cpp
   exporter.addObservation(obs_input);
   exporter.addImuEdge(imu_input);  // 内部会调用 GTSAM 预积分
   exporter.addPrior(prior_input);
   ```

3. 调用硬件消元
   ```cpp
   exporter.eliminateLandmark(landmark_id);
   exporter.eliminatePose(pose_id);
   ```

4. 驱动硬件模块
   ```
   VariableEliminationDriver
       ↓
   Axb (矩阵向量乘法)
       ↓
   RowBuffer (行缓冲)
       ↓
   SystolicArray (脉动阵列)
   ```

  "observation_count": 59979,这个意味着我有59979个landmark是吗？

---

**Cursor**

不是。`observation_count` 是观测数量，不是 landmark 数量。一个 landmark 可以被多个关键帧观测，因此观测数通常大于 landmark 数。检查数据以确认：


## 数据统计结果

- **Total observations: 59,979** — 这是观测总数
- **Unique landmarks: 6,726** — 这是不同的 landmark 数量
- **Average observations per landmark: 8.92** — 平均每个 landmark 被约 9 个关键帧观测

### 区别说明

1. **Observation（观测）** = 一个关键帧对一个 landmark 的观测
   - 例如：landmark #100 在 pose #0, #5, #10 都被观测到 → 产生 3 个 observations

2. **Landmark（地标点）** = 3D 空间中的一个点
   - 每个 landmark 有唯一的 `landmark_id`（0 到 6725）

### 关系

```
Observation Count = 所有 pose 对所有 landmark 的观测总数
Landmark Count = 不同的 landmark_id 数量

59,979 observations = 6,726 landmarks × 平均 8.92 次观测
```

### 其他统计

- 每个关键帧平均观测约 284 个特征点
- 最少 97 个，最多 577 个观测
- 每个 landmark 平均被约 9 个关键帧观测（说明有较好的多视角覆盖）

因此，你有 **6,726 个不同的 landmark**，而不是 59,979 个。59,979 是这些 landmark 在所有关键帧中的观测总数。

```plaintext
Observation Count = 所有 pose 对所有 landmark 的观测总数
Landmark Count = 不同的 landmark_id 数量

59,979 observations = 6,726 landmarks × 平均 8.92 次观测
```

6,726 是怎么得到的

**Cursor**

说明 6,726 的计算方法：


## 6,726 的计算方法

### 计算过程

1. 遍历所有观测记录
   - 从 `camera_observations.json` 读取所有 59,979 条观测

2. 提取唯一的 `landmark_id`
   - 使用 Python 的 `set()` 去重
   ```python
   landmark_ids_set = set()
   for obs in observations:
       landmark_ids_set.add(obs['landmark_id'])
   ```

3. 统计集合大小
   - `len(landmark_ids_set) = 6,726`

### 关键发现

- Landmark ID 范围：0 到 6,725（连续）
- 每个 ID 都至少出现一次（无缺失）
- 因此唯一 landmark 数量 = 6,726

### 为什么是 6,726 而不是 59,979？

```
59,979 observations = 6,726 landmarks × 平均 8.92 次观测

例如：
- Landmark 0 被 11 个不同的关键帧观测 → 产生 11 个 observations
- Landmark 1 被 10 个不同的关键帧观测 → 产生 10 个 observations
- ...
- 总共 6,726 个不同的 landmark
- 它们总共产生了 59,979 次观测
```

### 总结

6,726 = 在 `camera_observations.json` 中出现的不同 `landmark_id` 的数量（从 0 到 6,725，连续无缺失）。

```python
   landmark_ids_set = set()
   for obs in observations:
       landmark_ids_set.add(obs['landmark_id'])
```

```plaintext
59,979 observations = 6,726 landmarks × 平均 8.92 次观测

例如：
- Landmark 0 被 11 个不同的关键帧观测 → 产生 11 个 observations
- Landmark 1 被 10 个不同的关键帧观测 → 产生 10 个 observations
- ...
- 总共 6,726 个不同的 landmark
- 它们总共产生了 59,979 次观测
```

**Cursor**

目前的系统已经跑通了基本的“数据导出”流程，但在**算法效率**和**代码健壮性**上还有几个明显的优化点。以下是具体的优化建议：

### 1. IMU 数据检索算法优化（性能提升）

**现状**：
目前在 `mono_inertial_hw_export.cc` 中，提取两个关键帧之间的 IMU 数据（`SliceImuSegment`）时，每次都使用 `std::lower_bound`（二分查找）从头开始搜索。
- 时间复杂度：`O(K * log(N))`，其中 K 是关键帧数，N 是 IMU 采样数（MH01 中 N > 30,000）。

**优化方案**：
利用关键帧和 IMU 数据都是**按时间严格排序**的特性，使用**线性扫描 + 状态记忆**。
- 记录上一次 IMU 切片的结束索引，下一次直接从该索引开始向后查找。
- 时间复杂度降为：`O(K + N)`，即只需遍历一遍 IMU 数组。

**代码改动**：
```cpp
// 增加 last_idx 参数引用
vector<ImuMeasurementRecord> SliceImuSegment(double t_start, double t_end, 
    const vector<RawImuSample>& samples, size_t& last_idx) {
    // 从 last_idx 开始线性查找，而不是二分查找
    // ...
}
```

### 2. JSON 序列化封装（健壮性提升）

**现状**：
代码中大量使用手动字符串拼接（`os << "{\n"; os << "\"pose_id\": ...`）。
- 缺点：容易遗漏逗号、括号不匹配，且难以维护（例如增加一个字段需要改多处）。

**优化方案**：
实现一个轻量级的 `JsonWriter` 类，自动处理缩进、逗号分隔和类型转换。

### 3. 内存与校验优化（生产环境准备）

**`ORBSLAM3_Exporter`**：
- **输入校验**：`validateObservation` 等函数对每个点都做 `isfinite` 检查。这在开发期很有用，但在处理几十万个点时会有 CPU 开销。建议用宏 `#ifndef NDEBUG` 包裹，Release 模式下跳过部分检查。
- **内存预分配**：在 `addObservations` 中，`landmark_observations_[obs.landmark_id].push_back(obs)` 会引起频繁的内存重分配。如果能预估每个 landmark 的观测数（通常 2-20），可以优化。

### 4. 缺失的环节：数据导入器 (Importer)

**现状**：
你有导出器（写 JSON）和后端驱动（读结构体），但中间缺了一个“桥梁”。

**建议**：
编写一个 `json_loader.h`，将 JSON 读回并转换为 C++ 结构体，完成闭环测试：
`Dataset -> Export(JSON) -> Import(Struct) -> Exporter -> Hardware Driver`

### 1. IMU 数据检索优化：**并不明显**

你目前的理解很敏锐。在这个场景下，IMU 检索的优化（从二分查找改为线性扫描）**实际上不会让整个程序快多少**。

- **原因**：ORB-SLAM3 的前端（特征提取、光流跟踪、局部地图优化）是非常耗时的计算密集型任务。相比之下，导出数据时查找几万条 IMU 数据的开销（即使是二分查找 `O(log N)`）仅仅是几毫秒级别，在整体运行时间里几乎可以忽略不计。
- **结论**：这个优化属于“理论上的改进”，但在当前 MH01 数据集规模下，你**感觉不到任何速度变化**。除非你要处理长达数小时的数据，否则不用急着做。

### 2. `ORBSLAM3_Exporter` 确实还没开始优化

```cpp
#include "json_loader.h"

#include <stdexcept>

#include <boost/property_tree/json_parser.hpp>
#include <boost/property_tree/ptree.hpp>

namespace {

using boost::property_tree::ptree;

const ptree& RequireChild(const ptree& parent, const std::string& key) {
    auto opt = parent.get_child_optional(key);
    if (!opt) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Missing JSON key: " + key);
    }
    return opt.get();
}

template <typename T>
std::vector<T> ReadArray(const ptree& node) {
    std::vector<T> values;
    for (const auto& kv : node) {
        values.push_back(kv.second.get_value<T>());
    }
    return values;
}

template <typename T>
std::vector<T> ReadArray(const ptree& parent, const std::string& key) {
    const auto& child = RequireChild(parent, key);
    return ReadArray<T>(child);
}

Eigen::Matrix3f ToMatrix3f(const std::vector<float>& data) {
    if (data.size() != 9) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Matrix3f expects 9 floats");
    }
    Eigen::Matrix3f m;
    for (int r = 0; r < 3; ++r) {
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) {
            m(r, c) = data[r * 3 + c];
        }
    }
    return m;
}

Eigen::Matrix3f ToMatrix3f(const ptree& parent, const std::string& key) {
    return ToMatrix3f(ReadArray<float>(parent, key));
}

Eigen::Vector3f ToVector3f(const std::vector<float>& data) {
    if (data.size() != 3) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Vector3f expects 3 floats");
    }
    return Eigen::Vector3f(data[0], data[1], data[2]);
}

Eigen::Vector3f ToVector3f(const ptree& parent, const std::string& key) {
    return ToVector3f(ReadArray<float>(parent, key));
}

Eigen::Matrix<float, 6, 1> ToVector6f(const ptree& parent, const std::string& key) {
    auto values = ReadArray<float>(parent, key);
    if (values.size() != 6) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Vector6f expects 6 floats");
    }
    Eigen::Matrix<float, 6, 1> vec;
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
        vec(i) = values[i];
    }
    return vec;
}

}  // namespace

std::vector<ORBSLAM3Exporter::ObservationInput>
JsonLoader::LoadObservations(const std::string& filepath) {
    ptree root;
    read_json(filepath, root);

    std::vector<ORBSLAM3Exporter::ObservationInput> observations;
    const auto& obs_array = RequireChild(root, "observations");
    observations.reserve(obs_array.size());

    for (const auto& entry : obs_array) {
        const auto& node = entry.second;
        ORBSLAM3Exporter::ObservationInput obs;
        obs.pose_id = node.get<int>("pose_id");
        obs.landmark_id = node.get<int>("landmark_id");

        auto pixel = ReadArray<float>(node, "pixel");
        if (pixel.size() != 2) {
            throw std::runtime_error("pixel array must contain 2 floats");
        }
        obs.pixel = Eigen::Vector2f(pixel[0], pixel[1]);

        obs.Rcw = ToMatrix3f(node, "Rcw");
        obs.tcw = ToVector3f(node, "tcw");
        obs.landmark_w = ToVector3f(node, "landmark_w");

        auto intrinsics = ReadArray<float>(node, "intrinsics");
        if (intrinsics.size() != 4) {
            throw std::runtime_error("intrinsics array must contain 4 floats");
        }
        obs.fx = intrinsics[0];
        obs.fy = intrinsics[1];
        obs.cx = intrinsics[2];
        obs.cy = intrinsics[3];

        obs.sigma_pixel = node.get<float>("sigma_pixel", 1.0f);
        observations.push_back(obs);
    }

    return observations;
}

std::vector<ORBSLAM3Exporter::ImuEdgeInput>
JsonLoader::LoadImuEdges(const std::string& filepath) {
    ptree root;
    read_json(filepath, root);

    std::vector<ORBSLAM3Exporter::ImuEdgeInput> edges;
    const auto& edge_array = RequireChild(root, "imu_edges");
    edges.reserve(edge_array.size());

    for (const auto& entry : edge_array) {
        const auto& node = entry.second;
        ORBSLAM3Exporter::ImuEdgeInput edge;
        edge.pose_i_id = node.get<int>("pose_i");
        edge.pose_j_id = node.get<int>("pose_j");
        edge.dt_total = 0.0;

        const auto& meas_array = RequireChild(node, "measurements");
        edge.measurements.reserve(meas_array.size());

        for (const auto& meas : meas_array) {
            const auto& meas_node = meas.second;
            ImuPreprocessorGTSAM::ImuMeasurement m;
            m.dt = meas_node.get<double>("dt");
            auto acc = ReadArray<double>(meas_node, "acc");
            auto gyro = ReadArray<double>(meas_node, "gyro");
            if (acc.size() != 3 || gyro.size() != 3) {
                throw std::runtime_error("acc/gyro arrays must contain 3 values");
            }
            m.acc = Eigen::Vector3d(acc[0], acc[1], acc[2]);
            m.gyro = Eigen::Vector3d(gyro[0], gyro[1], gyro[2]);
            edge.measurements.push_back(m);
            edge.dt_total += m.dt;
        }

        edges.push_back(std::move(edge));
    }

    return edges;
}

std::vector<ORBSLAM3Exporter::PriorInput>
JsonLoader::LoadPriors(const std::string& filepath) {
    ptree root;
    read_json(filepath, root);

    std::vector<ORBSLAM3Exporter::PriorInput> priors;
    const auto& prior_array = RequireChild(root, "priors");
    priors.reserve(prior_array.size());

    for (const auto& entry : prior_array) {
        const auto& node = entry.second;
        ORBSLAM3Exporter::PriorInput prior;
        prior.pose_id = node.get<int>("pose_id");
        prior.Rp = ToMatrix3f(node, "Rp");
        prior.tp = ToVector3f(node, "tp");
        prior.sigma = ToVector6f(node, "sigma");
        priors.push_back(prior);
    }

    return priors;
}

std::vector<JsonLoader::PoseRecord>
JsonLoader::LoadPoses(const std::string& filepath) {
    ptree root;
    read_json(filepath, root);

    std::vector<PoseRecord> poses;
    const auto& pose_array = RequireChild(root, "poses");
    poses.reserve(pose_array.size());

    for (const auto& entry : pose_array) {
        const auto& node = entry.second;
        PoseRecord pose;
        pose.pose_id = node.get<int>("pose_id");
        pose.timestamp = node.get<double>("timestamp");
        pose.Rcw = ToMatrix3f(node, "Rcw");
        pose.tcw = ToVector3f(node, "tcw");
        poses.push_back(pose);
    }

    return poses;
}

```

```cpp
#include <algorithm>

#include <iostream>

#include <unordered_set>

#include "Camera.h"
#include "ORBSLAM3_Exporter.h"

namespace {

struct PipelineOptions {
    std::string json_dir;
    std::string poses_path;
    std::string observations_path;
    std::string imu_edges_path;
    std::string priors_path;
    float huber_delta = 2.5f;
    bool run_elimination = true;
};

std::string JoinPath(const std::string& dir, const std::string& filename) {
    if (dir.empty()) {
        return filename;
    }
    if (dir.back() == '/' || dir.back() == '\\') {
        return dir + filename;
    }
    return dir + "/" + filename;
}

void PrintUsage(const char* prog_name) {
    std::cerr << "用法: " << prog_name
              << " <json_directory> [--huber=2.5] [--no-elim]\n"
              << "  <json_directory> 应包含 poses.json / camera_observations.json / "
              << "imu_edges.json / priors.json\n"
              << "  --huber=VAL    设置相机因子的 Huber delta（默认 2.5）\n"
              << "  --no-elim      仅加载数据，不触发硬件消元\n";
}

PipelineOptions ParseArguments(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        throw std::runtime_error("缺少 json_directory 参数");
    }

    PipelineOptions opts;
    opts.json_dir = argv[1];
    opts.poses_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "poses.json");
    opts.observations_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "camera_observations.json");
    opts.imu_edges_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "imu_edges.json");
    opts.priors_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "priors.json");

    for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i) {
        std::string arg = argv[i];
        if (arg.rfind("--huber=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.huber_delta = std::stof(arg.substr(8));
        } else if (arg == "--no-elim") {
            opts.run_elimination = false;
        } else {
            throw std::runtime_error("未知参数: " + arg);
        }
    }

    if (opts.huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Huber delta 必须大于 0");
    }

    return opts;
}

template <typename Duration>
double ToMilliseconds(Duration d) {
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>>(d).count();
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    try {
        const auto opts = ParseArguments(argc, argv);

        const auto t0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        auto poses = JsonLoader::LoadPoses(opts.poses_path);
        auto observations = JsonLoader::LoadObservations(opts.observations_path);
        auto imu_edges = JsonLoader::LoadImuEdges(opts.imu_edges_path);
        auto priors = JsonLoader::LoadPriors(opts.priors_path);
        const auto t1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline] JSON 加载完成\n"
                  << "  poses: " << poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  observations: " << observations.size() << "\n"
                  << "  imu_edges: " << imu_edges.size() << "\n"
                  << "  priors: " << priors.size() << "\n"
                  << "  耗时: " << ToMilliseconds(t1 - t0) << " ms\n";

        VariableEliminationDriver driver;
        ORBSLAM3Exporter exporter(driver);

        std::unordered_set<int> initialized_landmarks;
        initialized_landmarks.reserve(observations.size());

        for (const auto& pose : poses) {
            driver.setPose(pose.pose_id, pose.Rcw, pose.tcw);
        }

        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            if (initialized_landmarks.insert(obs.landmark_id).second) {
                driver.setLandmark(obs.landmark_id, obs.landmark_w);
            }
        }

        exporter.addObservations(observations);
        exporter.addImuEdges(imu_edges);
        for (const auto& prior : priors) {
            exporter.addPrior(prior);
        }

        if (!opts.run_elimination) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline] 已加载所有因子 (--no-elim)，退出前打印统计信息。\n"
                      << "  待处理 landmarks: " << exporter.pendingLandmarkIds().size() << "\n"
                      << "  待处理 poses: " << exporter.pendingPoseIds().size() << "\n";
            return 0;
        }

        const auto t2 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        const std::size_t eliminated_landmarks =
            exporter.eliminateAllLandmarks(opts.huber_delta);
        const auto pose_ids = exporter.pendingPoseIds();
        const std::size_t eliminated_poses = exporter.eliminatePoses(pose_ids);
        const auto t3 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline] 消元阶段完成\n"
                  << "  消元 landmarks: " << eliminated_landmarks << " / "
                  << initialized_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  消元 poses: " << eliminated_poses << " / "
                  << pose_ids.size() << "\n"
                  << "  耗时: " << ToMilliseconds(t3 - t2) << " ms\n";

        std::cout << "[Pipeline] 提醒：VariableEliminationDriver 仍依赖硬件握手，"
                  << "在未接入 Axb/RowBuffer 时仅用于验证接口。\n";

    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << "[Pipeline][Error] " << e.what() << "\n";
        PrintUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}
```

**User**

消元的顺序是什么？

---

**Cursor**

当前消元顺序分两层：

### 1. 在 `json_to_hw_pipeline` / `ORBSLAM3_Exporter` 里
- **先消元全部 `landmark`**：`exporter.eliminateAllLandmarks(huber_delta)` 会调用 `pendingLandmarkIds()`，把 `landmark_id` 升序排序后逐个送进 `VariableEliminationDriver::eliminateLandmark()`。  
  → 等价于 “先把所有地标（3 DoF）剔除，生成只依赖 pose 的新因子”。

- **再消元 `pose`**：`pendingPoseIds()` 会收集所有仍带有 IMU / prior 的 pose_id，去重后升序排序，随后 `exporter.eliminatePoses(pose_ids)` 依次调用 `driver.eliminatePose()`。  
  → 等价于 “在 landmarks 消掉后，按 pose_id 升序把 pose（6 DoF）逐步消元”。

### 2. 在 `VariableEliminationDriver` 内部
- `eliminateLandmark`：取该地标的所有观测（按照传入顺序），在硬件里构成一个 bundle。顺序由 `json_to_hw_pipeline` 分组时的遍历决定（默认是遍历整个 `camera_observations`，所以同一 landmark 的观测输入顺序等于 JSON 中的顺序）。
- `eliminatePose`：对某个 pose：
  1. 汇集所有连接到它的 IMU 因子（先 IMU、后 prior）。
  2. 每个 IMU 因子的顺序就是你定义的 `imu_edges` JSON 顺序，prior 则按 `priors` 中出现顺序。
  3. 这些因子一起送入硬件 bundle，得到新的上三角块。

总结：**整体顺序 = 所有 landmarks（升序） → 所有关联 pose（升序）**。这是典型的 “Landmark-first, Pose-later” 消元策略，先把高维观测节点剔除，再剔除 pose 节点。

```cpp
        const auto pose_ids = exporter.pendingPoseIds();
        const std::size_t eliminated_poses = exporter.eliminatePoses(pose_ids);
        const auto t3 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline] Elimination completed\n"
                  << "  消元 landmarks: " << eliminated_landmarks << " / "
                  << initialized_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  消元 poses: " << eliminated_poses << " / "
                  << pose_ids.size() << "\n"
                  << "  耗时: " << ToMilliseconds(t3 - t2) << " ms\n";

        std::cout << "[Pipeline] Reminder: VariableEliminationDriver still relies on "
                  << "hardware handshakes; without Axb/RowBuffer it only validates the software interface.\n";

    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << "[Pipeline][Error] " << e.what() << "\n";
        PrintUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}

```

**Cursor**

按照你提到的 BLITZCRANK（`planning_demo/planning_back_end.py`）的做法，因子图变量按时间切片 `{x_i, v_i}` 成对出现，所有因子（GP、动力学、障碍、起终点先验）也都是按时间顺序布置。那套硬件在执行增量消元时遵循的典型顺序是：

1. **按时间切片推进**：从最旧的时间步开始，依次向末尾推进，只保留最后一小段（滑窗）作为未消元变量。
2. **切片内部的顺序**：先消掉速度 `v_i`（因为只和 `x_{i-1}, x_i, v_{i-1}, v_{i+1}` 等少量节点相连），再消掉位置 `x_i`。这样形成的 Schur 补保持带状结构，方便下一步继续。
3. **与后继的连接**：当 `x_i` 被消元后，自动生成连接到 `x_{i+1}`（以及可能的 `v_{i+1}`）的新块，实现和 BLITZ 一样的“向前传递”方式。

### 对比方案

| 方案 | 当前 ORB-SLAM3 版 | 参考 BLITZCRANK 的版本 |
|------|------------------|------------------------|
| 第 1 阶段 | 全部 landmarks（升序）一次性消元 | 与消元的 pose 联动：只要某个 landmark 的所有观测 pose 都在窗口最前端，就立即消元 |
| 第 2 阶段 | 剩余所有 pose（升序）一次性消元 | 时间顺序滑动窗口：对 `i = oldest … newest-window`，依次处理 (a) 与 pose_i 独占的 landmarks；(b) velocity_i；(c) pose_i |
| 单个 pose 内部顺序 | IMU 因子 → prior | velocity_i 先消；再把 pose_i 的 IMU、prior、障碍等一起丢给硬件 |
| 窗口策略 | 无（全部节点最终都消） | 类似 BLITZ：保留最近 `K` 个 pose（和相关速度）不消元，以便与前端/控制器继续对接 |

### 新版流程（伪代码）

```text
1. 读取 JSON → 初始化 driver（pose/landmark 初值）→ addObservation/addImuEdge/addPrior。

2. 设置窗口大小 K，例如 10 帧。

3. 构建以下数据结构：
   - obs_by_landmark[lm_id] → 所有观测
   - poses_in_time_order（由 PoseRecord.timestamp 排序）
   - lm_active_count：当前仍连接到未消元 pose 的计数

4. for pose_id in poses_in_time_order[:-K]:
     4.1 找出所有仅与当前 pose_id（或已消元 pose）相连的 landmarks：
         for lm in pendingLandmarks:
             if 所有观测 pose 都 <= 当前 pose_id:
                 eliminateLandmark(lm)
     4.2 如果存在 velocity 变量（如 SLAM 中的 IMU bias/速度），先 eliminateVelocity(pose_id)
     4.3 收集与 pose_id 相关的 IMU / prior /（可能的 camera 新块），调用 eliminatePose(pose_id)

5. 处理收尾：对仍未消元的 landmarks 和 pose（窗口内）可根据需求：
     - 保留到下一次前端循环
     - 或在结束时一次性 eliminate

6. backsubstitute / 更新估计（可选）
```

### 下一步建议

1. **实现时间序的驱动函数**  
   在 `json_to_hw_pipeline.cpp` 里新增 `runTemporalElimination(window_size)`，按上述顺序一句句调 `exporter.eliminateLandmark/pose`。可以保留现有 Landmarks→Poses 版本，通过命令行参数切换，方便对比。

2. **窗口内 Landmark 筛选**  
   需要一个快速判断“该 landmark 是否只连到已经排队消元的 pose”的逻辑。可以在导入观测时维护 `last_pose_id`（最大观测 pose）或剩余引用计数。

3. **（可选）处理 velocity/bias**  
   如果你准备引入速度/IMU bias 变量，可仿照 BLITZ 的 `x_i/v_i` 对：在 JSON 中或运行时生成对应输入，再按 “velocity → pose” 的顺序消元。

```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

#include "Camera.h"
#include "ORBSLAM3_Exporter.h"
#include "json_loader.h"

namespace {

struct PipelineOptions {
    std::string json_dir;
    std::string poses_path;
    std::string observations_path;
    std::string imu_edges_path;
    std::string priors_path;
    float huber_delta = 2.5f;
    bool run_elimination = true;
};

std::string JoinPath(const std::string& dir, const std::string& filename) {
    if (dir.empty()) {
        return filename;
    }
    if (dir.back() == '/' || dir.back() == '\\') {
        return dir + filename;
    }
    return dir + "/" + filename;
}

void PrintUsage(const char* prog_name) {
    std::cerr << "Usage: " << prog_name
              << " <json_directory> [--huber=2.5] [--no-elim]\n"
              << "  <json_directory> should contain poses.json / camera_observations.json / "
              << "imu_edges.json / priors.json\n"
              << "  --huber=VAL    Set the camera Huber delta (default 2.5)\n"
              << "  --no-elim      Load factors only, skip elimination\n";
}

PipelineOptions ParseArguments(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Missing json_directory argument");
    }

    PipelineOptions opts;
    opts.json_dir = argv[1];
    opts.poses_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "poses.json");
    opts.observations_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "camera_observations.json");
    opts.imu_edges_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "imu_edges.json");
    opts.priors_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "priors.json");

    for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i) {
        std::string arg = argv[i];
        if (arg.rfind("--huber=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.huber_delta = std::stof(arg.substr(8));
        } else if (arg == "--no-elim") {
            opts.run_elimination = false;
        } else {
            throw std::runtime_error("Unknown argument: " + arg);
        }
    }

    if (opts.huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Huber delta must be positive");
    }

    return opts;
}

template <typename Duration>
double ToMilliseconds(Duration d) {
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>>(d).count();
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    try {
        const auto opts = ParseArguments(argc, argv);

        const auto t0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        auto poses = JsonLoader::LoadPoses(opts.poses_path);
        auto observations = JsonLoader::LoadObservations(opts.observations_path);
        auto imu_edges = JsonLoader::LoadImuEdges(opts.imu_edges_path);
        auto priors = JsonLoader::LoadPriors(opts.priors_path);
        const auto t1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-LandmarkFirst] JSON loading completed\n"
                  << "  poses: " << poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  observations: " << observations.size() << "\n"
                  << "  imu_edges: " << imu_edges.size() << "\n"
                  << "  priors: " << priors.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t1 - t0) << " ms\n";

        VariableEliminationDriver driver;
        ORBSLAM3Exporter exporter(driver);

        std::unordered_set<int> initialized_landmarks;
        initialized_landmarks.reserve(observations.size());

        for (const auto& pose : poses) {
            driver.setPose(pose.pose_id, pose.Rcw, pose.tcw);
        }

        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            if (initialized_landmarks.insert(obs.landmark_id).second) {
                driver.setLandmark(obs.landmark_id, obs.landmark_w);
            }
        }

        exporter.addObservations(observations);
        exporter.addImuEdges(imu_edges);
        for (const auto& prior : priors) {
            exporter.addPrior(prior);
        }

        if (!opts.run_elimination) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-LandmarkFirst] Factors loaded (--no-elim).\n"
                      << "  pending landmarks: " << exporter.pendingLandmarkIds().size() << "\n"
                      << "  pending poses: " << exporter.pendingPoseIds().size() << "\n";
            return 0;
        }

        const auto t2 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        const std::size_t eliminated_landmarks =
            exporter.eliminateAllLandmarks(opts.huber_delta);
        const auto pose_ids = exporter.pendingPoseIds();
        const std::size_t eliminated_poses = exporter.eliminatePoses(pose_ids);
        const auto t3 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-LandmarkFirst] Elimination completed\n"
                  << "  eliminated landmarks: " << eliminated_landmarks << " / "
                  << initialized_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  eliminated poses: " << eliminated_poses << " / "
                  << pose_ids.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t3 - t2) << " ms\n"
                  << "  Reminder: VariableEliminationDriver still expects hardware handshakes.\n";

    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << "[Pipeline-LandmarkFirst][Error] " << e.what() << "\n";
        PrintUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}
```
