```cpp
/**
 * Variable-wise Elimination Driver Implementation
 * Implements the elimination sequence shown in your diagrams
 */
#include "VariableEliminationDriver.h"
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <cmath>

// Public accessor implementations
void VariableEliminationDriver::setPose(int pose_id, const Eigen::Matrix3f& R, const Eigen::Vector3f& t) {
    poses_R_[pose_id] = R;
    poses_t_[pose_id] = t;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::setLandmark(int landmark_id, const Eigen::Vector3f& pos) {
    landmarks_[landmark_id] = pos;
}

const Eigen::Matrix3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseRotation(int pose_id) const {
    return poses_R_.at(pose_id);
}

const Eigen::Vector3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseTranslation(int pose_id) const {
    return poses_t_.at(pose_id);
}

const Eigen::Vector3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getLandmark(int landmark_id) const {
    return landmarks_.at(landmark_id);
}

// Private helper implementations
void VariableEliminationDriver::wait_clock() { 
    /* hardware simulation */ 
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::wait_until(bool& signal) { 
    while(!signal) wait_clock(); 
}

Eigen::Matrix3f VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseRotationInternal(int pose_id) const {
    auto it = poses_R_.find(pose_id);
    if (it == poses_R_.end()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Pose rotation not found for pose_id: " + std::to_string(pose_id));
    }
    return it->second;
}

Eigen::Vector3f VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseTranslationInternal(int pose_id) const {
    auto it = poses_t_.find(pose_id);
    if (it == poses_t_.end()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Pose translation not found for pose_id: " + std::to_string(pose_id));
    }
    return it->second;
}

// eliminateLandmark implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::eliminateLandmark(
        int landmark_id,
        const std::vector<CameraObservation>& observations,
        float huber_delta
    ) {
        // Input validation
        if (observations.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("No observations provided for landmark " + std::to_string(landmark_id));
        }
        if (huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Huber delta must be positive");
        }
        
        // 1. Collect connected poses
        std::vector<int> connected_poses;
        std::map<int, int> pose_to_trail_slot;
        for (auto& obs : observations) {
            if (std::find(connected_poses.begin(), connected_poses.end(), obs.pose_id) == connected_poses.end()) {
                pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id] = connected_poses.size();
                connected_poses.push_back(obs.pose_id);
            }
        }
        
        int num_trails = connected_poses.size();
        int local_cols = 3 + 6 * num_trails;
        int local_rows = observations.size() * 2;
        
        // 2. Bundle begin
        axb_.bundle_begin = 1;
        axb_.bundle_panel_cols = 3;
        axb_.bundle_trails_count = num_trails;
        axb_.bundle_local_cols = local_cols;
        axb_.bundle_id = landmark_id;
        wait_clock();
        axb_.bundle_begin = 0;
        
        // 3. Feed each observation
        int local_row = 0;
        for (int k=0; k<observations.size(); k++) {
            auto& obs = observations[k];
            bool is_last = (k == observations.size() - 1);
            
            // Compute Pc and invZ
            Eigen::Vector3f Pc = obs.Rcw * obs.lw + obs.tcw;
            float Pc_z = Pc.z();
            if (std::abs(Pc_z) < 1e-6f) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Point behind camera or at infinity (Pc.z = " + std::to_string(Pc_z) + ")");
            }
            float invZ = 1.0f / Pc_z;
            
            // Compute residual for Huber weight (CPU side)
            Eigen::Vector2f z_pred;
            z_pred << obs.fx * Pc.x() * invZ + obs.cx,
                     obs.fy * Pc.y() * invZ + obs.cy;
            Eigen::Vector2f r = obs.pixel - z_pred;
            float sigma_pixel = obs.sigma_pixel;
            if (sigma_pixel <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid sigma_pixel: " + std::to_string(sigma_pixel));
            }
            Eigen::Vector2f r_hat = r / sigma_pixel;
            float rho = r_hat.norm();
            float w = (rho <= huber_delta) ? 1.0f : (huber_delta / rho);
            float alpha0 = w / sigma_pixel;
            float alpha1 = w / sigma_pixel;
            
            // Feed to Axb
            axb_.factor_valid = 1;
            axb_.factor_type = 0; // Camera
            axb_.local_col_panel = 0;  // landmark panel at local[0:2]
            axb_.local_col_trail = 3 + 6 * pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id]; // pose trail slot
            axb_.alpha[0] = alpha0;
            axb_.alpha[1] = alpha1;
            axb_.cam_fx = obs.fx;
            axb_.cam_fy = obs.fy;
            axb_.cam_cx = obs.cx;
            axb_.cam_cy = obs.cy;
            axb_.cam_z_u = obs.pixel.x();
            axb_.cam_z_v = obs.pixel.y();
            axb_.cam_Pc_X = Pc.x();
            axb_.cam_Pc_Y = Pc.y();
            axb_.cam_Pc_Z = Pc.z();
            axb_.cam_Pc_invZ = invZ;
            for (int i=0; i<3; i++)
                for (int j=0; j<3; j++)
                    axb_.cam_Rcw[i][j] = obs.Rcw(i,j);
            axb_.bundle_end = is_last ? 1 : 0;
            
            wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
            local_row += 2;
        }
        
        // 4. RowBuffer assembles local matrix and feeds systolicarray
        // (hardware automatic, CPU waits for completion)
        
        // 5. Collect new factor from RowBuffer
        wait_until(rowbuf_.new_factor_valid);
        
        // Extract R11 (3x3) and z1 (3) for backsubstitution
        BacksubEntry entry;
        entry.var_id = landmark_id;
        entry.is_landmark = true;
        entry.R11.resize(3, 3);
        entry.z1.resize(3);
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++)
                entry.R11(i,j) = rowbuf_.new_factor_R[i][j];
            entry.z1(i) = rowbuf_.new_factor_z[i];
        }
        backsub_stack_.push_back(entry);
        
        // Extract R22 and z2 (trailing blocks) as new factor connecting poses
        // Store to graph for next round elimination
        // (simplified: assume CPU maintains new factor list)
        
        rowbuf_.new_factor_ready = 1;
    }
    
// eliminatePose implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::eliminatePose(
        int pose_id,
        const std::vector<ImuConstraint>& imu_constraints,
        const std::vector<PriorConstraint>& prior_constraints
    ) {
        // 1. Collect connected poses via IMU
        std::vector<int> connected_poses;
        std::map<int, int> pose_to_trail_slot;
        
        for (auto& imu : imu_constraints) {
            int other_pose = (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id) ? imu.pose_j_id : imu.pose_i_id;
            if (std::find(connected_poses.begin(), connected_poses.end(), other_pose) 
                == connected_poses.end()) {
                pose_to_trail_slot[other_pose] = connected_poses.size();
                connected_poses.push_back(other_pose);
            }
        }
        
        int num_trails = connected_poses.size();
        int local_cols = 6 + 6 * num_trails;  // Panel(6) + Trails(6×N)
        
        // 2. Bundle begin
        axb_.bundle_begin = 1;
        axb_.bundle_panel_cols = 6;  // pose panel is 6 cols
        axb_.bundle_trails_count = num_trails;
        axb_.bundle_local_cols = local_cols;
        axb_.bundle_id = pose_id;
        wait_clock();
        axb_.bundle_begin = 0;
        
        // 3. Feed IMU factors
        for (size_t k=0; k<imu_constraints.size(); k++) {
            auto& imu = imu_constraints[k];
            bool is_last = (k == imu_constraints.size()-1) && prior_constraints.empty();
            
            uint8_t col_i = (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id) ? 0 : (6 + 6*pose_to_trail_slot[imu.pose_i_id]);
            uint8_t col_j = (imu.pose_j_id == pose_id) ? 0 : (6 + 6*pose_to_trail_slot[imu.pose_j_id]);
            
            sendImuFactor(imu, col_i, col_j, is_last);
        }
        
        // 4. Feed Prior factors (if any)
        for (size_t k=0; k<prior_constraints.size(); k++) {
            auto& prior = prior_constraints[k];
            bool is_last = (k == prior_constraints.size()-1);
            
            sendPriorFactor(prior, 0, is_last);  // pose_id is panel (col 0-5)
        }
        
        // 5. Collect QR result
        wait_until(rowbuf_.new_factor_valid);
        
        BacksubEntry entry;
        entry.var_id = pose_id;
        entry.is_landmark = false;  // pose is 6 cols
        entry.R11.resize(6, 6);
        entry.z1.resize(6);
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<6; j++)
                entry.R11(i,j) = rowbuf_.new_factor_R[i][j];
            entry.z1(i) = rowbuf_.new_factor_z[i];
        }
        backsub_stack_.push_back(entry);
        
        rowbuf_.new_factor_ready = 1;
    }
// sendImuFactor implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::sendImuFactor(
        const ImuConstraint& imu,
        uint8_t local_col_i,  // pose_i column in local matrix
        uint8_t local_col_j,  // pose_j column in local matrix
        bool is_last_in_bundle
    ) {
        // Get current pose estimates (with safety checks)
        Eigen::Matrix3f Ri = getPoseRotationInternal(imu.pose_i_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f ti = getPoseTranslationInternal(imu.pose_i_id);
        Eigen::Matrix3f Rj = getPoseRotationInternal(imu.pose_j_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f tj = getPoseTranslationInternal(imu.pose_j_id);
        
        // Set factor type
        axb_.factor_valid = 1;
        axb_.factor_type = 1; // IMU
        axb_.local_col_panel = local_col_i;  // pose_i is panel
        axb_.local_col_trail = local_col_j;  // pose_j is trail
        
        // Set whitening coefficients (from IMU covariance)
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            float sigma_val = imu.sigma(i);
            if (sigma_val <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid IMU sigma[" + std::to_string(i) + "] = " + std::to_string(sigma_val));
            }
            axb_.alpha[i] = 1.0f / sigma_val;  // sigma is stddev
        }
        
        // Set IMU payload (matching Axb.sv naming)
        // R0 = Ri, R1 = Rj, Rd = deltaR
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
                axb_.R0[i][j] = Ri(i,j);
                axb_.R1[i][j] = Rj(i,j);
                axb_.Rd[i][j] = imu.deltaR(i,j);
            }
            axb_.t0[i] = ti(i);
            axb_.t1[i] = tj(i);
            axb_.td[i] = imu.deltaT(i);
        }
        
        axb_.bundle_end = is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0;
        wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
        axb_.factor_valid = 0;
        axb_.bundle_end = 0;
    }
// sendPriorFactor implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::sendPriorFactor(
        const PriorConstraint& prior,
        uint8_t local_col_pose,  // pose column in local matrix
        bool is_last_in_bundle
    ) {
        // Get current pose estimate (with safety checks)
        Eigen::Matrix3f Ri = getPoseRotationInternal(prior.pose_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f ti = getPoseTranslationInternal(prior.pose_id);
        
        // Set factor type
        axb_.factor_valid = 1;
        axb_.factor_type = 2; // Prior
        axb_.local_col_panel = local_col_pose;  // pose is panel
        axb_.local_col_trail = 0;  // No trail for Prior (prior is observation, not variable)
        
        // Set whitening coefficients
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            float sigma_val = prior.sigma(i);
            if (sigma_val <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid Prior sigma[" + std::to_string(i) + "] = " + std::to_string(sigma_val));
            }
            axb_.alpha[i] = 1.0f / sigma_val;
        }
        
        // Set Prior payload
        // Ri = current estimate, Rp/tp = prior observation
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
                axb_.R0[i][j] = prior.Rp(i,j);  // Rp (prior rotation)
                axb_.R1[i][j] = Ri(i,j);         // Ri (current estimate)
            }
            axb_.t0[i] = prior.tp(i);  // tp (prior translation)
            axb_.t1[i] = ti(i);        // ti (current estimate)
        }
        
        axb_.bundle_end = is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0;
        wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
        axb_.factor_valid = 0;
        axb_.bundle_end = 0;
    }
    
// makeImuConstraint implementation
ImuConstraint VariableEliminationDriver::makeImuConstraint(
        int pose_i_id,
        int pose_j_id,
        const std::vector<ImuPreprocessorGTSAM::ImuMeasurement>& imu_segment,
        double dt_total
    ) {
        // Input validation
        if (imu_segment.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Empty IMU segment");
        }
        if (dt_total <= 0.0) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid dt_total: " + std::to_string(dt_total));
        }
        
        // Get current estimate for Ri (needed for g compensation)
        Eigen::Matrix3d Ri_d = getPoseRotationInternal(pose_i_id).cast<double>();
        
        // Call GTSAM preprocessor
        auto imu_output = imu_preprocessor_.getRelativePose(imu_segment, Ri_d, dt_total);
        
        // Convert to ImuConstraint
        ImuConstraint imu;
        imu.pose_i_id = pose_i_id;
        imu.pose_j_id = pose_j_id;
        imu.deltaR = imu_output.deltaR;
        imu.deltaT = imu_output.deltaT;
        imu.sigma = imu_output.sigma;
        
        return imu;
    }
// backsubstitute implementation
std::map<int, Eigen::VectorXf> VariableEliminationDriver::backsubstitute(const Eigen::VectorXf& x_final) {
        std::map<int, Eigen::VectorXf> solution;
        
        // Solve in reverse order
        for (auto it = backsub_stack_.rbegin(); it != backsub_stack_.rend(); ++it) {
            int dim = it->is_landmark ? 3 : 6;
            Eigen::VectorXf delta_var(dim);
            
            // R11 * delta_var = z1 - R12 * (already_solved_vars)
            // Simplified: assume R12 part handled by trail updates
            Eigen::FullPivLU<Eigen::MatrixXf> lu(it->R11);
            if (!lu.isInvertible()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("R11 matrix is singular for variable " + std::to_string(it->var_id));
            }
            delta_var = lu.solve(it->z1);
            solution[it->var_id] = delta_var;
        }
        
        return solution;
    }

// Helper: SO(3) exponential map (Rodriguez formula)
Eigen::Matrix3f so3Exp(const Eigen::Vector3f& omega) {
    float theta = omega.norm();
    if (theta < 1e-6) {
        return Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity();
    }
    
    Eigen::Vector3f axis = omega / theta;
    Eigen::Matrix3f K;
    K << 0, -axis(2), axis(1),
         axis(2), 0, -axis(0),
         -axis(1), axis(0), 0;
    
    return Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity() + 
           std::sin(theta) * K + 
           (1 - std::cos(theta)) * K * K;
}

std::vector<int> getAllPoseIds() {
    // Placeholder: return all pose IDs in order
    return {};
}

Eigen::VectorXf solveFinalDenseBlock() {
    // Placeholder: solve final dense Schur complement
    return Eigen::VectorXf::Zero(6);
}

/**
 * Complete elimination example with all three factor types
 */
void runCompleteExample() {
    VariableEliminationDriver driver;
    
    // === Setup initial estimates ===

/**
 * Main elimination loop (complete version)

void runVariableElimination(
    const std::vector<CameraObservation>& camera_obs,
    const std::vector<ImuConstraint>& imu_factors,
    const std::vector<PriorConstraint>& priors
) {
    VariableEliminationDriver driver;
    
    // Phase 1: Eliminate all landmarks
    std::set<int> unique_landmarks;
    for (auto& obs : camera_obs)
        unique_landmarks.insert(obs.landmark_id);
    
    for (int lm_id : unique_landmarks) {
        std::vector<CameraObservation> lm_obs;
        for (auto& obs : camera_obs)
            if (obs.landmark_id == lm_id)
                lm_obs.push_back(obs);
        
        driver.eliminateLandmark(lm_id, lm_obs);
    }
    
    // Phase 2: Eliminate old poses (keep last K poses for sliding window)
    const int WINDOW_SIZE = 10;
    std::vector<int> pose_ids = getAllPoseIds();
    
    for (size_t i=0; i<pose_ids.size()-WINDOW_SIZE; i++) {
        int pose_id = pose_ids[i];
        
        // Collect IMU factors related to this pose
        std::vector<ImuConstraint> related_imu;
        for (auto& imu : imu_factors) {
            if (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id || imu.pose_j_id == pose_id)
                related_imu.push_back(imu);
        }
        
        // Collect Prior factors (usually only pose_0)
        std::vector<PriorConstraint> related_prior;
        for (auto& prior : priors) {
            if (prior.pose_id == pose_id)
                related_prior.push_back(prior);
        }
        
        driver.eliminatePose(pose_id, related_imu, related_prior);
    }
    
    // Phase 3: Solve final dense block (last WINDOW_SIZE poses)
    // Using Cholesky or direct solver
    // ...
    
    // Phase 4: Backsubstitution
    Eigen::VectorXf final_x = solveFinalDenseBlock();
    // auto solution = driver.backsubstitute(final_x);
    
    // Phase 5: Update all variables
    // for (auto& [var_id, delta] : solution) {
```

这些耗时不是为了“证明硬件性能”，而是用来在纯软件环境里比较两条管线的消元策略差异：

- **数据加载耗时**：确认两个版本对 JSON 的解析、内存准备一致，说明后续对比是在同一输入条件下展开。
- **消元阶段耗时**：虽然现在还是 CPU 上的模拟，但它能体现不同顺序（BlitzCrank 滑窗 vs. Landmark-first）在“准备多少因子、维持多大工作集、处理顺序”上的成本差异。哪怕还没接上硬件，这个时间差也是选型的参考——例如滑窗策略可能更适合实时场景，因为它每次只处理窗口外的变量，从软件耗时你就能推测它在硬件上也会更接近 streaming 行为。

换句话说，当前耗时 = “纯软件模拟的执行时间”，作用是帮助你在硬件接入之前就看到两种策略在资源使用、处理批量上的不同，为后续决定“接硬件时用哪种顺序”提供依据。一旦硬件连通，再把这套计时换成真实寄存器计数，就能继续沿用同样的比较方法。

**User**

详细讲一下b的校园策略是什么

---

**Cursor**

BlitzCrank（`json_to_hw_pipeline`）的消元策略可以概括为“时间序列滑动窗口 + 局部前推”的三步循环：

1. **构建时间顺序和窗口**  
   - 先按时间排序所有 pose，设置一个窗口大小（默认 10）。  
   - `pose_sequence.size() - window` 之前的 pose 被认为“已经滑出窗口”，需要被消掉；窗口末尾的 pose（最后 10 帧）保留，等待后续新观测加入。

2. **逐步前推，先 Landmark 后 Pose**  
   - 对于每个滑出窗口的 pose `pose_i`：  
     a. 找出所有只连接到窗口外 pose 的 landmarks（通过 `landmarks_by_rank` 事先按最早观测 pose ID 排序），逐个调用 `exporter.eliminateLandmark()`。这些地标消完后，会生成新的“Pose-Pose”因子，只与剩余 pose 相连。  
     b. 再对 `pose_i` 执行 `exporter.eliminatePose()`：先送它关联的 IMU 因子，再送先验（若有），最终把 `pose_i` 从图中剔除，同时把新的约束传递给后续 pose。  
   - 每次循环只处理一个时间步的 landmarks + pose，因此工作集受窗口限制，适合实时或在线场景。

3. **窗口滚动，保留末尾状态**  
   - 当循环走完“窗口外”所有 pose 后，剩余 10 个 pose 以及它们关联的 ~358 个 landmarks 被保留，以便下一批数据进来时继续处理。  
   - 如果希望保留更长历史，可以通过 `--window=N` 调整窗口大小。

这种策略的核心特点：  
- **时间有序**：严格按照时间递增消元，模拟实际系统向前推进。  
- **局部工作集**：任何时刻只操作窗口外的一个 pose 及其相关 landmarks，内存和硬件带宽压力固定。  
- **可持续衔接**：窗口末尾保留的 pose 充当“状态接口”，方便下一次运行继续消元或接入控制器。

所以 BlitzCrank 版的“b 消元策略”就是：时间序列滑动窗口 → 每个时间步先消关联 landmarks、再消该 pose → 把新因子传给窗口中的 pose，保持系统实时推进。

**User**

不是有三个cost定义的消元的顺序吗Blitzcrank.pdf

---

**Cursor**

是的，BLITZCRANK 在论文里（Sec. III）确实定义了三类 cost，用来给 factor graph 的变量找一个“性价比最高”的消元顺序 [file://Blitzcrank.pdf]。它们的作用分别是：

1. **结构复杂度成本（Structure / Connectivity Cost）**  
   衡量当前节点与其邻接节点的关联度。连接越多、消元后会产生的填充项越多，cost 越高，意味着暂时不要动它，避免生成巨大 Schur 补。  
   - 对应我们的场景：若某个 pose 仍连接大量 landmark/IMU 因子，Blitzcrank-style pipeline 会先推迟它，保证局部带宽可控。

2. **资源占用成本（Resource / Memory Cost）**  
   估算把某个节点交给硬件阵列时需要多少面板列、trail 列以及 RowBuffer 资源。cost 越高越容易爆表，需要拖到后面或拆分成多步。  
   - 这就是为什么论文建议配合滑窗或分块策略，把一次处理的变量数量压缩到硬件能接受的范围。

3. **延迟/收益成本（Latency / Benefit Cost）**  
   代表“现在把它消掉能带来多大好处”的评分——比如立即解除后续约束、让轨迹前缀稳定下来等。Blitzcrank 最终选定的顺序（论文里称为 **Ours**）就是在这三个 cost 之间做权衡：优先消掉既能释放资源、又不会炸填充的变量。

我们现在实现的 `json_to_hw_pipeline`（BlitzCrank-style）本质就在模仿论文里的最终顺序：  
- 先根据结构成本把变量按时间与依赖程度排序；  
- 再结合资源成本设定滑动窗口（默认 10 pose），保证一次只送出窗口外的块；  
- 最后用“收益成本”决定先消掉窗口边缘的 landmarks，再消对应 pose，让后续的因子图保持稀疏。

如果你需要把这三类 cost 显式编码进我们的 pipeline（比如输出 cost 数值、或者在 CLI 中可调），可以在 `json_to_hw_b.cpp` 里新增一段权重公式，照着论文给的策略去组合即可。

当前准备实现 BLITZCRANK 论文里那套三成本（结构/资源/收益）驱动的消元顺序，具体思路如下，请先确认：

1. **命令行入口扩展**  
   - 新增 `--ordering=`（`sequential` / `cost`）和 `--cost-weights=ws,wr,wb` 两个可选参数，默认保持原有顺序（`sequential`）。  
   - 这样你可以显式切换到 cost-based 策略，或调整各成本权重。

2. **统计信息预处理**  
   - 解析 JSON 后，构建 `pose_rank`、`pose_sequence`，计算窗口阈值 `pose_limit = total - window`。  
   - 对每个 landmark：统计观测次数、唯一关联 pose 集合、最新观测 rank；对每个 pose：统计连接的 IMU 边数量、初始待处理 landmark 数。  
   - 只要 landmark 的最新观测 rank 落在 `pose_limit` 之前，就认定“可消”；同理，rank 在窗口之外的 pose 才进入候选集。

3. **成本计算与归一化**  
   - 按 BLITZCRANK 思路分别求出三种 raw cost：  
     - 结构：landmark 用观测/关联 pose 数，pose 用 IMU 度数；  
     - 资源：估算本地矩阵列数（landmark：`3+6*k`；pose：`6+6*k`）作为对硬件占用的 proxy；  
     - 收益：越靠前（rank 小）的变量收益越大 → 用 `urgency = (pose_limit-1 - rank)/range` 归一化。  
   - 将 raw 值归一化到 0~1，组合成 `score = ws*structure + wr*resource - wb*urgency`，得出最终排序权重。

4. **优先队列驱动的消元循环**  
   - 使用两个小根堆：一个放“可消的 landmark”（score 越小越先消），另一个放“满足 pending=0 的 pose”。  
   - 迭代过程：  
     1. 若当前没有 pose 可以消，就弹出下一个得分最低的 landmark，调用 `exporter.eliminateLandmark()`，并把该 landmark 关联 pose 的 `pending_landmarks` 计数减一；一旦某 pose 的计数降为 0，就压入 pose 堆。  
     2. 若 pose 堆非空，则取得分最低的 pose 执行 `exporter.eliminatePose()`。  
   - 整个循环直到 `pose_limit` 个 pose 全部消完；最终仍会保留窗口中的 pose/landmark，与原滑窗策略对齐。

5. **日志与兼容性**  
   - cost 模式下会额外输出各阶段的成本统计（例如多少 landmark/pose 由 cost 排序处理）。  
   - 若用户继续使用 `--ordering=sequential`，仍走旧逻辑，行为不变。

不是。BLITZCRANK 开源仓库里的 `planning_demo/` 只是一个 Python 版的轨迹规划 demo，用 GTSAM 构建因子图并交给 CPU 求解；它没有实现论文第 III 节的“成本驱动消元顺序”，也没有我们现在 `json_to_hw_pipeline` 这种滑窗 + Landmark/Pose 配对的调度逻辑。所以我们的 pipeline 是依据论文描述自己实现的，和他们公开的 demo 代码并不一样。

```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <queue>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

#include "VariableEliminationDriver.h"
#include "ORBSLAM3_Exporter.h"
#include "json_loader.h"

namespace {

struct PipelineOptions {
    std::string json_dir;
    std::string poses_path;
    std::string observations_path;
    std::string imu_edges_path;
    std::string priors_path;
    float huber_delta = 2.5f;
    bool run_elimination = true;
    std::size_t window_size = 10;
};

std::string JoinPath(const std::string& dir, const std::string& filename) {
    if (dir.empty()) {
        return filename;
    }
    if (dir.back() == '/' || dir.back() == '\\') {
        return dir + filename;
    }
    return dir + "/" + filename;
}

void PrintUsage(const char* prog_name) {
    std::cerr << "Usage: " << prog_name
              << " <json_directory> [--huber=2.5] [--window=10] [--no-elim]\n"
              << "  <json_directory> should contain poses.json / camera_observations.json / "
              << "imu_edges.json / priors.json\n"
              << "  --huber=VAL    Set the camera Huber delta (default 2.5)\n"
              << "  --window=N     Keep last N poses (default 10) instead of eliminating them\n"
              << "  --no-elim      Load factors only, skip elimination\n";
}

PipelineOptions ParseArguments(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Missing json_directory argument");
    }

    PipelineOptions opts;
    opts.json_dir = argv[1];
    opts.poses_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "poses.json");
    opts.observations_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "camera_observations.json");
    opts.imu_edges_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "imu_edges.json");
    opts.priors_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "priors.json");

    for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i) {
        std::string arg = argv[i];
        if (arg.rfind("--huber=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.huber_delta = std::stof(arg.substr(8));
        } else if (arg.rfind("--window=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.window_size = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::stoul(arg.substr(9)));
        } else if (arg == "--no-elim") {
            opts.run_elimination = false;
        } else {
            throw std::runtime_error("Unknown argument: " + arg);
        }
    }

    if (opts.huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Huber delta must be positive");
    }
    if (opts.window_size == 0) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Window size must be positive");
    }

    return opts;
}

template <typename Duration>
double ToMilliseconds(Duration d) {
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>>(d).count();
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    try {
        const auto opts = ParseArguments(argc, argv);

        const auto t0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        auto poses = JsonLoader::LoadPoses(opts.poses_path);
        auto observations = JsonLoader::LoadObservations(opts.observations_path);
        auto imu_edges = JsonLoader::LoadImuEdges(opts.imu_edges_path);
        auto priors = JsonLoader::LoadPriors(opts.priors_path);
        const auto t1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] JSON loading completed\n"
                  << "  poses: " << poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  observations: " << observations.size() << "\n"
                  << "  imu_edges: " << imu_edges.size() << "\n"
                  << "  priors: " << priors.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t1 - t0) << " ms\n";

        VariableEliminationDriver driver;
        ORBSLAM3Exporter exporter(driver);

        std::unordered_set<int> initialized_landmarks;
        initialized_landmarks.reserve(observations.size());

        for (const auto& pose : poses) {
            driver.setPose(pose.pose_id, pose.Rcw, pose.tcw);
        }

        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            if (initialized_landmarks.insert(obs.landmark_id).second) {
                driver.setLandmark(obs.landmark_id, obs.landmark_w);
            }
        }

        exporter.addObservations(observations);
        exporter.addImuEdges(imu_edges);
        for (const auto& prior : priors) {
            exporter.addPrior(prior);
        }

        if (!opts.run_elimination) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Factors loaded (--no-elim).\n"
                      << "  pending landmarks: " << exporter.pendingLandmarkIds().size() << "\n"
                      << "  pending poses: " << exporter.pendingPoseIds().size() << "\n";
            return 0;
        }

        // Sort poses by timestamp to obtain temporal order
        std::sort(poses.begin(), poses.end(),
                  [](const JsonLoader::PoseRecord& a, const JsonLoader::PoseRecord& b) {
                      if (a.timestamp == b.timestamp) {
                          return a.pose_id < b.pose_id;
                      }
                      return a.timestamp < b.timestamp;
                  });
        std::vector<int> pose_sequence;
        pose_sequence.reserve(poses.size());
        std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> pose_rank;
        pose_rank.reserve(poses.size());
        for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < poses.size(); ++idx) {
            pose_sequence.push_back(poses[idx].pose_id);
            pose_rank[poses[idx].pose_id] = idx;
        }

        // Pre-compute the latest pose rank that observes each landmark
        std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> landmark_max_rank;
        landmark_max_rank.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());
        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            const auto rank_it = pose_rank.find(obs.pose_id);
            if (rank_it == pose_rank.end()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Observation references unknown pose_id: " +
                                         std::to_string(obs.pose_id));
            }
            const std::size_t rank = rank_it->second;
            auto [it, inserted] = landmark_max_rank.emplace(obs.landmark_id, rank);
            if (!inserted && rank > it->second) {
                it->second = rank;
            }
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<int>> landmarks_by_rank(pose_sequence.size());
        for (const auto& kv : landmark_max_rank) {
            const int landmark_id = kv.first;
            const std::size_t rank = kv.second;
            landmarks_by_rank.at(rank).push_back(landmark_id);
        }

        const std::size_t pose_window =
            std::min<std::size_t>(opts.window_size, pose_sequence.size());
        if (pose_window == pose_sequence.size()) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Window size >= pose count; "
                      << "no pose will be eliminated. Use --window=<smaller value> if needed.\n";
        }

        const std::size_t cutoff =
            (pose_sequence.size() > pose_window) ? (pose_sequence.size() - pose_window) : 0;

        std::unordered_set<int> eliminated_landmarks_set;
        eliminated_landmarks_set.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());

        std::size_t eliminated_landmarks = 0;
        std::size_t eliminated_poses = 0;

        const auto t2 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < cutoff; ++idx) {
            if (idx < landmarks_by_rank.size()) {
                for (int lm_id : landmarks_by_rank[idx]) {
                    if (eliminated_landmarks_set.insert(lm_id).second) {
                        if (exporter.eliminateLandmark(lm_id, opts.huber_delta)) {
                            ++eliminated_landmarks;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            int pose_id = pose_sequence[idx];
            if (exporter.eliminatePose(pose_id)) {
                ++eliminated_poses;
            }
        }

        const auto t3 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        const auto pending_landmarks = exporter.pendingLandmarkIds();
        const auto pending_poses = exporter.pendingPoseIds();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Elimination completed\n"
                  << "  eliminated landmarks: " << eliminated_landmarks << " / "
                  << initialized_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  eliminated poses: " << eliminated_poses << " / "
                  << pose_sequence.size() - pose_window << "\n"
                  << "  remaining window size: " << pose_window << "\n"
                  << "  pending landmarks: " << pending_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  pending poses: " << pending_poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t3 - t2) << " ms\n"
                  << "  Reminder: VariableEliminationDriver still expects hardware handshakes.\n";

    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle][Error] " << e.what() << "\n";
        PrintUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
            const auto rank_it = pose_rank.find(obs.pose_id);
            if (rank_it == pose_rank.end()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Observation references unknown pose_id: " +
                                         std::to_string(obs.pose_id));
            }
            const std::size_t rank = rank_it->second;
            auto [it, inserted] = landmark_max_rank.emplace(obs.landmark_id, rank);
            if (!inserted && rank > it->second) {
                it->second = rank;
            }
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<int>> landmarks_by_rank(pose_sequence.size());
        for (const auto& kv : landmark_max_rank) {
            const int landmark_id = kv.first;
            const std::size_t rank = kv.second;
            landmarks_by_rank.at(rank).push_back(landmark_id);
        }

        const std::size_t pose_window =
            std::min<std::size_t>(opts.window_size, pose_sequence.size());
        if (pose_window == pose_sequence.size()) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Window size >= pose count; "
                      << "no pose will be eliminated. Use --window=<smaller value> if needed.\n";
        }

        const std::size_t cutoff =
            (pose_sequence.size() > pose_window) ? (pose_sequence.size() - pose_window) : 0;

        std::unordered_set<int> eliminated_landmarks_set;
        eliminated_landmarks_set.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());

        std::size_t eliminated_landmarks = 0;
        std::size_t eliminated_poses = 0;

        const auto t2 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < cutoff; ++idx) {
            if (idx < landmarks_by_rank.size()) {
                for (int lm_id : landmarks_by_rank[idx]) {
                    if (eliminated_landmarks_set.insert(lm_id).second) {
                        if (exporter.eliminateLandmark(lm_id, opts.huber_delta)) {
                            ++eliminated_landmarks;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            int pose_id = pose_sequence[idx];
            if (exporter.eliminatePose(pose_id)) {
                ++eliminated_poses;
            }
        }

        const auto t3 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        const auto pending_landmarks = exporter.pendingLandmarkIds();
        const auto pending_poses = exporter.pendingPoseIds();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Elimination completed\n"
                  << "  eliminated landmarks: " << eliminated_landmarks << " / "
                  << initialized_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  eliminated poses: " << eliminated_poses << " / "
                  << pose_sequence.size() - pose_window << "\n"
                  << "  remaining window size: " << pose_window << "\n"
                  << "  pending landmarks: " << pending_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  pending poses: " << pending_poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t3 - t2) << " ms\n"
                  << "  Reminder: VariableEliminationDriver still expects hardware handshakes.\n";

    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle][Error] " << e.what() << "\n";
        PrintUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
std::string JoinPath(const std::string& dir, const std::string& filename) {
    if (dir.empty()) {
        return filename;
    }
    if (dir.back() == '/' || dir.back() == '\\') {
        return dir + filename;
    }
    return dir + "/" + filename;
}

void PrintUsage(const char* prog_name) {
    std::cerr << "Usage: " << prog_name
              << " <json_directory> [--huber=2.5] [--window=10] [--no-elim]\n"
              << "  <json_directory> should contain poses.json / camera_observations.json / "
              << "imu_edges.json / priors.json\n"
              << "  --huber=VAL    Set the camera Huber delta (default 2.5)\n"
              << "  --window=N     Keep last N poses (default 10) instead of eliminating them\n"
              << "  --no-elim      Load factors only, skip elimination\n";
}

PipelineOptions ParseArguments(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Missing json_directory argument");
    }

    PipelineOptions opts;
    opts.json_dir = argv[1];
    opts.poses_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "poses.json");
    opts.observations_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "camera_observations.json");
    opts.imu_edges_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "imu_edges.json");
    opts.priors_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "priors.json");

    for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i) {
        std::string arg = argv[i];
        if (arg.rfind("--huber=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.huber_delta = std::stof(arg.substr(8));
        } else if (arg.rfind("--window=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.window_size = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::stoul(arg.substr(9)));
        } else if (arg == "--no-elim") {
            opts.run_elimination = false;
        } else {
            throw std::runtime_error("Unknown argument: " + arg);
        }
    }

    if (opts.huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Huber delta must be positive");
    }
    if (opts.window_size == 0) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Window size must be positive");
    }

    return opts;
}

template <typename Duration>
double ToMilliseconds(Duration d) {
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>>(d).count();
}
```

```cpp
double NormalizeValue(double value, double min_v, double max_v) {
    const double range = max_v - min_v;
    if (range < 1e-9) {
        return 0.0;
    }
    return (value - min_v) / range;
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    try {
        const auto opts = ParseArguments(argc, argv);

        const auto t0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        auto poses = JsonLoader::LoadPoses(opts.poses_path);
        auto observations = JsonLoader::LoadObservations(opts.observations_path);
        auto imu_edges = JsonLoader::LoadImuEdges(opts.imu_edges_path);
        auto priors = JsonLoader::LoadPriors(opts.priors_path);

        }

        exporter.addImuEdges(imu_edges);
        for (const auto& prior : priors) {

        }

            std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Factors loaded (--no-elim).\n"

                      << "  pending poses: " << exporter.pendingPoseIds().size() << "\n";
            return 0;
        }

                  [](const JsonLoader::PoseRecord& a, const JsonLoader::PoseRecord& b) {
                      if (a.timestamp == b.timestamp) {
                          return a.pose_id < b.pose_id;
                      }
                      return a.timestamp < b.timestamp;
                  });
        std::vector<int> pose_sequence;
        pose_sequence.reserve(poses.size());
        std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> pose_rank;
        pose_rank.reserve(poses.size());
        for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < poses.size(); ++idx) {
            pose_sequence.push_back(poses[idx].pose_id);
            pose_rank[poses[idx].pose_id] = idx;
        }

        // Pre-compute the latest pose rank that observes each landmark
        std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> landmark_max_rank;
        landmark_max_rank.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());
        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            const auto rank_it = pose_rank.find(obs.pose_id);
            if (rank_it == pose_rank.end()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Observation references unknown pose_id: " +
                                         std::to_string(obs.pose_id));
            }
            const std::size_t rank = rank_it->second;
            auto [it, inserted] = landmark_max_rank.emplace(obs.landmark_id, rank);
            if (!inserted && rank > it->second) {
                it->second = rank;
            }
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<int>> landmarks_by_rank(pose_sequence.size());
        for (const auto& kv : landmark_max_rank) {
            const int landmark_id = kv.first;
            const std::size_t rank = kv.second;
            landmarks_by_rank.at(rank).push_back(landmark_id);
        }

        const std::size_t pose_window =
            std::min<std::size_t>(opts.window_size, pose_sequence.size());
        if (pose_window == pose_sequence.size()) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Window size >= pose count; "
                      << "no pose will be eliminated. Use --window=<smaller value> if needed.\n";
        }

        const std::size_t cutoff =
            (pose_sequence.size() > pose_window) ? (pose_sequence.size() - pose_window) : 0;

        std::unordered_set<int> eliminated_landmarks_set;
        eliminated_landmarks_set.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());

        std::size_t eliminated_landmarks = 0;
        std::size_t eliminated_poses = 0;

        const auto t2 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < cutoff; ++idx) {
            if (idx < landmarks_by_rank.size()) {
                for (int lm_id : landmarks_by_rank[idx]) {

                ++eliminated_poses;

        const auto pending_poses = exporter.pendingPoseIds();

                  << pose_sequence.size() - pose_window << "\n"
                  << "  remaining window size: " << pose_window << "\n"
                  << "  pending landmarks: " << pending_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  pending poses: " << pending_poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t3 - t2) << " ms\n"
                  << "  Reminder: VariableEliminationDriver still expects hardware handshakes.\n";
```

```cpp
    opts.imu_edges_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "imu_edges.json");
    opts.priors_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "priors.json");

    for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i) {
        std::string arg = argv[i];
        if (arg.rfind("--huber=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.huber_delta = std::stof(arg.substr(8));
        } else if (arg.rfind("--window=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.window_size = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::stoul(arg.substr(9)));
```
```cpp
        } else if (arg.rfind("--ordering=", 0) == 0) {
            const std::string value = arg.substr(11);
            if (value == "sequential") {
                opts.ordering_mode = OrderingMode::kSequential;
            } else if (value == "cost") {
                opts.ordering_mode = OrderingMode::kCost;
            } else {
                throw std::runtime_error("Unknown ordering mode: " + value);
            }
        } else if (arg.rfind("--cost-weights=", 0) == 0) {
            const std::string weights_str = arg.substr(15);
            std::stringstream ss(weights_str);
            std::string token;
            std::vector<double> weights;
            while (std::getline(ss, token, ',')) {
                if (token.empty()) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Invalid --cost-weights format");
                }
                weights.push_back(std::stod(token));
            }
            if (weights.size() != 3) {
                throw std::runtime_error("--cost-weights requires three comma-separated numbers");
            }
            if (weights[0] < 0.0 || weights[1] < 0.0 || weights[2] < 0.0) {
                throw std::runtime_error("--cost-weights must be non-negative");
            }
            opts.cost_weights.structure = weights[0];
            opts.cost_weights.resource = weights[1];
            opts.cost_weights.benefit = weights[2];
        } else if (arg == "--no-elim") {
            opts.run_elimination = false;
        } else {
            throw std::runtime_error("Unknown argument: " + arg);
        }
    }

    if (opts.huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Huber delta must be positive");
    }
    if (opts.window_size == 0) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Window size must be positive");
    }

    return opts;
}

template <typename Duration>
double ToMilliseconds(Duration d) {
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>>(d).count();
}

double NormalizeValue(double value, double min_v, double max_v) {
    const double range = max_v - min_v;
    if (range < 1e-9) {
        return 0.0;
    }
    return (value - min_v) / range;
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    try {
        const auto opts = ParseArguments(argc, argv);

        const auto t0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        auto poses = JsonLoader::LoadPoses(opts.poses_path);
        auto observations = JsonLoader::LoadObservations(opts.observations_path);
        auto imu_edges = JsonLoader::LoadImuEdges(opts.imu_edges_path);
        auto priors = JsonLoader::LoadPriors(opts.priors_path);
        const auto t1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] JSON loading completed\n"
                  << "  poses: " << poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  observations: " << observations.size() << "\n"
                  << "  imu_edges: " << imu_edges.size() << "\n"
                  << "  priors: " << priors.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t1 - t0) << " ms\n";

        VariableEliminationDriver driver;
        ORBSLAM3Exporter exporter(driver);

        std::unordered_set<int> initialized_landmarks;
        initialized_landmarks.reserve(observations.size());

        for (const auto& pose : poses) {
            driver.setPose(pose.pose_id, pose.Rcw, pose.tcw);
        }

        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            if (initialized_landmarks.insert(obs.landmark_id).second) {
                driver.setLandmark(obs.landmark_id, obs.landmark_w);
            }
        }

        exporter.addObservations(observations);
        exporter.addImuEdges(imu_edges);
        for (const auto& prior : priors) {
            exporter.addPrior(prior);
        }

        if (!opts.run_elimination) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Factors loaded (--no-elim).\n"
                      << "  pending landmarks: " << exporter.pendingLandmarkIds().size() << "\n"
                      << "  pending poses: " << exporter.pendingPoseIds().size() << "\n";
            return 0;
        }

        // Sort poses by timestamp to obtain temporal order
        std::sort(poses.begin(), poses.end(),
                  [](const JsonLoader::PoseRecord& a, const JsonLoader::PoseRecord& b) {
                      if (a.timestamp == b.timestamp) {
                          return a.pose_id < b.pose_id;
                      }
                      return a.timestamp < b.timestamp;
                  });
        std::vector<int> pose_sequence;
        pose_sequence.reserve(poses.size());
        std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> pose_rank;
        pose_rank.reserve(poses.size());
        for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < poses.size(); ++idx) {
            pose_sequence.push_back(poses[idx].pose_id);
            pose_rank[poses[idx].pose_id] = idx;
        }

        // Pre-compute the latest pose rank that observes each landmark
        std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> landmark_max_rank;
        landmark_max_rank.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());
        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            const auto rank_it = pose_rank.find(obs.pose_id);
            if (rank_it == pose_rank.end()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Observation references unknown pose_id: " +
                                         std::to_string(obs.pose_id));
            }
            const std::size_t rank = rank_it->second;
            auto [it, inserted] = landmark_max_rank.emplace(obs.landmark_id, rank);
            if (!inserted && rank > it->second) {
                it->second = rank;
            }
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<int>> landmarks_by_rank(pose_sequence.size());
        for (const auto& kv : landmark_max_rank) {
            const int landmark_id = kv.first;
            const std::size_t rank = kv.second;
            landmarks_by_rank.at(rank).push_back(landmark_id);
        }

        const std::size_t pose_window =
            std::min<std::size_t>(opts.window_size, pose_sequence.size());
        if (pose_window == pose_sequence.size()) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Window size >= pose count; "
                      << "no pose will be eliminated. Use --window=<smaller value> if needed.\n";
        }

        const std::size_t cutoff =
            (pose_sequence.size() > pose_window) ? (pose_sequence.size() - pose_window) : 0;

        std::unordered_set<int> eliminated_landmarks_set;
        eliminated_landmarks_set.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());

        std::size_t eliminated_landmarks = 0;
        std::size_t eliminated_poses = 0;

        const auto t2 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < cutoff; ++idx) {
            if (idx < landmarks_by_rank.size()) {
                for (int lm_id : landmarks_by_rank[idx]) {
                    if (eliminated_landmarks_set.insert(lm_id).second) {
                        if (exporter.eliminateLandmark(lm_id, opts.huber_delta)) {
                            ++eliminated_landmarks;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            int pose_id = pose_sequence[idx];
            if (exporter.eliminatePose(pose_id)) {
                ++eliminated_poses;
            }
        }

        const auto t3 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        const auto pending_landmarks = exporter.pendingLandmarkIds();
        const auto pending_poses = exporter.pendingPoseIds();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Elimination completed\n"
                  << "  eliminated landmarks: " << eliminated_landmarks << " / "
                  << initialized_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  eliminated poses: " << eliminated_poses << " / "
                  << pose_sequence.size() - pose_window << "\n"
                  << "  remaining window size: " << pose_window << "\n"
                  << "  pending landmarks: " << pending_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  pending poses: " << pending_poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t3 - t2) << " ms\n"
                  << "  Reminder: VariableEliminationDriver still expects hardware handshakes.\n";

    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle][Error] " << e.what() << "\n";
        PrintUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <iostream>

#include <unordered_set>
```
