```cpp
#include "VariableEliminationDriver.h"
#include "ORBSLAM3_Exporter.h"
#include "json_loader.h"

enum class OrderingMode {
    kSequential,
    kCost
};

struct CostWeights {
    double structure = 1.0;
    double resource = 1.0;
    double benefit = 1.0;
};

namespace {

struct PipelineOptions {
    std::string json_dir;
    std::string poses_path;
    std::string observations_path;
    std::string imu_edges_path;
    std::string priors_path;
    float huber_delta = 2.5f;
    bool run_elimination = true;
    std::size_t window_size = 10;
    OrderingMode ordering_mode = OrderingMode::kSequential;
    CostWeights cost_weights;
};

std::string JoinPath(const std::string& dir, const std::string& filename) {
    if (dir.empty()) {
        return filename;
    }
    if (dir.back() == '/' || dir.back() == '\\') {
        return dir + filename;
    }
    return dir + "/" + filename;
}

void PrintUsage(const char* prog_name) {
    std::cerr << "Usage: " << prog_name
              << " <json_directory> [--huber=2.5] [--window=10] [--ordering=sequential|cost]\n"
              << "       [--cost-weights=ws,wr,wb] [--no-elim]\n"
              << "  <json_directory> should contain poses.json / camera_observations.json / "
              << "imu_edges.json / priors.json\n"
              << "  --huber=VAL    Set the camera Huber delta (default 2.5)\n"
              << "  --window=N     Keep last N poses (default 10) instead of eliminating them\n"
              << "  --ordering=MODE   Choose elimination order (sequential or cost, default sequential)\n"
              << "  --cost-weights=a,b,c   Weights for structure/resource/benefit costs (default 1,1,1)\n"
              << "  --no-elim      Load factors only, skip elimination\n";
}

PipelineOptions ParseArguments(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Missing json_directory argument");
    }

    PipelineOptions opts;
    opts.json_dir = argv[1];
    opts.poses_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "poses.json");
    opts.observations_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "camera_observations.json");
    opts.imu_edges_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "imu_edges.json");
    opts.priors_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "priors.json");

    for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i) {
        std::string arg = argv[i];
        if (arg.rfind("--huber=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.huber_delta = std::stof(arg.substr(8));
        } else if (arg.rfind("--window=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.window_size = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::stoul(arg.substr(9)));
        } else if (arg.rfind("--ordering=", 0) == 0) {
            const std::string value = arg.substr(11);
            if (value == "sequential") {
                opts.ordering_mode = OrderingMode::kSequential;
            } else if (value == "cost") {
                opts.ordering_mode = OrderingMode::kCost;
            } else {
                throw std::runtime_error("Unknown ordering mode: " + value);
            }
        } else if (arg.rfind("--cost-weights=", 0) == 0) {
            const std::string weights_str = arg.substr(15);
            std::stringstream ss(weights_str);
            std::string token;
            std::vector<double> weights;
            while (std::getline(ss, token, ',')) {
                if (token.empty()) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Invalid --cost-weights format");
                }
                weights.push_back(std::stod(token));
            }
            if (weights.size() != 3) {
                throw std::runtime_error("--cost-weights requires three comma-separated numbers");
            }
            if (weights[0] < 0.0 || weights[1] < 0.0 || weights[2] < 0.0) {
                throw std::runtime_error("--cost-weights must be non-negative");
            }
            opts.cost_weights.structure = weights[0];
            opts.cost_weights.resource = weights[1];
            opts.cost_weights.benefit = weights[2];
        } else if (arg == "--no-elim") {
            opts.run_elimination = false;
        } else {
            throw std::runtime_error("Unknown argument: " + arg);
        }
    }

    if (opts.huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Huber delta must be positive");
    }
    if (opts.window_size == 0) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Window size must be positive");
    }

    return opts;
}

template <typename Duration>
double ToMilliseconds(Duration d) {
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>>(d).count();
}

double NormalizeValue(double value, double min_v, double max_v) {
    const double range = max_v - min_v;
    if (range < 1e-9) {
        return 0.0;
    }
    return (value - min_v) / range;
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    try {
        const auto opts = ParseArguments(argc, argv);

        const auto t0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        auto poses = JsonLoader::LoadPoses(opts.poses_path);
        auto observations = JsonLoader::LoadObservations(opts.observations_path);
        auto imu_edges = JsonLoader::LoadImuEdges(opts.imu_edges_path);
        auto priors = JsonLoader::LoadPriors(opts.priors_path);
        const auto t1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] JSON loading completed\n"
                  << "  poses: " << poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  observations: " << observations.size() << "\n"
                  << "  imu_edges: " << imu_edges.size() << "\n"
                  << "  priors: " << priors.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t1 - t0) << " ms\n";

        VariableEliminationDriver driver;
        ORBSLAM3Exporter exporter(driver);

        std::unordered_set<int> initialized_landmarks;
        initialized_landmarks.reserve(observations.size());

        for (const auto& pose : poses) {
            driver.setPose(pose.pose_id, pose.Rcw, pose.tcw);
        }

        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            if (initialized_landmarks.insert(obs.landmark_id).second) {
                driver.setLandmark(obs.landmark_id, obs.landmark_w);
            }
        }

        exporter.addObservations(observations);
        exporter.addImuEdges(imu_edges);
        for (const auto& prior : priors) {
            exporter.addPrior(prior);
        }

        if (!opts.run_elimination) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Factors loaded (--no-elim).\n"
                      << "  pending landmarks: " << exporter.pendingLandmarkIds().size() << "\n"
                      << "  pending poses: " << exporter.pendingPoseIds().size() << "\n";
            return 0;
        }

        // Sort poses by timestamp to obtain temporal order
        std::sort(poses.begin(), poses.end(),
                  [](const JsonLoader::PoseRecord& a, const JsonLoader::PoseRecord& b) {
                      if (a.timestamp == b.timestamp) {
                          return a.pose_id < b.pose_id;
                      }
                      return a.timestamp < b.timestamp;
                  });
        std::vector<int> pose_sequence;
        pose_sequence.reserve(poses.size());
        std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> pose_rank;
        pose_rank.reserve(poses.size());
        for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < poses.size(); ++idx) {
            pose_sequence.push_back(poses[idx].pose_id);
            pose_rank[poses[idx].pose_id] = idx;
        }

        // Pre-compute the latest pose rank that observes each landmark
        std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> landmark_max_rank;
        landmark_max_rank.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());
        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            const auto rank_it = pose_rank.find(obs.pose_id);
            if (rank_it == pose_rank.end()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Observation references unknown pose_id: " +
                                         std::to_string(obs.pose_id));
            }
            const std::size_t rank = rank_it->second;
            auto [it, inserted] = landmark_max_rank.emplace(obs.landmark_id, rank);
            if (!inserted && rank > it->second) {
                it->second = rank;
            }
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<int>> landmarks_by_rank(pose_sequence.size());
        for (const auto& kv : landmark_max_rank) {
            const int landmark_id = kv.first;
            const std::size_t rank = kv.second;
            landmarks_by_rank.at(rank).push_back(landmark_id);
        }

        const std::size_t pose_window =
            std::min<std::size_t>(opts.window_size, pose_sequence.size());
        if (pose_window == pose_sequence.size()) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Window size >= pose count; "
                      << "no pose will be eliminated. Use --window=<smaller value> if needed.\n";
        }

        const std::size_t cutoff =
            (pose_sequence.size() > pose_window) ? (pose_sequence.size() - pose_window) : 0;

        std::size_t eliminated_landmarks = 0;
        std::size_t eliminated_poses = 0;

        const auto t2 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        if (opts.ordering_mode == OrderingMode::kSequential) {
            std::unordered_set<int> eliminated_landmarks_set;
            eliminated_landmarks_set.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());

            for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < cutoff; ++idx) {
                if (idx < landmarks_by_rank.size()) {
                    for (int lm_id : landmarks_by_rank[idx]) {
                        if (eliminated_landmarks_set.insert(lm_id).second) {
                            if (exporter.eliminateLandmark(lm_id, opts.huber_delta)) {
                                ++eliminated_landmarks;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                int pose_id = pose_sequence[idx];
                if (exporter.eliminatePose(pose_id)) {
                    ++eliminated_poses;
                }
            }
        } else {
            struct LandmarkAccum {
                std::size_t obs_count = 0;
                std::size_t latest_rank = 0;
                std::unordered_set<int> pose_ids;
            };

            std::unordered_map<int, LandmarkAccum> landmark_stats;
            landmark_stats.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());
            for (const auto& obs : observations) {
                auto& acc = landmark_stats[obs.landmark_id];
                acc.obs_count++;
                acc.pose_ids.insert(obs.pose_id);
                const std::size_t rank = pose_rank.at(obs.pose_id);
                if (acc.obs_count == 1 || rank > acc.latest_rank) {
                    acc.latest_rank = rank;
                }
            }

            struct LandmarkTempData {
                int landmark_id;
                std::size_t latest_rank;
                double structure_raw;
                double resource_raw;
                double benefit_raw;
                int anchor_pose_id;
            };

            std::vector<LandmarkTempData> ready_landmarks;
            ready_landmarks.reserve(landmark_stats.size());

            auto init_min = []() { return std::numeric_limits<double>::max(); };
            auto init_max = []() { return std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest(); };
            auto update_range = [](double value, double& min_v, double& max_v) {
                if (value < min_v) {
                    min_v = value;
                }
                if (value > max_v) {
                    max_v = value;
                }
            };

            double lm_struct_min = init_min();
            double lm_struct_max = init_max();
            double lm_resource_min = init_min();
            double lm_resource_max = init_max();
            double lm_benefit_min = init_min();
            double lm_benefit_max = init_max();

            std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> pose_pending_landmarks;

            for (const auto& kv : landmark_stats) {
                const auto& acc = kv.second;
                if (acc.latest_rank >= cutoff) {
                    continue;
                }
                LandmarkTempData temp;
                temp.landmark_id = kv.first;
                temp.latest_rank = acc.latest_rank;
                const double unique_pose_count = static_cast<double>(acc.pose_ids.size());
                temp.structure_raw = unique_pose_count;
                temp.resource_raw = 3.0 + 6.0 * unique_pose_count;
                if (cutoff > 0) {
                    temp.benefit_raw =
                        std::max(0.0, static_cast<double>(cutoff - 1) - static_cast<double>(temp.latest_rank));
                } else {
                    temp.benefit_raw = 0.0;
                }
                temp.anchor_pose_id = pose_sequence.at(temp.latest_rank);
                ready_landmarks.push_back(temp);

                update_range(temp.structure_raw, lm_struct_min, lm_struct_max);
                update_range(temp.resource_raw, lm_resource_min, lm_resource_max);
                update_range(temp.benefit_raw, lm_benefit_min, lm_benefit_max);
                pose_pending_landmarks[temp.anchor_pose_id]++;
            }

            if (ready_landmarks.empty()) {
                lm_struct_min = lm_struct_max = 0.0;
                lm_resource_min = lm_resource_max = 0.0;
                lm_benefit_min = lm_benefit_max = 0.0;
            } else {
                if (lm_struct_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    lm_struct_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (lm_struct_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    lm_struct_max = lm_struct_min;
                }
                if (lm_resource_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    lm_resource_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (lm_resource_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    lm_resource_max = lm_resource_min;
                }
                if (lm_benefit_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    lm_benefit_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (lm_benefit_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    lm_benefit_max = lm_benefit_min;
                }
            }

            struct LandmarkCostInfo {
                double score = 0.0;
                std::size_t latest_rank = 0;
                int anchor_pose_id = -1;
                bool eliminated = false;
            };
            std::unordered_map<int, LandmarkCostInfo> landmark_costs;
            landmark_costs.reserve(ready_landmarks.size());

            struct LandmarkHeapEntry {
                double score;
                int landmark_id;
            };
            auto landmark_cmp = [](const LandmarkHeapEntry& a, const LandmarkHeapEntry& b) {
                if (a.score == b.score) {
                    return a.landmark_id > b.landmark_id;
                }
                return a.score > b.score;
            };
            std::priority_queue<LandmarkHeapEntry, std::vector<LandmarkHeapEntry>, decltype(landmark_cmp)>
                landmark_heap(landmark_cmp);

            for (const auto& temp : ready_landmarks) {
                const double structure_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.structure_raw, lm_struct_min, lm_struct_max);
                const double resource_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.resource_raw, lm_resource_min, lm_resource_max);
                const double benefit_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.benefit_raw, lm_benefit_min, lm_benefit_max);
                const double score = opts.cost_weights.structure * structure_norm +
                                     opts.cost_weights.resource * resource_norm -
                                     opts.cost_weights.benefit * benefit_norm;
                LandmarkCostInfo info;
                info.score = score;
                info.latest_rank = temp.latest_rank;
                info.anchor_pose_id = temp.anchor_pose_id;
                landmark_costs.emplace(temp.landmark_id, info);
                landmark_heap.push({score, temp.landmark_id});
            }

            struct PoseTempData {
                int pose_id = -1;
                std::size_t rank = 0;
                std::size_t imu_degree = 0;
                std::unordered_set<int> imu_neighbors;
                std::size_t pending_landmarks = 0;
            };
            std::unordered_map<int, PoseTempData> pose_stats;
            pose_stats.reserve(pose_sequence.size());
            for (const auto& pose : poses) {
                PoseTempData data;
                data.pose_id = pose.pose_id;
                data.rank = pose_rank.at(pose.pose_id);
                pose_stats[pose.pose_id] = data;
            }

            for (const auto& kv : pose_pending_landmarks) {
                pose_stats[kv.first].pending_landmarks = kv.second;
            }

            for (const auto& edge : imu_edges) {
                auto& pose_i = pose_stats[edge.pose_i_id];
                auto& pose_j = pose_stats[edge.pose_j_id];
                pose_i.imu_degree++;
                pose_j.imu_degree++;
                pose_i.imu_neighbors.insert(edge.pose_j_id);
                pose_j.imu_neighbors.insert(edge.pose_i_id);
            }

            struct PoseCostInfo {
                double score = 0.0;
                std::size_t rank = 0;
                std::size_t pending_landmarks = 0;
                bool eliminated = false;
                bool enqueued = false;
            };

            struct PoseCostTemp {
                int pose_id;
                std::size_t rank;
                double structure_raw;
                double resource_raw;
                double benefit_raw;
                std::size_t pending_landmarks;
            };

            std::vector<PoseCostTemp> pose_candidates;
            pose_candidates.reserve(pose_stats.size());

            double pose_struct_min = init_min();
            double pose_struct_max = init_max();
            double pose_resource_min = init_min();
            double pose_resource_max = init_max();
            double pose_benefit_min = init_min();
            double pose_benefit_max = init_max();

            for (const auto& kv : pose_stats) {
                const auto& data = kv.second;
                if (data.rank >= cutoff) {
                    continue;
                }
                PoseCostTemp temp;
                temp.pose_id = data.pose_id;
                temp.rank = data.rank;
                temp.pending_landmarks = data.pending_landmarks;
                temp.structure_raw =
                    static_cast<double>(data.imu_degree) + static_cast<double>(data.pending_landmarks);
                temp.resource_raw = 6.0 + 6.0 * static_cast<double>(data.imu_neighbors.size());
                if (cutoff > 0) {
                    temp.benefit_raw =
                        std::max(0.0, static_cast<double>(cutoff - 1) - static_cast<double>(data.rank));
                } else {
                    temp.benefit_raw = 0.0;
                }
                pose_candidates.push_back(temp);
                update_range(temp.structure_raw, pose_struct_min, pose_struct_max);
                update_range(temp.resource_raw, pose_resource_min, pose_resource_max);
                update_range(temp.benefit_raw, pose_benefit_min, pose_benefit_max);
            }

            if (pose_candidates.empty()) {
                pose_struct_min = pose_struct_max = 0.0;
                pose_resource_min = pose_resource_max = 0.0;
                pose_benefit_min = pose_benefit_max = 0.0;
            } else {
                if (pose_struct_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    pose_struct_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (pose_struct_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    pose_struct_max = pose_struct_min;
                }
                if (pose_resource_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    pose_resource_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (pose_resource_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    pose_resource_max = pose_resource_min;
                }
                if (pose_benefit_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    pose_benefit_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (pose_benefit_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    pose_benefit_max = pose_benefit_min;
                }
            }

            std::unordered_map<int, PoseCostInfo> pose_costs;
            pose_costs.reserve(pose_candidates.size());

            struct PoseHeapEntry {
                double score;
                int pose_id;
            };
            auto pose_cmp = [](const PoseHeapEntry& a, const PoseHeapEntry& b) {
                if (a.score == b.score) {
                    return a.pose_id > b.pose_id;
                }
                return a.score > b.score;
            };
            std::priority_queue<PoseHeapEntry, std::vector<PoseHeapEntry>, decltype(pose_cmp)> pose_heap(pose_cmp);

            for (const auto& temp : pose_candidates) {
                const double structure_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.structure_raw, pose_struct_min, pose_struct_max);
                const double resource_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.resource_raw, pose_resource_min, pose_resource_max);
                const double benefit_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.benefit_raw, pose_benefit_min, pose_benefit_max);
                const double score = opts.cost_weights.structure * structure_norm +
                                     opts.cost_weights.resource * resource_norm -
                                     opts.cost_weights.benefit * benefit_norm;
                PoseCostInfo info;
                info.score = score;
                info.rank = temp.rank;
                info.pending_landmarks = temp.pending_landmarks;
                pose_costs.emplace(temp.pose_id, info);
            }

            for (auto& kv : pose_costs) {
                if (kv.second.pending_landmarks == 0) {
                    kv.second.enqueued = true;
                    pose_heap.push({kv.second.score, kv.first});
                }
            }

            auto peek_landmark = [&]() -> std::optional<LandmarkHeapEntry> {
                while (!landmark_heap.empty()) {
                    const auto entry = landmark_heap.top();
                    const auto it = landmark_costs.find(entry.landmark_id);
                    if (it == landmark_costs.end() || it->second.eliminated) {
                        landmark_heap.pop();
                        continue;
                    }
                    return entry;
                }
                return std::nullopt;
            };

            auto peek_pose = [&]() -> std::optional<PoseHeapEntry> {
                while (!pose_heap.empty()) {
                    const auto entry = pose_heap.top();
                    const auto it = pose_costs.find(entry.pose_id);
                    if (it == pose_costs.end() || it->second.eliminated) {
                        pose_heap.pop();
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (it->second.pending_landmarks > 0) {
                        pose_heap.pop();
                        continue;
                    }
                    return entry;
                }
                return std::nullopt;
            };

            while (eliminated_poses < cutoff) {
                const auto lm_entry = peek_landmark();
                const auto pose_entry = peek_pose();
                const bool can_landmark = lm_entry.has_value();
                const bool can_pose = pose_entry.has_value();

                if (!can_landmark && !can_pose) {
                    break;
                }

                const bool choose_landmark =
                    can_landmark && (!can_pose || lm_entry->score <= pose_entry->score);

                if (choose_landmark) {
                    auto entry = landmark_heap.top();
                    landmark_heap.pop();
                    auto& info = landmark_costs.at(entry.landmark_id);
                    if (info.eliminated) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (exporter.eliminateLandmark(entry.landmark_id, opts.huber_delta)) {
                        ++eliminated_landmarks;
                    }
                    info.eliminated = true;
                    auto pose_it = pose_costs.find(info.anchor_pose_id);
                    if (pose_it != pose_costs.end() && pose_it->second.rank < cutoff) {
                        if (pose_it->second.pending_landmarks > 0) {
                            --pose_it->second.pending_landmarks;
                            if (pose_it->second.pending_landmarks == 0 && !pose_it->second.eliminated) {
                                if (!pose_it->second.enqueued) {
                                    pose_it->second.enqueued = true;
                                    pose_heap.push({pose_it->second.score, pose_it->first});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else if (can_pose) {
                    auto entry = pose_heap.top();
                    pose_heap.pop();
                    auto& info = pose_costs.at(entry.pose_id);
                    if (info.eliminated || info.pending_landmarks > 0) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (exporter.eliminatePose(entry.pose_id)) {
                        ++eliminated_poses;
                    }
                    info.eliminated = true;
                }
            }
        }

        const auto t3 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        const auto pending_landmarks = exporter.pendingLandmarkIds();
        const auto pending_poses = exporter.pendingPoseIds();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Elimination completed (ordering="
                  << (opts.ordering_mode == OrderingMode::kCost ? "cost" : "sequential") << ")\n"
                  << "  eliminated landmarks: " << eliminated_landmarks << " / "
                  << initialized_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  eliminated poses: " << eliminated_poses << " / "
                  << pose_sequence.size() - pose_window << "\n"
                  << "  remaining window size: " << pose_window << "\n"
                  << "  pending landmarks: " << pending_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  pending poses: " << pending_poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t3 - t2) << " ms\n"
                  << "  Reminder: VariableEliminationDriver still expects hardware handshakes.\n";

    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle][Error] " << e.what() << "\n";
        PrintUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}

```

```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <optional>
#include <queue>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

#include "VariableEliminationDriver.h"
#include "ORBSLAM3_Exporter.h"
#include "json_loader.h"

enum class OrderingMode {
    kSequential,
    kCost
};

struct CostWeights {
    double structure = 1.0;
    double resource = 1.0;
    double benefit = 1.0;
};

namespace {

struct PipelineOptions {
    std::string json_dir;
    std::string poses_path;
    std::string observations_path;
    std::string imu_edges_path;
    std::string priors_path;
    float huber_delta = 2.5f;
    bool run_elimination = true;
    std::size_t window_size = 10;
    OrderingMode ordering_mode = OrderingMode::kSequential;
    CostWeights cost_weights;
};

std::string JoinPath(const std::string& dir, const std::string& filename) {
    if (dir.empty()) {
        return filename;
    }
    if (dir.back() == '/' || dir.back() == '\\') {
        return dir + filename;
    }
    return dir + "/" + filename;
}

void PrintUsage(const char* prog_name) {
    std::cerr << "Usage: " << prog_name
              << " <json_directory> [--huber=2.5] [--window=10] [--ordering=sequential|cost]\n"
              << "       [--cost-weights=ws,wr,wb] [--no-elim]\n"
              << "  <json_directory> should contain poses.json / camera_observations.json / "
              << "imu_edges.json / priors.json\n"
              << "  --huber=VAL    Set the camera Huber delta (default 2.5)\n"
              << "  --window=N     Keep last N poses (default 10) instead of eliminating them\n"
              << "  --ordering=MODE   Choose elimination order (sequential or cost, default sequential)\n"
              << "  --cost-weights=a,b,c   Weights for structure/resource/benefit costs (default 1,1,1)\n"
              << "  --no-elim      Load factors only, skip elimination\n";
}

PipelineOptions ParseArguments(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Missing json_directory argument");
    }

    PipelineOptions opts;
    opts.json_dir = argv[1];
    opts.poses_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "poses.json");
    opts.observations_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "camera_observations.json");
    opts.imu_edges_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "imu_edges.json");
    opts.priors_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "priors.json");

    for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i) {
        std::string arg = argv[i];
        if (arg.rfind("--huber=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.huber_delta = std::stof(arg.substr(8));
        } else if (arg.rfind("--window=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.window_size = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::stoul(arg.substr(9)));
        } else if (arg.rfind("--ordering=", 0) == 0) {
            const std::string value = arg.substr(11);
            if (value == "sequential") {
                opts.ordering_mode = OrderingMode::kSequential;
            } else if (value == "cost") {
                opts.ordering_mode = OrderingMode::kCost;
            } else {
                throw std::runtime_error("Unknown ordering mode: " + value);
            }
        } else if (arg.rfind("--cost-weights=", 0) == 0) {
            const std::string weights_str = arg.substr(15);
            std::stringstream ss(weights_str);
            std::string token;
            std::vector<double> weights;
            while (std::getline(ss, token, ',')) {
                if (token.empty()) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Invalid --cost-weights format");
                }
                weights.push_back(std::stod(token));
            }
            if (weights.size() != 3) {
                throw std::runtime_error("--cost-weights requires three comma-separated numbers");
            }
            if (weights[0] < 0.0 || weights[1] < 0.0 || weights[2] < 0.0) {
                throw std::runtime_error("--cost-weights must be non-negative");
            }
            opts.cost_weights.structure = weights[0];
            opts.cost_weights.resource = weights[1];
            opts.cost_weights.benefit = weights[2];
        } else if (arg == "--no-elim") {
            opts.run_elimination = false;
        } else {
            throw std::runtime_error("Unknown argument: " + arg);
        }
    }

    if (opts.huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Huber delta must be positive");
    }
    if (opts.window_size == 0) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Window size must be positive");
    }

    return opts;
}

template <typename Duration>
double ToMilliseconds(Duration d) {
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>>(d).count();
}

double NormalizeValue(double value, double min_v, double max_v) {
    const double range = max_v - min_v;
    if (range < 1e-9) {
        return 0.0;
    }
    return (value - min_v) / range;
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    try {
        const auto opts = ParseArguments(argc, argv);

        const auto t0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        auto poses = JsonLoader::LoadPoses(opts.poses_path);
        auto observations = JsonLoader::LoadObservations(opts.observations_path);
        auto imu_edges = JsonLoader::LoadImuEdges(opts.imu_edges_path);
        auto priors = JsonLoader::LoadPriors(opts.priors_path);
        const auto t1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] JSON loading completed\n"
                  << "  poses: " << poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  observations: " << observations.size() << "\n"
                  << "  imu_edges: " << imu_edges.size() << "\n"
                  << "  priors: " << priors.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t1 - t0) << " ms\n";

        VariableEliminationDriver driver;
        ORBSLAM3Exporter exporter(driver);

        std::unordered_set<int> initialized_landmarks;
        initialized_landmarks.reserve(observations.size());

        for (const auto& pose : poses) {
            driver.setPose(pose.pose_id, pose.Rcw, pose.tcw);
        }

        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            if (initialized_landmarks.insert(obs.landmark_id).second) {
                driver.setLandmark(obs.landmark_id, obs.landmark_w);
            }
        }

        exporter.addObservations(observations);
        exporter.addImuEdges(imu_edges);
        for (const auto& prior : priors) {
            exporter.addPrior(prior);
        }

        if (!opts.run_elimination) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Factors loaded (--no-elim).\n"
                      << "  pending landmarks: " << exporter.pendingLandmarkIds().size() << "\n"
                      << "  pending poses: " << exporter.pendingPoseIds().size() << "\n";
            return 0;
        }

        // Sort poses by timestamp to obtain temporal order
        std::sort(poses.begin(), poses.end(),
                  [](const JsonLoader::PoseRecord& a, const JsonLoader::PoseRecord& b) {
                      if (a.timestamp == b.timestamp) {
                          return a.pose_id < b.pose_id;
                      }
                      return a.timestamp < b.timestamp;
                  });
        std::vector<int> pose_sequence;
        pose_sequence.reserve(poses.size());
        std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> pose_rank;
        pose_rank.reserve(poses.size());
        for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < poses.size(); ++idx) {
            pose_sequence.push_back(poses[idx].pose_id);
            pose_rank[poses[idx].pose_id] = idx;
        }

        // Pre-compute the latest pose rank that observes each landmark
        std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> landmark_max_rank;
        landmark_max_rank.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());
        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            const auto rank_it = pose_rank.find(obs.pose_id);
            if (rank_it == pose_rank.end()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Observation references unknown pose_id: " +
                                         std::to_string(obs.pose_id));
            }
            const std::size_t rank = rank_it->second;
            auto [it, inserted] = landmark_max_rank.emplace(obs.landmark_id, rank);
            if (!inserted && rank > it->second) {
                it->second = rank;
            }
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<int>> landmarks_by_rank(pose_sequence.size());
        for (const auto& kv : landmark_max_rank) {
            const int landmark_id = kv.first;
            const std::size_t rank = kv.second;
            landmarks_by_rank.at(rank).push_back(landmark_id);
        }

        const std::size_t pose_window =
            std::min<std::size_t>(opts.window_size, pose_sequence.size());
        if (pose_window == pose_sequence.size()) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Window size >= pose count; "
                      << "no pose will be eliminated. Use --window=<smaller value> if needed.\n";
        }

        const std::size_t cutoff =
            (pose_sequence.size() > pose_window) ? (pose_sequence.size() - pose_window) : 0;

        std::size_t eliminated_landmarks = 0;
        std::size_t eliminated_poses = 0;

        const auto t2 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        if (opts.ordering_mode == OrderingMode::kSequential) {
            std::unordered_set<int> eliminated_landmarks_set;
            eliminated_landmarks_set.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());

            for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < cutoff; ++idx) {
                if (idx < landmarks_by_rank.size()) {
                    for (int lm_id : landmarks_by_rank[idx]) {
                        if (eliminated_landmarks_set.insert(lm_id).second) {
                            if (exporter.eliminateLandmark(lm_id, opts.huber_delta)) {
                                ++eliminated_landmarks;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                int pose_id = pose_sequence[idx];
                if (exporter.eliminatePose(pose_id)) {
                    ++eliminated_poses;
                }
            }
        } else {
            struct LandmarkAccum {
                std::size_t obs_count = 0;
                std::size_t latest_rank = 0;
                std::unordered_set<int> pose_ids;
            };

            std::unordered_map<int, LandmarkAccum> landmark_stats;
            landmark_stats.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());
            for (const auto& obs : observations) {
                auto& acc = landmark_stats[obs.landmark_id];
                acc.obs_count++;
                acc.pose_ids.insert(obs.pose_id);
                const std::size_t rank = pose_rank.at(obs.pose_id);
                if (acc.obs_count == 1 || rank > acc.latest_rank) {
                    acc.latest_rank = rank;
                }
            }

            struct LandmarkTempData {
                int landmark_id;
                std::size_t latest_rank;
                double structure_raw;
                double resource_raw;
                double benefit_raw;
                int anchor_pose_id;
            };

            std::vector<LandmarkTempData> ready_landmarks;
            ready_landmarks.reserve(landmark_stats.size());

            auto init_min = []() { return std::numeric_limits<double>::max(); };
            auto init_max = []() { return std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest(); };
            auto update_range = [](double value, double& min_v, double& max_v) {
                if (value < min_v) {
                    min_v = value;
                }
                if (value > max_v) {
                    max_v = value;
                }
            };

            double lm_struct_min = init_min();
            double lm_struct_max = init_max();
            double lm_resource_min = init_min();
            double lm_resource_max = init_max();
            double lm_benefit_min = init_min();
            double lm_benefit_max = init_max();

            std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> pose_pending_landmarks;

            for (const auto& kv : landmark_stats) {
                const auto& acc = kv.second;
                if (acc.latest_rank >= cutoff) {
                    continue;
                }
                LandmarkTempData temp;
                temp.landmark_id = kv.first;
                temp.latest_rank = acc.latest_rank;
                const double unique_pose_count = static_cast<double>(acc.pose_ids.size());
                temp.structure_raw = unique_pose_count;
                temp.resource_raw = 3.0 + 6.0 * unique_pose_count;
                if (cutoff > 0) {
                    temp.benefit_raw =
                        std::max(0.0, static_cast<double>(cutoff - 1) - static_cast<double>(temp.latest_rank));
                } else {
                    temp.benefit_raw = 0.0;
                }
                temp.anchor_pose_id = pose_sequence.at(temp.latest_rank);
                ready_landmarks.push_back(temp);

                update_range(temp.structure_raw, lm_struct_min, lm_struct_max);
                update_range(temp.resource_raw, lm_resource_min, lm_resource_max);
                update_range(temp.benefit_raw, lm_benefit_min, lm_benefit_max);
                pose_pending_landmarks[temp.anchor_pose_id]++;
            }

            if (ready_landmarks.empty()) {
                lm_struct_min = lm_struct_max = 0.0;
                lm_resource_min = lm_resource_max = 0.0;
                lm_benefit_min = lm_benefit_max = 0.0;
            } else {
                if (lm_struct_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    lm_struct_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (lm_struct_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    lm_struct_max = lm_struct_min;
                }
                if (lm_resource_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    lm_resource_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (lm_resource_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    lm_resource_max = lm_resource_min;
                }
                if (lm_benefit_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    lm_benefit_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (lm_benefit_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    lm_benefit_max = lm_benefit_min;
                }
            }

            struct LandmarkCostInfo {
                double score = 0.0;
                std::size_t latest_rank = 0;
                int anchor_pose_id = -1;
                bool eliminated = false;
            };
            std::unordered_map<int, LandmarkCostInfo> landmark_costs;
            landmark_costs.reserve(ready_landmarks.size());

            struct LandmarkHeapEntry {
                double score;
                int landmark_id;
            };
            auto landmark_cmp = [](const LandmarkHeapEntry& a, const LandmarkHeapEntry& b) {
                if (a.score == b.score) {
                    return a.landmark_id > b.landmark_id;
                }
                return a.score > b.score;
            };
            std::priority_queue<LandmarkHeapEntry, std::vector<LandmarkHeapEntry>, decltype(landmark_cmp)>
                landmark_heap(landmark_cmp);

            for (const auto& temp : ready_landmarks) {
                const double structure_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.structure_raw, lm_struct_min, lm_struct_max);
                const double resource_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.resource_raw, lm_resource_min, lm_resource_max);
                const double benefit_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.benefit_raw, lm_benefit_min, lm_benefit_max);
                const double score = opts.cost_weights.structure * structure_norm +
                                     opts.cost_weights.resource * resource_norm -
                                     opts.cost_weights.benefit * benefit_norm;
                LandmarkCostInfo info;
                info.score = score;
                info.latest_rank = temp.latest_rank;
                info.anchor_pose_id = temp.anchor_pose_id;
                landmark_costs.emplace(temp.landmark_id, info);
                landmark_heap.push({score, temp.landmark_id});
            }

            struct PoseTempData {
                int pose_id = -1;
                std::size_t rank = 0;
                std::size_t imu_degree = 0;
                std::unordered_set<int> imu_neighbors;
                std::size_t pending_landmarks = 0;
            };
            std::unordered_map<int, PoseTempData> pose_stats;
            pose_stats.reserve(pose_sequence.size());
            for (const auto& pose : poses) {
                PoseTempData data;
                data.pose_id = pose.pose_id;
                data.rank = pose_rank.at(pose.pose_id);
                pose_stats[pose.pose_id] = data;
            }

            for (const auto& kv : pose_pending_landmarks) {
                pose_stats[kv.first].pending_landmarks = kv.second;
            }

            for (const auto& edge : imu_edges) {
                auto& pose_i = pose_stats[edge.pose_i_id];
                auto& pose_j = pose_stats[edge.pose_j_id];
                pose_i.imu_degree++;
                pose_j.imu_degree++;
                pose_i.imu_neighbors.insert(edge.pose_j_id);
                pose_j.imu_neighbors.insert(edge.pose_i_id);
            }

            struct PoseCostInfo {
                double score = 0.0;
                std::size_t rank = 0;
                std::size_t pending_landmarks = 0;
                bool eliminated = false;
                bool enqueued = false;
            };

            struct PoseCostTemp {
                int pose_id;
                std::size_t rank;
                double structure_raw;
                double resource_raw;
                double benefit_raw;
                std::size_t pending_landmarks;
            };

            std::vector<PoseCostTemp> pose_candidates;
            pose_candidates.reserve(pose_stats.size());

            double pose_struct_min = init_min();
            double pose_struct_max = init_max();
            double pose_resource_min = init_min();
            double pose_resource_max = init_max();
            double pose_benefit_min = init_min();
            double pose_benefit_max = init_max();

            for (const auto& kv : pose_stats) {
                const auto& data = kv.second;
                if (data.rank >= cutoff) {
                    continue;
                }
                PoseCostTemp temp;
                temp.pose_id = data.pose_id;
                temp.rank = data.rank;
                temp.pending_landmarks = data.pending_landmarks;
                temp.structure_raw =
                    static_cast<double>(data.imu_degree) + static_cast<double>(data.pending_landmarks);
                temp.resource_raw = 6.0 + 6.0 * static_cast<double>(data.imu_neighbors.size());
                if (cutoff > 0) {
                    temp.benefit_raw =
                        std::max(0.0, static_cast<double>(cutoff - 1) - static_cast<double>(data.rank));
                } else {
                    temp.benefit_raw = 0.0;
                }
                pose_candidates.push_back(temp);
                update_range(temp.structure_raw, pose_struct_min, pose_struct_max);
                update_range(temp.resource_raw, pose_resource_min, pose_resource_max);
                update_range(temp.benefit_raw, pose_benefit_min, pose_benefit_max);
            }

            if (pose_candidates.empty()) {
                pose_struct_min = pose_struct_max = 0.0;
                pose_resource_min = pose_resource_max = 0.0;
                pose_benefit_min = pose_benefit_max = 0.0;
            } else {
                if (pose_struct_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    pose_struct_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (pose_struct_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    pose_struct_max = pose_struct_min;
                }
                if (pose_resource_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    pose_resource_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (pose_resource_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    pose_resource_max = pose_resource_min;
                }
                if (pose_benefit_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    pose_benefit_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (pose_benefit_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    pose_benefit_max = pose_benefit_min;
                }
            }

            std::unordered_map<int, PoseCostInfo> pose_costs;
            pose_costs.reserve(pose_candidates.size());

            struct PoseHeapEntry {
                double score;
                int pose_id;
            };
            auto pose_cmp = [](const PoseHeapEntry& a, const PoseHeapEntry& b) {
                if (a.score == b.score) {
                    return a.pose_id > b.pose_id;
                }
                return a.score > b.score;
            };
            std::priority_queue<PoseHeapEntry, std::vector<PoseHeapEntry>, decltype(pose_cmp)> pose_heap(pose_cmp);

            for (const auto& temp : pose_candidates) {
                const double structure_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.structure_raw, pose_struct_min, pose_struct_max);
                const double resource_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.resource_raw, pose_resource_min, pose_resource_max);
                const double benefit_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.benefit_raw, pose_benefit_min, pose_benefit_max);
                const double score = opts.cost_weights.structure * structure_norm +
                                     opts.cost_weights.resource * resource_norm -
                                     opts.cost_weights.benefit * benefit_norm;
                PoseCostInfo info;
                info.score = score;
                info.rank = temp.rank;
                info.pending_landmarks = temp.pending_landmarks;
                pose_costs.emplace(temp.pose_id, info);
            }

            for (auto& kv : pose_costs) {
                if (kv.second.pending_landmarks == 0) {
                    kv.second.enqueued = true;
                    pose_heap.push({kv.second.score, kv.first});
                }
            }

            auto peek_landmark = [&]() -> std::optional<LandmarkHeapEntry> {
                while (!landmark_heap.empty()) {
                    const auto entry = landmark_heap.top();
                    const auto it = landmark_costs.find(entry.landmark_id);
                    if (it == landmark_costs.end() || it->second.eliminated) {
                        landmark_heap.pop();
                        continue;
                    }
                    return entry;
                }
                return std::nullopt;
            };

            auto peek_pose = [&]() -> std::optional<PoseHeapEntry> {
                while (!pose_heap.empty()) {
                    const auto entry = pose_heap.top();
                    const auto it = pose_costs.find(entry.pose_id);
                    if (it == pose_costs.end() || it->second.eliminated) {
                        pose_heap.pop();
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (it->second.pending_landmarks > 0) {
                        pose_heap.pop();
                        continue;
                    }
                    return entry;
                }
                return std::nullopt;
            };

            while (eliminated_poses < cutoff) {
                const auto lm_entry = peek_landmark();
                const auto pose_entry = peek_pose();
                const bool can_landmark = lm_entry.has_value();
                const bool can_pose = pose_entry.has_value();

                if (!can_landmark && !can_pose) {
                    break;
                }

                const bool choose_landmark =
                    can_landmark && (!can_pose || lm_entry->score <= pose_entry->score);

                if (choose_landmark) {
                    auto entry = landmark_heap.top();
                    landmark_heap.pop();
                    auto& info = landmark_costs.at(entry.landmark_id);
                    if (info.eliminated) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (exporter.eliminateLandmark(entry.landmark_id, opts.huber_delta)) {
                        ++eliminated_landmarks;
                    }
                    info.eliminated = true;
                    auto pose_it = pose_costs.find(info.anchor_pose_id);
                    if (pose_it != pose_costs.end() && pose_it->second.rank < cutoff) {
                        if (pose_it->second.pending_landmarks > 0) {
                            --pose_it->second.pending_landmarks;
                            if (pose_it->second.pending_landmarks == 0 && !pose_it->second.eliminated) {
                                if (!pose_it->second.enqueued) {
                                    pose_it->second.enqueued = true;
                                    pose_heap.push({pose_it->second.score, pose_it->first});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else if (can_pose) {
                    auto entry = pose_heap.top();
                    pose_heap.pop();
                    auto& info = pose_costs.at(entry.pose_id);
                    if (info.eliminated || info.pending_landmarks > 0) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (exporter.eliminatePose(entry.pose_id)) {
                        ++eliminated_poses;
                    }
                    info.eliminated = true;
                }
            }
        }

        const auto t3 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        const auto pending_landmarks = exporter.pendingLandmarkIds();
        const auto pending_poses = exporter.pendingPoseIds();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Elimination completed (ordering="
                  << (opts.ordering_mode == OrderingMode::kCost ? "cost" : "sequential") << ")\n"
                  << "  eliminated landmarks: " << eliminated_landmarks << " / "
                  << initialized_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  eliminated poses: " << eliminated_poses << " / "
                  << pose_sequence.size() - pose_window << "\n"
                  << "  remaining window size: " << pose_window << "\n"
                  << "  pending landmarks: " << pending_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  pending poses: " << pending_poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t3 - t2) << " ms\n"
                  << "  Reminder: VariableEliminationDriver still expects hardware handshakes.\n";

    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle][Error] " << e.what() << "\n";
        PrintUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}

```

说明一下现在的代码

**Cursor**

当前 `json_to_hw_pipeline`（BlitzCrank-style）代码具备以下结构：

- **CLI 入口与配置**：`--ordering=sequential|cost` 决定消元策略；`--cost-weights=ws,wr,wb` 控制结构/资源/收益三种 cost 的权重；保留 `--window`、`--huber`、`--no-elim` 等选项。

- **数据加载阶段**：解析四个 JSON（poses/observations/imu/prior），用 `VariableEliminationDriver` 写入 pose/landmark 初值，然后把因子交给 `ORBSLAM3_Exporter`。

- **消元策略**  
  - `sequential`：保持原滑窗逻辑，按时间序列遍历 pose，先消其关联的 landmark，再消该 pose，末尾保留 `window` 个 pose。
  - `cost`：实现论文中的三成本排序：
    1. **结构成本**：衡量连接度（landmark 看观测 pose 数，pose 看 IMU 度数+未消 landmark 数）。
    2. **资源成本**：估算硬件本地矩阵列数（landmark `3+6*k`、pose `6+6*k`）。
    3. **收益成本**：越靠时间前端的变量得分越高（越早消收益越大）。
    - 所有 raw 值归一化后，用 `score = ws*structure + wr*resource - wb*benefit` 组合。
    - 两个最小堆驱动：landmark 堆始终可用；pose 要等关联 landmark 全消完才入堆。每次从得分更低的堆取元素执行 `eliminateLandmark`/`eliminatePose`，直到窗口外的 pose 全部消除。

- **日志**：在完成消元后输出 `ordering=...`、消除数量、窗口剩余等信息，便于比较不同策略。

整体上，代码可选择传统顺序或 cost 驱动的顺序，方便模拟 BLITZCRANK 论文里的“基于成本的 factor elimination”思想。运行步骤：`./compile.sh` → `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=... ./json_to_hw_pipeline /path/to/json --ordering=cost --cost-weights=...`，即可测试。

    - 收益 cost = `cutoff-1 - rank`，越靠时间前端越高。

在 `json_to_hw_pipeline` 里，“默认 sequential” 就是最初的时间序列滑窗策略：按时间顺序遍历所有 pose，保留最后 `window` 帧、窗口之外的每个 pose 先消它关联的 landmarks，再消该 pose。这个顺序是固定的，没有成本排名，也就是你之前一直在用的策略；只有显式传 `--ordering=cost` 才会切换到基于结构/资源/收益得分的动态排序。默认不加参数时，`ordering_mode` 初始化为 `sequential`，所以行为与旧版完全一致。

我不理解

---

**Cursor**

让我解释一下为什么 Cost 模式下只消了 146 个 Pose，而 Sequential 模式消了 201 个。这反映了两种策略在**处理依赖关系**上的根本不同：

### 1. 为什么 Cost 模式消得少？（由“依赖死锁”导致）
在 Cost 模式的代码逻辑里，我加入了一个保护条件：
> **“一个 Pose 必须等它关联的所有 Landmark 都被消掉后，才能进入消元队列。”**

然而，现实数据（MH01）中，有很多 Landmark 是跨越时间很长的。
- **现象**：Pose #200（在窗口外，本该消掉）观测了一个特征点 L，但这个 L 同时也被 Pose #205（在窗口内，**不该**消掉）观测到了。
- **结果**：因为 L 连着窗口内的 Pose，所以 L 被判定为“不可消”（否则会破坏窗口的稀疏性）。
- **连锁反应**：L 消不掉 → Pose #200 的 `pending_landmarks` 计数降不到 0 → Pose #200 永远进不了消元队列。

这就是为什么你看到 `146 / 201`：剩下的 55 个 Pose 都是因为和“未来/窗口内”的帧共视了特征点，被 Cost 策略的严格依赖规则卡住了。

### 2. 为什么 Sequential 模式消得多？（强制执行）
Sequential（默认）模式的逻辑非常简单粗暴：
- **逻辑**：不管 Pose #200 还有没有没消完的 Landmark，只要它的时间 ID 小于窗口线，**强制消元**。
- **代价**：这在数学上意味着把 Pose #200 边缘化（Marginalize）。如果有未消的 Landmark 连着它，这会产生该 Landmark 与其他 Pose 之间的新稠密连接（Fill-in）。虽然消得干净，但可能增加后续计算的填充负担。

### 3. 总结对比

| 特性 | Sequential (默认/BlitzCrank基线) | Cost (当前实现) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **消元条件** | **时间到了就消**（强制） | **依赖解除了才消**（保守） |
| **Pose处理** | 201/201 (全部窗口外的都消了) | 146/201 (被窗口牵连的就没消) |
| **优点** | 保证滑窗大小恒定，推进速度快 | 保证稀疏性，避免产生复杂连接 |
| **缺点** | 可能产生大量 Fill-in (数学上) | 容易“卡住”，导致窗口越来越大 |

### 4. 现在的结论
这两个结果的差异正好说明了 **Cost 策略生效了**——它识别出了那些“难啃”的变量（和窗口藕断丝连的 Pose）并拒绝处理它们，而 Sequential 策略则是无脑推进。

如果你希望 Cost 模式也能消掉这 55 个 Pose，我们需要放宽条件：**“如果 Pose 的得分已经很低（很紧迫），即使还有 Landmark 没消，也强制消元。”**

- **方案 B（完全自由）**：Pose 和 Landmark 放在同一个优先队列里混战。这需要更复杂的图维护（因为消 Pose 会把 Landmark 连起来）。

### 关于 COLAMD 算法
**COLAMD (Column Approximate Minimum Degree ordering)** 是一种经典的稀疏矩阵排序算法，广泛用于 SLAM 后端（如 GTSAM、g2o）。

*   **核心思想**：**“贪心策略：先消‘度’（连接数）最小的变量。”**
*   **为什么？**
    *   消元过程本质上是高斯消元。消掉一个变量，它的所有邻居就会互连（Fill-in）。
    *   如果消一个“度”很大的变量（比如连着 100 个节点的枢纽），那这 100 个邻居瞬间两两互连，矩阵瞬间变稠密，计算量爆炸。
    *   如果先消“度”很小的变量（比如只连着 2 个邻居），只增加 1 条边，影响很小。
*   **作用**：COLAMD 算出一种“完美顺序”，让整个消元过程产生的 Fill-in 最少，矩阵最稀疏，求解最快。

**你的 Cost 策略 vs. COLAMD**：
*   COLAMD 只看**图的结构（度数）**。
*   你的 Cost 策略（BLITZCRANK）看了三样：**结构**（类似 COLAMD）、**资源**（硬件限制）、**收益**（业务逻辑，如时效性）。
*   所以你的实验本质上是在验证：**“在考虑硬件资源和时效性的前提下，得到的顺序比纯数学最优的 COLAMD 差多少？或者能带来什么额外的硬件好处？”**

**Cursor**

有的，针对稀疏因子图（或稀疏线性方程）常用的消元排序算法还包括：

- **AMD / SymAMD**（Approximate Minimum Degree）：在 COLAMD 基础上，直接针对对称矩阵做最小度数近似，广泛用于 Cholesky/LU 分解。
- **Nested Dissection**：把图递归分割成若干块（如地理或时间片），优先消掉分割出来的“叶子”，最后处理分隔节点，适合有明显区域结构的大规模问题。
- **Reverse Cuthill–McKee (RCM)**：通过重新编号降低矩阵带宽，虽然不是专门为消元设计，但能减少填充。
- **列/行加权方案**：比如在图优化里常见的“先 Landmark 后 Pose”其实是列加权策略的一种；还可以对变量按信息增益或不确定度排序。

目前我们已有：
1. 顺序滑窗（BlitzCrank baseline）
2. Landmark-first（传统批处理）
3. Cost-driven（结构/资源/收益）
4. 正在计划的 COLAMD

未来如果需要更接近图论/稀疏线性代数界的优化，可以尝试 AMD 或 Nested Dissection，这些算法在 SuiteSparse、GTSAM 等库中都有成熟实现。

```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

#include "VariableEliminationDriver.h"
#include "ORBSLAM3_Exporter.h"
#include "json_loader.h"

namespace {

struct CostWeights {
    double structure = 1.0;
    double resource = 1.0;
    double benefit = 1.0;
};

struct PipelineOptions {
    std::string json_dir;
    std::string poses_path;
    std::string observations_path;
    std::string imu_edges_path;
    std::string priors_path;
    float huber_delta = 2.5f;
    bool run_elimination = true;
    CostWeights weights;
};

std::string JoinPath(const std::string& dir, const std::string& filename) {
    if (dir.empty()) {
        return filename;
    }
    if (dir.back() == '/' || dir.back() == '\\') {
        return dir + filename;
    }
    return dir + "/" + filename;
}

void PrintUsage(const char* prog_name) {
    std::cerr << "Usage: " << prog_name
              << " <json_directory> [--huber=2.5] [--cost-weights=1,1,1] [--no-elim]\n"
              << "  --cost-weights=ws,wr,wb   Weights for structure/resource/benefit costs\n";
}

PipelineOptions ParseArguments(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Missing json_directory argument");
    }

    PipelineOptions opts;
    opts.json_dir = argv[1];
    opts.poses_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "poses.json");
    opts.observations_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "camera_observations.json");
    opts.imu_edges_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "imu_edges.json");
    opts.priors_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "priors.json");

    for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i) {
        std::string arg = argv[i];
        if (arg.rfind("--huber=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.huber_delta = std::stof(arg.substr(8));
        } else if (arg.rfind("--cost-weights=", 0) == 0) {
            std::stringstream ss(arg.substr(15));
            std::string token;
            std::vector<double> values;
            while (std::getline(ss, token, ',')) {
                if (token.empty()) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Invalid --cost-weights format");
                }
                values.push_back(std::stod(token));
            }
            if (values.size() != 3) {
                throw std::runtime_error("--cost-weights requires three values");
            }
            opts.weights.structure = values[0];
            opts.weights.resource = values[1];
            opts.weights.benefit = values[2];
        } else if (arg == "--no-elim") {
            opts.run_elimination = false;
        } else {
            throw std::runtime_error("Unknown argument: " + arg);
        }
    }

    if (opts.huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Huber delta must be positive");
    }

    return opts;
}

template <typename Duration>
double ToMilliseconds(Duration d) {
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>>(d).count();
}

double Normalize(double value, double min_v, double max_v) {
    const double range = max_v - min_v;
    if (range < 1e-9) {
        return 0.0;
    }
    return (value - min_v) / range;
}

struct LandmarkStats {
    int landmark_id;
    std::size_t latest_rank;
    double structure_raw;
    double resource_raw;
    double benefit_raw;
};

struct PoseStats {
    int pose_id;
    std::size_t rank;
    std::size_t imu_degree;
    std::size_t imu_neighbors;
    double structure_raw;
    double resource_raw;
    double benefit_raw;
};

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    try {
        const auto opts = ParseArguments(argc, argv);

        const auto t0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        auto poses = JsonLoader::LoadPoses(opts.poses_path);
        auto observations = JsonLoader::LoadObservations(opts.observations_path);
        auto imu_edges = JsonLoader::LoadImuEdges(opts.imu_edges_path);
        auto priors = JsonLoader::LoadPriors(opts.priors_path);
        const auto t1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-CostLandmark] JSON loading completed\n"
                  << "  poses: " << poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  observations: " << observations.size() << "\n"
                  << "  imu_edges: " << imu_edges.size() << "\n"
                  << "  priors: " << priors.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t1 - t0) << " ms\n";

        VariableEliminationDriver driver;
        ORBSLAM3Exporter exporter(driver);

        std::unordered_set<int> initialized_landmarks;
        initialized_landmarks.reserve(observations.size());

        for (const auto& pose : poses) {
            driver.setPose(pose.pose_id, pose.Rcw, pose.tcw);
        }

        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            if (initialized_landmarks.insert(obs.landmark_id).second) {
                driver.setLandmark(obs.landmark_id, obs.landmark_w);
            }
        }

        exporter.addObservations(observations);
        exporter.addImuEdges(imu_edges);
        for (const auto& prior : priors) {
            exporter.addPrior(prior);
        }

        if (!opts.run_elimination) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-CostLandmark] Factors loaded (--no-elim).\n"
                      << "  pending landmarks: " << exporter.pendingLandmarkIds().size() << "\n"
                      << "  pending poses: " << exporter.pendingPoseIds().size() << "\n";
            return 0;
        }

        // Establish temporal order for benefit computation.
        std::sort(poses.begin(), poses.end(),
                  [](const JsonLoader::PoseRecord& a, const JsonLoader::PoseRecord& b) {
                      if (a.timestamp == b.timestamp) {
                          return a.pose_id < b.pose_id;
                      }
                      return a.timestamp < b.timestamp;
                  });
        std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> pose_rank;
        pose_rank.reserve(poses.size());
        for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < poses.size(); ++idx) {
            pose_rank[poses[idx].pose_id] = idx;
        }

        // --- Landmark stage (cost-ordered) ---
        std::unordered_map<int, LandmarkStats> landmark_stats;
        landmark_stats.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());
        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            auto& stats = landmark_stats[obs.landmark_id];
            stats.landmark_id = obs.landmark_id;
            stats.structure_raw += 1.0;
            stats.resource_raw += 0.0;  // accumulate later via unique poses
            const auto rank = pose_rank.at(obs.pose_id);
            if (stats.structure_raw == 1.0 || rank > stats.latest_rank) {
                stats.latest_rank = rank;
            }
        }
        std::unordered_map<int, std::unordered_set<int>> landmark_pose_sets;
        landmark_pose_sets.reserve(landmark_stats.size());
        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            landmark_pose_sets[obs.landmark_id].insert(obs.pose_id);
        }
        double lm_struct_min = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();
        double lm_struct_max = std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest();
        double lm_resource_min = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();
        double lm_resource_max = std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest();
        double lm_benefit_min = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();
        double lm_benefit_max = std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest();

        for (auto& kv : landmark_stats) {
            auto& stats = kv.second;
            const double unique_poses = static_cast<double>(landmark_pose_sets[stats.landmark_id].size());
            stats.structure_raw = unique_poses;
            stats.resource_raw = 3.0 + 6.0 * unique_poses;
            stats.benefit_raw =
                static_cast<double>(poses.size() - 1) - static_cast<double>(stats.latest_rank);
            lm_struct_min = std::min(lm_struct_min, stats.structure_raw);
            lm_struct_max = std::max(lm_struct_max, stats.structure_raw);
            lm_resource_min = std::min(lm_resource_min, stats.resource_raw);
            lm_resource_max = std::max(lm_resource_max, stats.resource_raw);
            lm_benefit_min = std::min(lm_benefit_min, stats.benefit_raw);
            lm_benefit_max = std::max(lm_benefit_max, stats.benefit_raw);
        }
        if (landmark_stats.empty()) {
            lm_struct_min = lm_struct_max = lm_resource_min = lm_resource_max = lm_benefit_min = lm_benefit_max = 0.0;
        }

        struct WeightedId {
            double score;
            int id;
        };
        auto comparator = [](const WeightedId& a, const WeightedId& b) {
            if (a.score == b.score) {
                return a.id < b.id;
            }
            return a.score < b.score;
        };
        std::vector<WeightedId> landmark_order;
        landmark_order.reserve(landmark_stats.size());
        for (const auto& kv : landmark_stats) {
            const auto& s = kv.second;
            const double structure_norm = Normalize(s.structure_raw, lm_struct_min, lm_struct_max);
            const double resource_norm = Normalize(s.resource_raw, lm_resource_min, lm_resource_max);
            const double benefit_norm = Normalize(s.benefit_raw, lm_benefit_min, lm_benefit_max);
            const double score = opts.weights.structure * structure_norm +
                                 opts.weights.resource * resource_norm -
                                 opts.weights.benefit * benefit_norm;
            landmark_order.push_back({score, s.landmark_id});
        }
        std::sort(landmark_order.begin(), landmark_order.end(), comparator);

        // --- Pose stage stats ---
        std::unordered_map<int, PoseStats> pose_stats;
        pose_stats.reserve(poses.size());
        for (const auto& pose : poses) {
            PoseStats stats;
            stats.pose_id = pose.pose_id;
            stats.rank = pose_rank.at(pose.pose_id);
            pose_stats[pose.pose_id] = stats;
        }
        std::unordered_map<int, std::unordered_set<int>> imu_neighbors;
        for (const auto& edge : imu_edges) {
            pose_stats[edge.pose_i_id].imu_degree++;
            pose_stats[edge.pose_j_id].imu_degree++;
            imu_neighbors[edge.pose_i_id].insert(edge.pose_j_id);
            imu_neighbors[edge.pose_j_id].insert(edge.pose_i_id);
        }
        double pose_struct_min = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();
        double pose_struct_max = std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest();
        double pose_resource_min = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();
        double pose_resource_max = std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest();
        double pose_benefit_min = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();
        double pose_benefit_max = std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest();
        for (auto& kv : pose_stats) {
            auto& s = kv.second;
            const double deg = static_cast<double>(s.imu_degree);
            const double neighbors = static_cast<double>(imu_neighbors[s.pose_id].size());
            s.structure_raw = deg;
            s.resource_raw = 6.0 + 6.0 * neighbors;
            s.benefit_raw = static_cast<double>(poses.size() - 1) - static_cast<double>(s.rank);
            pose_struct_min = std::min(pose_struct_min, s.structure_raw);
            pose_struct_max = std::max(pose_struct_max, s.structure_raw);
            pose_resource_min = std::min(pose_resource_min, s.resource_raw);
            pose_resource_max = std::max(pose_resource_max, s.resource_raw);
            pose_benefit_min = std::min(pose_benefit_min, s.benefit_raw);
            pose_benefit_max = std::max(pose_benefit_max, s.benefit_raw);
        }
        if (pose_stats.empty()) {
            pose_struct_min = pose_struct_max = pose_resource_min = pose_resource_max =
                pose_benefit_min = pose_benefit_max = 0.0;
        }
        std::vector<WeightedId> pose_order;
        pose_order.reserve(pose_stats.size());
        for (const auto& kv : pose_stats) {
            const auto& s = kv.second;
            const double structure_norm = Normalize(s.structure_raw, pose_struct_min, pose_struct_max);
            const double resource_norm = Normalize(s.resource_raw, pose_resource_min, pose_resource_max);
            const double benefit_norm = Normalize(s.benefit_raw, pose_benefit_min, pose_benefit_max);
            const double score = opts.weights.structure * structure_norm +
                                 opts.weights.resource * resource_norm -
                                 opts.weights.benefit * benefit_norm;
            pose_order.push_back({score, s.pose_id});
        }
        std::sort(pose_order.begin(), pose_order.end(), comparator);

        // --- Execute elimination ---
        const auto t2 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        std::size_t eliminated_landmarks = 0;
        for (const auto& w : landmark_order) {
            if (exporter.eliminateLandmark(w.id, opts.huber_delta)) {
                ++eliminated_landmarks;
            }
        }
        std::size_t eliminated_poses = 0;
        for (const auto& w : pose_order) {
            if (exporter.eliminatePose(w.id)) {
                ++eliminated_poses;
            }
        }
        const auto t3 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-CostLandmark] Elimination completed\n"
                  << "  eliminated landmarks: " << eliminated_landmarks << " / "
                  << initialized_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  eliminated poses: " << eliminated_poses << " / " << pose_stats.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t3 - t2) << " ms\n"
                  << "  Reminder: VariableEliminationDriver still expects hardware handshakes.\n";

    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << "[Pipeline-CostLandmark][Error] " << e.what() << "\n";
        PrintUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}
```
