```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <iostream>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

#include "VariableEliminationDriver.h"
#include "ORBSLAM3_Exporter.h"
#include "json_loader.h"

namespace {

struct PipelineOptions {
    std::string json_dir;
    std::string poses_path;
    std::string observations_path;
    std::string imu_edges_path;
    std::string priors_path;
    float huber_delta = 2.5f;
    bool run_elimination = true;
    std::string dump_path;
};

std::string JoinPath(const std::string& dir, const std::string& filename) {
    if (dir.empty()) {
        return filename;
    }
    if (dir.back() == '/' || dir.back() == '\\') {
        return dir + filename;
    }
    return dir + "/" + filename;
}

void PrintUsage(const char* prog_name) {
    std::cerr << "Usage: " << prog_name
              << " <json_directory> [--huber=2.5] [--dump-stimulus=path] [--no-elim]\n";
}

PipelineOptions ParseArguments(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Missing json_directory argument");
    }

    PipelineOptions opts;
    opts.json_dir = argv[1];
    opts.poses_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "poses.json");
    opts.observations_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "camera_observations.json");
    opts.imu_edges_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "imu_edges.json");
    opts.priors_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "priors.json");

    for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i) {
        std::string arg = argv[i];
        if (arg.rfind("--huber=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.huber_delta = std::stof(arg.substr(8));
        } else if (arg.rfind("--dump-stimulus=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.dump_path = arg.substr(16);
        } else if (arg == "--no-elim") {
            opts.run_elimination = false;
        } else {
            throw std::runtime_error("Unknown argument: " + arg);
        }
    }

    if (opts.huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Huber delta must be positive");
    }

    return opts;
}

template <typename Duration>
double ToMilliseconds(Duration d) {
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>>(d).count();
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    try {
        const auto opts = ParseArguments(argc, argv);

        const auto t0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        auto poses = JsonLoader::LoadPoses(opts.poses_path);
        auto observations = JsonLoader::LoadObservations(opts.observations_path);
        auto imu_edges = JsonLoader::LoadImuEdges(opts.imu_edges_path);
        auto priors = JsonLoader::LoadPriors(opts.priors_path);
        const auto t1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-COLAMD] JSON loading completed\n"
                  << "  poses: " << poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  observations: " << observations.size() << "\n"
                  << "  imu_edges: " << imu_edges.size() << "\n"
                  << "  priors: " << priors.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t1 - t0) << " ms\n";

        VariableEliminationDriver driver;
        if (!opts.dump_path.empty()) {
            driver.enableStimulusDump(opts.dump_path);
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-COLAMD] Stimulus dump enabled: "
                      << opts.dump_path << "\n";
        }
        ORBSLAM3Exporter exporter(driver);

        std::unordered_set<int> initialized_landmarks;
        initialized_landmarks.reserve(observations.size());

        for (const auto& pose : poses) {
            driver.setPose(pose.pose_id, pose.Rcw, pose.tcw);
        }

        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            if (initialized_landmarks.insert(obs.landmark_id).second) {
                driver.setLandmark(obs.landmark_id, obs.landmark_w);
            }
        }

        exporter.addObservations(observations);
        exporter.addImuEdges(imu_edges);
        for (const auto& prior : priors) {
            exporter.addPrior(prior);
        }

        if (!opts.run_elimination) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-COLAMD] Factors loaded (--no-elim).\n"
                      << "  pending landmarks: " << exporter.pendingLandmarkIds().size() << "\n"
                      << "  pending poses: " << exporter.pendingPoseIds().size() << "\n";
            return 0;
        }

        // --- Landmark ordering: min unique pose degree ---
        std::unordered_map<int, std::unordered_set<int>> landmark_pose_sets;
        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            landmark_pose_sets[obs.landmark_id].insert(obs.pose_id);
        }
        std::vector<int> landmark_ids;
        landmark_ids.reserve(landmark_pose_sets.size());
        for (const auto& kv : landmark_pose_sets) {
            landmark_ids.push_back(kv.first);
        }
        std::sort(landmark_ids.begin(), landmark_ids.end(),
                  [&](int a, int b) {
                      const auto deg_a = landmark_pose_sets[a].size();
                      const auto deg_b = landmark_pose_sets[b].size();
                      if (deg_a == deg_b) {
                          return a < b;
                      }
                      return deg_a < deg_b;
                  });

        // --- Pose graph construction for COLAMD ---
        std::unordered_map<int, std::unordered_set<int>> adjacency;
        adjacency.reserve(poses.size());
        for (const auto& pose : poses) {
            adjacency[pose.pose_id];  // ensure entry
        }

        for (const auto& edge : imu_edges) {
            adjacency[edge.pose_i_id].insert(edge.pose_j_id);
            adjacency[edge.pose_j_id].insert(edge.pose_i_id);
        }

        for (const auto& kv : landmark_pose_sets) {
            const auto& pose_set = kv.second;
            if (pose_set.size() < 2) {
                continue;
            }
            std::vector<int> pose_list(pose_set.begin(), pose_set.end());
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < pose_list.size(); ++i) {
                for (std::size_t j = i + 1; j < pose_list.size(); ++j) {
                    const int u = pose_list[i];
                    const int v = pose_list[j];
                    adjacency[u].insert(v);
                    adjacency[v].insert(u);
                }
            }
        }

        struct DegreeEntry {
            int degree;
            int pose_id;
            int version;
        };
        auto cmp = [](const DegreeEntry& a, const DegreeEntry& b) {
            if (a.degree == b.degree) {
                return a.pose_id > b.pose_id;
            }
            return a.degree > b.degree;
        };
        std::priority_queue<DegreeEntry, std::vector<DegreeEntry>, decltype(cmp)> heap(cmp);
        std::unordered_map<int, int> current_degree;
        std::unordered_map<int, int> node_version;
        std::unordered_set<int> active;
        active.reserve(adjacency.size());
        int version_counter = 0;
        for (const auto& kv : adjacency) {
            const int deg = static_cast<int>(kv.second.size());
            current_degree[kv.first] = deg;
            active.insert(kv.first);
            heap.push({deg, kv.first, version_counter});
            node_version[kv.first] = version_counter++;
        }

        std::vector<int> pose_order;
        pose_order.reserve(adjacency.size());

        while (!heap.empty()) {
            auto entry = heap.top();
            heap.pop();

            if (!active.count(entry.pose_id)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (entry.version != node_version[entry.pose_id]) {
                continue;
            }

            pose_order.push_back(entry.pose_id);
            active.erase(entry.pose_id);

            auto neighbors = adjacency[entry.pose_id];
            for (int nb : neighbors) {
                if (!active.count(nb)) {
                    continue;
                }
                adjacency[nb].erase(entry.pose_id);
                int new_degree = static_cast<int>(adjacency[nb].size());
                current_degree[nb] = new_degree;
                node_version[nb] = version_counter;
                heap.push({new_degree, nb, version_counter});
                ++version_counter;
            }
            adjacency[entry.pose_id].clear();
        }

        const auto t2 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        std::size_t eliminated_landmarks = 0;
        for (int id : landmark_ids) {
            if (exporter.eliminateLandmark(id, opts.huber_delta)) {
                ++eliminated_landmarks;
            }
        }
        std::size_t eliminated_poses = 0;
        for (int pose_id : pose_order) {
            if (exporter.eliminatePose(pose_id)) {
                ++eliminated_poses;
            }
        }
        const auto t3 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-COLAMD] Elimination completed\n"
                  << "  eliminated landmarks: " << eliminated_landmarks << " / "
                  << initialized_landmarks.size() << "\n"
                  << "  eliminated poses: " << eliminated_poses << " / " << pose_order.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t3 - t2) << " ms\n"
                  << "  Reminder: VariableEliminationDriver still expects hardware handshakes.\n";

    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << "[Pipeline-COLAMD][Error] " << e.what() << "\n";
        PrintUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}
```

根据 RTL 代码分析，我来总结 **Axb.sv** 的输入接口格式：

## Axb 模块输入信号

| 信号 | 位宽 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `bundle_begin` | 1 | Bundle 开始脉冲 |
| `bundle_end` | 1 | Bundle 结束脉冲 |
| `factor_valid` | 1 | Factor 数据有效 |
| `factor_type` | 2 | 0=Camera, 1=IMU, 2=Prior |
| `local_col_panel` | 8 | Panel 列起始位置 |
| `local_col_trail` | 8 | Trail 列起始位置 |
| `alpha[0:5]` | 32×6 | 白化系数（IEEE 754 单精度） |
| **Camera payload** | | |
| `cam_fx, cam_fy, cam_cx, cam_cy` | 32×4 | 相机内参 |
| `cam_z_u, cam_z_v` | 32×2 | 观测值 |
| `cam_Pc_X/Y/Z/invZ` | 32×4 | 3D 点投影 |
| `cam_Rcw[3][3]` | 32×9 | 旋转矩阵 |
| **IMU/Prior payload** | | |
| `R0[3][3], R1[3][3], Rd[3][3]` | 32×27 | 旋转矩阵 |
| `t0[3], t1[3], td[3]` | 32×9 | 平移向量 |

---

## 建议的 HEX 文件格式

每个 factor 用一行或多行表示，每行是连续的 32-bit 十六进制值（IEEE 754 单精度浮点）：

```
# 格式: TYPE LOCAL_COL_PANEL LOCAL_COL_TRAIL ALPHA[0..5] PAYLOAD...
# Camera factor (type=0): 19 words header + 19 words payload = 38 words
00 00 00 3F800000 3F800000 3F800000 3F800000 3F800000 3F800000 <cam_fx> <cam_fy> ...

# IMU factor (type=1): 19 words header + 36 words payload
01 00 06 <alpha0..5> <R0[0][0]> <R0[0][1]> ... <td[2]>

# Prior factor (type=2): 同 IMU
02 00 00 ...
```

```cpp
/**
 * Variable-wise Elimination Driver Implementation
 * Implements the elimination sequence shown in your diagrams
 */
#include "VariableEliminationDriver.h"
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <cstring>

constexpr bool kEnableStimulusDumpDefault = false;

// Helper: Convert float to IEEE 754 hex string (8 chars, uppercase)
static std::string floatToHex(float f) {
    uint32_t bits;
    std::memcpy(&bits, &f, sizeof(bits));
    char buf[16];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%08X", bits);
    return std::string(buf);
}

// Helper: Write a 32-bit value as hex (for integers)
static std::string uint32ToHex(uint32_t v) {
    char buf[16];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%08X", v);
    return std::string(buf);
}

// Helper: Write a 3x3 matrix as 9 hex floats (row-major)
static std::string mat3ToHex(const float m[3][3]) {
    std::string s;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
            s += floatToHex(m[i][j]) + " ";
    return s;
}

// Helper: Write a 3-element vector as 3 hex floats
static std::string vec3ToHex(const float v[3]) {
    return floatToHex(v[0]) + " " + floatToHex(v[1]) + " " + floatToHex(v[2]) + " ";
}

// Public accessor implementations
void VariableEliminationDriver::setPose(int pose_id, const Eigen::Matrix3f& R, const Eigen::Vector3f& t) {
    poses_R_[pose_id] = R;
    poses_t_[pose_id] = t;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::setLandmark(int landmark_id, const Eigen::Vector3f& pos) {
    landmarks_[landmark_id] = pos;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::enableStimulusDump(const std::string& file_path) {
    stimulus_stream_.open(file_path);
    if (!stimulus_stream_) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Failed to open stimulus dump file: " + file_path);
    }
    dump_enabled_ = true;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::disableStimulusDump() {
    if (stimulus_stream_.is_open()) {
        stimulus_stream_.close();
    }
    dump_enabled_ = false;
}

const Eigen::Matrix3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseRotation(int pose_id) const {
    return poses_R_.at(pose_id);
}

const Eigen::Vector3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseTranslation(int pose_id) const {
    return poses_t_.at(pose_id);
}

const Eigen::Vector3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getLandmark(int landmark_id) const {
    return landmarks_.at(landmark_id);
}

// Private helper implementations
void VariableEliminationDriver::wait_clock() { 
    /* hardware simulation - busy wait to simulate compute cost */ 
    volatile int dummy = 0;
    for(int i=0; i<1000; i++) dummy++;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::wait_until(bool& signal) { 
    while(!signal) wait_clock(); 
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::writeStimulus(const std::string& line) {
    if (dump_enabled_ && stimulus_stream_) {
        stimulus_stream_ << line << "\n";
    }
}

Eigen::Matrix3f VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseRotationInternal(int pose_id) const {
    auto it = poses_R_.find(pose_id);
    if (it == poses_R_.end()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Pose rotation not found for pose_id: " + std::to_string(pose_id));
    }
    return it->second;
}

Eigen::Vector3f VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseTranslationInternal(int pose_id) const {
    auto it = poses_t_.find(pose_id);
    if (it == poses_t_.end()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Pose translation not found for pose_id: " + std::to_string(pose_id));
    }
    return it->second;
}

// eliminateLandmark implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::eliminateLandmark(
        int landmark_id,
        const std::vector<CameraObservation>& observations,
        float huber_delta
    ) {
        // Input validation
        if (observations.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("No observations provided for landmark " + std::to_string(landmark_id));
        }
        if (huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Huber delta must be positive");
        }
        
        // 1. Collect connected poses
        std::vector<int> connected_poses;
        std::map<int, int> pose_to_trail_slot;
        for (auto& obs : observations) {
            if (std::find(connected_poses.begin(), connected_poses.end(), obs.pose_id) == connected_poses.end()) {
                pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id] = connected_poses.size();
                connected_poses.push_back(obs.pose_id);
            }
        }
        
        int num_trails = connected_poses.size();
        int local_cols = 3 + 6 * num_trails;
        int local_rows = observations.size() * 2;
        
        // 2. Bundle begin
        axb_.bundle_begin = 1;
        axb_.bundle_panel_cols = 3;
        axb_.bundle_trails_count = num_trails;
        axb_.bundle_local_cols = local_cols;
        axb_.bundle_id = landmark_id;
        writeStimulus("BUNDLE_BEGIN LANDMARK " + std::to_string(landmark_id) +
                      " PANEL=3 TRAIL=" + std::to_string(num_trails) +
                      " LCOLS=" + std::to_string(local_cols));
        wait_clock();
        axb_.bundle_begin = 0;
        
        // 3. Feed each observation
        int local_row = 0;
        for (int k=0; k<observations.size(); k++) {
            auto& obs = observations[k];
            bool is_last = (k == observations.size() - 1);
            
            // Compute Pc and invZ
            Eigen::Vector3f Pc = obs.Rcw * obs.lw + obs.tcw;
            float Pc_z = Pc.z();
            if (std::abs(Pc_z) < 1e-6f) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Point behind camera or at infinity (Pc.z = " + std::to_string(Pc_z) + ")");
            }
            float invZ = 1.0f / Pc_z;
            
            // Compute residual for Huber weight (CPU side)
            Eigen::Vector2f z_pred;
            z_pred << obs.fx * Pc.x() * invZ + obs.cx,
                     obs.fy * Pc.y() * invZ + obs.cy;
            Eigen::Vector2f r = obs.pixel - z_pred;
            float sigma_pixel = obs.sigma_pixel;
            if (sigma_pixel <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid sigma_pixel: " + std::to_string(sigma_pixel));
            }
            Eigen::Vector2f r_hat = r / sigma_pixel;
            float rho = r_hat.norm();
            float w = (rho <= huber_delta) ? 1.0f : (huber_delta / rho);
            float alpha0 = w / sigma_pixel;
            float alpha1 = w / sigma_pixel;
            
            // Feed to Axb
            axb_.factor_valid = 1;
            axb_.factor_type = 0; // Camera
            axb_.local_col_panel = 0;  // landmark panel at local[0:2]
            axb_.local_col_trail = 3 + 6 * pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id]; // pose trail slot
            axb_.alpha[0] = alpha0;
            axb_.alpha[1] = alpha1;
            axb_.cam_fx = obs.fx;
            axb_.cam_fy = obs.fy;
            axb_.cam_cx = obs.cx;
            axb_.cam_cy = obs.cy;
            axb_.cam_z_u = obs.pixel.x();
            axb_.cam_z_v = obs.pixel.y();
            axb_.cam_Pc_X = Pc.x();
            axb_.cam_Pc_Y = Pc.y();
            axb_.cam_Pc_Z = Pc.z();
            axb_.cam_Pc_invZ = invZ;
            for (int i=0; i<3; i++)
                for (int j=0; j<3; j++)
                    axb_.cam_Rcw[i][j] = obs.Rcw(i,j);
            axb_.bundle_end = is_last ? 1 : 0;
            {
                std::ostringstream oss;
                oss << std::hexfloat;
                oss << "LANDMARK_OBS id=" << landmark_id
                    << " pose=" << obs.pose_id
                    << " trail=" << pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id]
                    << " fx=" << obs.fx << " fy=" << obs.fy
                    << " cx=" << obs.cx << " cy=" << obs.cy
                    << " zu=" << obs.pixel.x()
                    << " zv=" << obs.pixel.y()
                    << " pcx=" << Pc.x()
                    << " pcy=" << Pc.y()
                    << " pcz=" << Pc.z()
                    << " invz=" << invZ
                    << " alpha0=" << alpha0
                    << " alpha1=" << alpha1
                    << " last=" << is_last;
                writeStimulus(oss.str());
            }
            
            wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
            local_row += 2;
        }
        
        // 4. RowBuffer assembles local matrix and feeds systolicarray
        // (hardware automatic, CPU waits for completion)
        
        // 5. Collect new factor from RowBuffer
        wait_until(rowbuf_.new_factor_valid);
        
        // Extract R11 (3x3) and z1 (3) for backsubstitution
        BacksubEntry entry;
        entry.var_id = landmark_id;
        entry.is_landmark = true;
        entry.R11.resize(3, 3);
        entry.z1.resize(3);
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++)
                entry.R11(i,j) = rowbuf_.new_factor_R[i][j];
            entry.z1(i) = rowbuf_.new_factor_z[i];
        }
        backsub_stack_.push_back(entry);
        
        // Extract R22 and z2 (trailing blocks) as new factor connecting poses
        // Store to graph for next round elimination
        // (simplified: assume CPU maintains new factor list)
        
        rowbuf_.new_factor_ready = 1;
    }
    
// eliminatePose implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::eliminatePose(
        int pose_id,
        const std::vector<ImuConstraint>& imu_constraints,
        const std::vector<PriorConstraint>& prior_constraints
    ) {
        // 1. Collect connected poses via IMU
        std::vector<int> connected_poses;
        std::map<int, int> pose_to_trail_slot;
        
        for (auto& imu : imu_constraints) {
            int other_pose = (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id) ? imu.pose_j_id : imu.pose_i_id;
            if (std::find(connected_poses.begin(), connected_poses.end(), other_pose) 
                == connected_poses.end()) {
                pose_to_trail_slot[other_pose] = connected_poses.size();
                connected_poses.push_back(other_pose);
            }
        }
        
        int num_trails = connected_poses.size();
        int local_cols = 6 + 6 * num_trails;  // Panel(6) + Trails(6×N)
        
        // 2. Bundle begin
        axb_.bundle_begin = 1;
        axb_.bundle_panel_cols = 6;  // pose panel is 6 cols
        axb_.bundle_trails_count = num_trails;
        axb_.bundle_local_cols = local_cols;
        axb_.bundle_id = pose_id;
        writeStimulus("BUNDLE_BEGIN POSE " + std::to_string(pose_id) +
                      " PANEL=6 TRAIL=" + std::to_string(num_trails) +
                      " LCOLS=" + std::to_string(local_cols));
        wait_clock();
        axb_.bundle_begin = 0;
        
        // 3. Feed IMU factors
        for (size_t k=0; k<imu_constraints.size(); k++) {
            auto& imu = imu_constraints[k];
            bool is_last = (k == imu_constraints.size()-1) && prior_constraints.empty();
            
            uint8_t col_i = (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id) ? 0 : (6 + 6*pose_to_trail_slot[imu.pose_i_id]);
            uint8_t col_j = (imu.pose_j_id == pose_id) ? 0 : (6 + 6*pose_to_trail_slot[imu.pose_j_id]);
            
            sendImuFactor(imu, col_i, col_j, is_last);
        }
        
        // 4. Feed Prior factors (if any)
        for (size_t k=0; k<prior_constraints.size(); k++) {
            auto& prior = prior_constraints[k];
            bool is_last = (k == prior_constraints.size()-1);
            
            sendPriorFactor(prior, 0, is_last);  // pose_id is panel (col 0-5)
        }
        
        // 5. Collect QR result
        wait_until(rowbuf_.new_factor_valid);
        
        BacksubEntry entry;
        entry.var_id = pose_id;
        entry.is_landmark = false;  // pose is 6 cols
        entry.R11.resize(6, 6);
        entry.z1.resize(6);
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<6; j++)
                entry.R11(i,j) = rowbuf_.new_factor_R[i][j];
            entry.z1(i) = rowbuf_.new_factor_z[i];
        }
        backsub_stack_.push_back(entry);
        
        rowbuf_.new_factor_ready = 1;
    }
// sendImuFactor implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::sendImuFactor(
        const ImuConstraint& imu,
        uint8_t local_col_i,  // pose_i column in local matrix
        uint8_t local_col_j,  // pose_j column in local matrix
        bool is_last_in_bundle
    ) {
        // Get current pose estimates (with safety checks)
        Eigen::Matrix3f Ri = getPoseRotationInternal(imu.pose_i_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f ti = getPoseTranslationInternal(imu.pose_i_id);
        Eigen::Matrix3f Rj = getPoseRotationInternal(imu.pose_j_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f tj = getPoseTranslationInternal(imu.pose_j_id);
        
        // Set factor type
        axb_.factor_valid = 1;
        axb_.factor_type = 1; // IMU
        axb_.local_col_panel = local_col_i;  // pose_i is panel
        axb_.local_col_trail = local_col_j;  // pose_j is trail
        
        // Set whitening coefficients (from IMU covariance)
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            float sigma_val = imu.sigma(i);
            if (sigma_val <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid IMU sigma[" + std::to_string(i) + "] = " + std::to_string(sigma_val));
            }
            axb_.alpha[i] = 1.0f / sigma_val;  // sigma is stddev
        }
        
        // Set IMU payload (matching Axb.sv naming)
        // R0 = Ri, R1 = Rj, Rd = deltaR
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
                axb_.R0[i][j] = Ri(i,j);
                axb_.R1[i][j] = Rj(i,j);
                axb_.Rd[i][j] = imu.deltaR(i,j);
            }
            axb_.t0[i] = ti(i);
            axb_.t1[i] = tj(i);
            axb_.td[i] = imu.deltaT(i);
        }
        
        axb_.bundle_end = is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0;
        {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << std::hexfloat;
            oss << "IMU_FACTOR pose_i=" << imu.pose_i_id
                << " pose_j=" << imu.pose_j_id
                << " col_i=" << static_cast<int>(local_col_i)
                << " col_j=" << static_cast<int>(local_col_j)
                << " last=" << is_last_in_bundle;
            for (int i=0; i<6; ++i) {
                oss << " alpha[" << i << "]=" << axb_.alpha[i];
            }
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
        axb_.factor_valid = 0;
        axb_.bundle_end = 0;
    }
// sendPriorFactor implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::sendPriorFactor(
        const PriorConstraint& prior,
        uint8_t local_col_pose,  // pose column in local matrix
        bool is_last_in_bundle
    ) {
        // Get current pose estimate (with safety checks)
        Eigen::Matrix3f Ri = getPoseRotationInternal(prior.pose_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f ti = getPoseTranslationInternal(prior.pose_id);
        
        // Set factor type
        axb_.factor_valid = 1;
        axb_.factor_type = 2; // Prior
        axb_.local_col_panel = local_col_pose;  // pose is panel
        axb_.local_col_trail = 0;  // No trail for Prior (prior is observation, not variable)
        
        // Set whitening coefficients
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            float sigma_val = prior.sigma(i);
            if (sigma_val <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid Prior sigma[" + std::to_string(i) + "] = " + std::to_string(sigma_val));
            }
            axb_.alpha[i] = 1.0f / sigma_val;
        }
        
        // Set Prior payload
        // Ri = current estimate, Rp/tp = prior observation
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
                axb_.R0[i][j] = prior.Rp(i,j);  // Rp (prior rotation)
                axb_.R1[i][j] = Ri(i,j);         // Ri (current estimate)
            }
            axb_.t0[i] = prior.tp(i);  // tp (prior translation)
            axb_.t1[i] = ti(i);        // ti (current estimate)
        }
        
        axb_.bundle_end = is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0;
        {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << std::hexfloat;
            oss << "PRIOR_FACTOR pose=" << prior.pose_id
                << " last=" << is_last_in_bundle;
            for (int i=0; i<6; ++i) {
                oss << " alpha[" << i << "]=" << axb_.alpha[i];
            }
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
        axb_.factor_valid = 0;
        axb_.bundle_end = 0;
    }
    
// makeImuConstraint implementation
ImuConstraint VariableEliminationDriver::makeImuConstraint(
        int pose_i_id,
        int pose_j_id,
        const std::vector<ImuPreprocessorGTSAM::ImuMeasurement>& imu_segment,
        double dt_total
    ) {
        // Input validation
        if (imu_segment.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Empty IMU segment");
        }
        if (dt_total <= 0.0) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid dt_total: " + std::to_string(dt_total));
        }
        
        // Get current estimate for Ri (needed for g compensation)
        Eigen::Matrix3d Ri_d = getPoseRotationInternal(pose_i_id).cast<double>();
        
        // Call GTSAM preprocessor
        auto imu_output = imu_preprocessor_.getRelativePose(imu_segment, Ri_d, dt_total);
        
        // Convert to ImuConstraint
        ImuConstraint imu;
        imu.pose_i_id = pose_i_id;
        imu.pose_j_id = pose_j_id;
        imu.deltaR = imu_output.deltaR;
        imu.deltaT = imu_output.deltaT;
        imu.sigma = imu_output.sigma;
        
        return imu;
    }
// backsubstitute implementation
std::map<int, Eigen::VectorXf> VariableEliminationDriver::backsubstitute(const Eigen::VectorXf& x_final) {
        std::map<int, Eigen::VectorXf> solution;
        
        // Solve in reverse order
        for (auto it = backsub_stack_.rbegin(); it != backsub_stack_.rend(); ++it) {
            int dim = it->is_landmark ? 3 : 6;
            Eigen::VectorXf delta_var(dim);
            
            // R11 * delta_var = z1 - R12 * (already_solved_vars)
            // Simplified: assume R12 part handled by trail updates
            Eigen::FullPivLU<Eigen::MatrixXf> lu(it->R11);
            if (!lu.isInvertible()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("R11 matrix is singular for variable " + std::to_string(it->var_id));
            }
            delta_var = lu.solve(it->z1);
            solution[it->var_id] = delta_var;
        }
        
        return solution;
    }

// Helper: SO(3) exponential map (Rodriguez formula)
Eigen::Matrix3f so3Exp(const Eigen::Vector3f& omega) {
    float theta = omega.norm();
    if (theta < 1e-6) {
        return Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity();
    }
    
    Eigen::Vector3f axis = omega / theta;
    Eigen::Matrix3f K;
    K << 0, -axis(2), axis(1),
         axis(2), 0, -axis(0),
         -axis(1), axis(0), 0;
    
    return Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity() + 
           std::sin(theta) * K + 
           (1 - std::cos(theta)) * K * K;
}
```

现在更新 `writeStimulus` 函数和相关的 dump 调用，改为输出 hex 格式：

```cpp
/**
 * Variable-wise Elimination Driver Implementation
 * Implements the elimination sequence shown in your diagrams
 */
#include "VariableEliminationDriver.h"
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <cstring>

constexpr bool kEnableStimulusDumpDefault = false;

// Helper: Convert float to IEEE 754 hex string (8 chars, uppercase)
static std::string floatToHex(float f) {
    uint32_t bits;
    std::memcpy(&bits, &f, sizeof(bits));
    char buf[16];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%08X", bits);
    return std::string(buf);
}

// Helper: Write a 32-bit value as hex (for integers)
static std::string uint32ToHex(uint32_t v) {
    char buf[16];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%08X", v);
    return std::string(buf);
}

// Helper: Write a 3x3 matrix as 9 hex floats (row-major)
static std::string mat3ToHex(const float m[3][3]) {
    std::string s;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
            s += floatToHex(m[i][j]) + " ";
    return s;
}

// Helper: Write a 3-element vector as 3 hex floats
static std::string vec3ToHex(const float v[3]) {
    return floatToHex(v[0]) + " " + floatToHex(v[1]) + " " + floatToHex(v[2]) + " ";
}

// Public accessor implementations
void VariableEliminationDriver::setPose(int pose_id, const Eigen::Matrix3f& R, const Eigen::Vector3f& t) {
    poses_R_[pose_id] = R;
    poses_t_[pose_id] = t;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::setLandmark(int landmark_id, const Eigen::Vector3f& pos) {
    landmarks_[landmark_id] = pos;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::enableStimulusDump(const std::string& file_path) {
    stimulus_stream_.open(file_path);
    if (!stimulus_stream_) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Failed to open stimulus dump file: " + file_path);
    }
    dump_enabled_ = true;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::disableStimulusDump() {
    if (stimulus_stream_.is_open()) {
        stimulus_stream_.close();
    }
    dump_enabled_ = false;
}

const Eigen::Matrix3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseRotation(int pose_id) const {
    return poses_R_.at(pose_id);
}

const Eigen::Vector3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseTranslation(int pose_id) const {
    return poses_t_.at(pose_id);
}

const Eigen::Vector3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getLandmark(int landmark_id) const {
    return landmarks_.at(landmark_id);
}

// Private helper implementations
void VariableEliminationDriver::wait_clock() { 
    /* hardware simulation - busy wait to simulate compute cost */ 
    volatile int dummy = 0;
    for(int i=0; i<1000; i++) dummy++;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::wait_until(bool& signal) { 
    while(!signal) wait_clock(); 
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::writeStimulus(const std::string& line) {
    if (dump_enabled_ && stimulus_stream_) {
        stimulus_stream_ << line << "\n";
    }
}

Eigen::Matrix3f VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseRotationInternal(int pose_id) const {
    auto it = poses_R_.find(pose_id);
    if (it == poses_R_.end()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Pose rotation not found for pose_id: " + std::to_string(pose_id));
    }
    return it->second;
}

Eigen::Vector3f VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseTranslationInternal(int pose_id) const {
    auto it = poses_t_.find(pose_id);
    if (it == poses_t_.end()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Pose translation not found for pose_id: " + std::to_string(pose_id));
    }
    return it->second;
}

// eliminateLandmark implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::eliminateLandmark(
        int landmark_id,
        const std::vector<CameraObservation>& observations,
        float huber_delta
    ) {
        // Input validation
        if (observations.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("No observations provided for landmark " + std::to_string(landmark_id));
        }
        if (huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Huber delta must be positive");
        }
        
        // 1. Collect connected poses
        std::vector<int> connected_poses;
        std::map<int, int> pose_to_trail_slot;
        for (auto& obs : observations) {
            if (std::find(connected_poses.begin(), connected_poses.end(), obs.pose_id) == connected_poses.end()) {
                pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id] = connected_poses.size();
                connected_poses.push_back(obs.pose_id);
            }
        }
        
        int num_trails = connected_poses.size();
        int local_cols = 3 + 6 * num_trails;
        int local_rows = observations.size() * 2;
        
        // 2. Bundle begin
        axb_.bundle_begin = 1;
        axb_.bundle_panel_cols = 3;
        axb_.bundle_trails_count = num_trails;
        axb_.bundle_local_cols = local_cols;
        axb_.bundle_id = landmark_id;
        // HEX format: BUNDLE_BEGIN <type:L/P> <id> <panel_cols> <trail_count> <local_cols>
        if (dump_enabled_) {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << "# BUNDLE_BEGIN LANDMARK id=" << landmark_id 
                << " panel=3 trails=" << num_trails << " lcols=" << local_cols << "\n";
            oss << "BB " << uint32ToHex(0) << " " << uint32ToHex(landmark_id) << " "
                << uint32ToHex(3) << " " << uint32ToHex(num_trails) << " " << uint32ToHex(local_cols);
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_clock();
        axb_.bundle_begin = 0;
        
        // 3. Feed each observation
        int local_row = 0;
        for (int k=0; k<observations.size(); k++) {
            auto& obs = observations[k];
            bool is_last = (k == observations.size() - 1);
            
            // Compute Pc and invZ
            Eigen::Vector3f Pc = obs.Rcw * obs.lw + obs.tcw;
            float Pc_z = Pc.z();
            if (std::abs(Pc_z) < 1e-6f) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Point behind camera or at infinity (Pc.z = " + std::to_string(Pc_z) + ")");
            }
            float invZ = 1.0f / Pc_z;
            
            // Compute residual for Huber weight (CPU side)
            Eigen::Vector2f z_pred;
            z_pred << obs.fx * Pc.x() * invZ + obs.cx,
                     obs.fy * Pc.y() * invZ + obs.cy;
            Eigen::Vector2f r = obs.pixel - z_pred;
            float sigma_pixel = obs.sigma_pixel;
            if (sigma_pixel <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid sigma_pixel: " + std::to_string(sigma_pixel));
            }
            Eigen::Vector2f r_hat = r / sigma_pixel;
            float rho = r_hat.norm();
            float w = (rho <= huber_delta) ? 1.0f : (huber_delta / rho);
            float alpha0 = w / sigma_pixel;
            float alpha1 = w / sigma_pixel;
            
            // Feed to Axb
            axb_.factor_valid = 1;
            axb_.factor_type = 0; // Camera
            axb_.local_col_panel = 0;  // landmark panel at local[0:2]
            axb_.local_col_trail = 3 + 6 * pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id]; // pose trail slot
            axb_.alpha[0] = alpha0;
            axb_.alpha[1] = alpha1;
            axb_.cam_fx = obs.fx;
            axb_.cam_fy = obs.fy;
            axb_.cam_cx = obs.cx;
            axb_.cam_cy = obs.cy;
            axb_.cam_z_u = obs.pixel.x();
            axb_.cam_z_v = obs.pixel.y();
            axb_.cam_Pc_X = Pc.x();
            axb_.cam_Pc_Y = Pc.y();
            axb_.cam_Pc_Z = Pc.z();
            axb_.cam_Pc_invZ = invZ;
            for (int i=0; i<3; i++)
                for (int j=0; j<3; j++)
                    axb_.cam_Rcw[i][j] = obs.Rcw(i,j);
            axb_.bundle_end = is_last ? 1 : 0;
            {
                std::ostringstream oss;
                oss << std::hexfloat;
                oss << "LANDMARK_OBS id=" << landmark_id
                    << " pose=" << obs.pose_id
                    << " trail=" << pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id]
                    << " fx=" << obs.fx << " fy=" << obs.fy
                    << " cx=" << obs.cx << " cy=" << obs.cy
                    << " zu=" << obs.pixel.x()
                    << " zv=" << obs.pixel.y()
                    << " pcx=" << Pc.x()
                    << " pcy=" << Pc.y()
                    << " pcz=" << Pc.z()
                    << " invz=" << invZ
                    << " alpha0=" << alpha0
                    << " alpha1=" << alpha1
                    << " last=" << is_last;
                writeStimulus(oss.str());
            }
            
            wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
            local_row += 2;
        }
        
        // 4. RowBuffer assembles local matrix and feeds systolicarray
        // (hardware automatic, CPU waits for completion)
        
        // 5. Collect new factor from RowBuffer
        wait_until(rowbuf_.new_factor_valid);
        
        // Extract R11 (3x3) and z1 (3) for backsubstitution
        BacksubEntry entry;
        entry.var_id = landmark_id;
        entry.is_landmark = true;
        entry.R11.resize(3, 3);
        entry.z1.resize(3);
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++)
                entry.R11(i,j) = rowbuf_.new_factor_R[i][j];
            entry.z1(i) = rowbuf_.new_factor_z[i];
        }
        backsub_stack_.push_back(entry);
        
        // Extract R22 and z2 (trailing blocks) as new factor connecting poses
        // Store to graph for next round elimination
        // (simplified: assume CPU maintains new factor list)
        
        rowbuf_.new_factor_ready = 1;
    }
    
// eliminatePose implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::eliminatePose(
        int pose_id,
        const std::vector<ImuConstraint>& imu_constraints,
        const std::vector<PriorConstraint>& prior_constraints
    ) {
        // 1. Collect connected poses via IMU
        std::vector<int> connected_poses;
        std::map<int, int> pose_to_trail_slot;
        
        for (auto& imu : imu_constraints) {
            int other_pose = (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id) ? imu.pose_j_id : imu.pose_i_id;
            if (std::find(connected_poses.begin(), connected_poses.end(), other_pose) 
                == connected_poses.end()) {
                pose_to_trail_slot[other_pose] = connected_poses.size();
                connected_poses.push_back(other_pose);
            }
        }
        
        int num_trails = connected_poses.size();
        int local_cols = 6 + 6 * num_trails;  // Panel(6) + Trails(6×N)
        
        // 2. Bundle begin
        axb_.bundle_begin = 1;
        axb_.bundle_panel_cols = 6;  // pose panel is 6 cols
        axb_.bundle_trails_count = num_trails;
        axb_.bundle_local_cols = local_cols;
        axb_.bundle_id = pose_id;
        writeStimulus("BUNDLE_BEGIN POSE " + std::to_string(pose_id) +
                      " PANEL=6 TRAIL=" + std::to_string(num_trails) +
                      " LCOLS=" + std::to_string(local_cols));
        wait_clock();
        axb_.bundle_begin = 0;
        
        // 3. Feed IMU factors
        for (size_t k=0; k<imu_constraints.size(); k++) {
            auto& imu = imu_constraints[k];
            bool is_last = (k == imu_constraints.size()-1) && prior_constraints.empty();
            
            uint8_t col_i = (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id) ? 0 : (6 + 6*pose_to_trail_slot[imu.pose_i_id]);
            uint8_t col_j = (imu.pose_j_id == pose_id) ? 0 : (6 + 6*pose_to_trail_slot[imu.pose_j_id]);
            
            sendImuFactor(imu, col_i, col_j, is_last);
        }
        
        // 4. Feed Prior factors (if any)
        for (size_t k=0; k<prior_constraints.size(); k++) {
            auto& prior = prior_constraints[k];
            bool is_last = (k == prior_constraints.size()-1);
            
            sendPriorFactor(prior, 0, is_last);  // pose_id is panel (col 0-5)
        }
        
        // 5. Collect QR result
        wait_until(rowbuf_.new_factor_valid);
        
        BacksubEntry entry;
        entry.var_id = pose_id;
        entry.is_landmark = false;  // pose is 6 cols
        entry.R11.resize(6, 6);
        entry.z1.resize(6);
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<6; j++)
                entry.R11(i,j) = rowbuf_.new_factor_R[i][j];
            entry.z1(i) = rowbuf_.new_factor_z[i];
        }
        backsub_stack_.push_back(entry);
        
        rowbuf_.new_factor_ready = 1;
    }
// sendImuFactor implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::sendImuFactor(
        const ImuConstraint& imu,
        uint8_t local_col_i,  // pose_i column in local matrix
        uint8_t local_col_j,  // pose_j column in local matrix
        bool is_last_in_bundle
    ) {
        // Get current pose estimates (with safety checks)
        Eigen::Matrix3f Ri = getPoseRotationInternal(imu.pose_i_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f ti = getPoseTranslationInternal(imu.pose_i_id);
        Eigen::Matrix3f Rj = getPoseRotationInternal(imu.pose_j_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f tj = getPoseTranslationInternal(imu.pose_j_id);
        
        // Set factor type
        axb_.factor_valid = 1;
        axb_.factor_type = 1; // IMU
        axb_.local_col_panel = local_col_i;  // pose_i is panel
        axb_.local_col_trail = local_col_j;  // pose_j is trail
        
        // Set whitening coefficients (from IMU covariance)
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            float sigma_val = imu.sigma(i);
            if (sigma_val <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid IMU sigma[" + std::to_string(i) + "] = " + std::to_string(sigma_val));
            }
            axb_.alpha[i] = 1.0f / sigma_val;  // sigma is stddev
        }
        
        // Set IMU payload (matching Axb.sv naming)
        // R0 = Ri, R1 = Rj, Rd = deltaR
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
                axb_.R0[i][j] = Ri(i,j);
                axb_.R1[i][j] = Rj(i,j);
                axb_.Rd[i][j] = imu.deltaR(i,j);
            }
            axb_.t0[i] = ti(i);
            axb_.t1[i] = tj(i);
            axb_.td[i] = imu.deltaT(i);
        }
        
        axb_.bundle_end = is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0;
        {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << std::hexfloat;
            oss << "IMU_FACTOR pose_i=" << imu.pose_i_id
                << " pose_j=" << imu.pose_j_id
                << " col_i=" << static_cast<int>(local_col_i)
                << " col_j=" << static_cast<int>(local_col_j)
                << " last=" << is_last_in_bundle;
            for (int i=0; i<6; ++i) {
                oss << " alpha[" << i << "]=" << axb_.alpha[i];
            }
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
        axb_.factor_valid = 0;
        axb_.bundle_end = 0;
    }
// sendPriorFactor implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::sendPriorFactor(
        const PriorConstraint& prior,
        uint8_t local_col_pose,  // pose column in local matrix
        bool is_last_in_bundle
    ) {
        // Get current pose estimate (with safety checks)
        Eigen::Matrix3f Ri = getPoseRotationInternal(prior.pose_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f ti = getPoseTranslationInternal(prior.pose_id);
        
        // Set factor type
        axb_.factor_valid = 1;
        axb_.factor_type = 2; // Prior
        axb_.local_col_panel = local_col_pose;  // pose is panel
        axb_.local_col_trail = 0;  // No trail for Prior (prior is observation, not variable)
        
        // Set whitening coefficients
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            float sigma_val = prior.sigma(i);
            if (sigma_val <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid Prior sigma[" + std::to_string(i) + "] = " + std::to_string(sigma_val));
            }
            axb_.alpha[i] = 1.0f / sigma_val;
        }
        
        // Set Prior payload
        // Ri = current estimate, Rp/tp = prior observation
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
                axb_.R0[i][j] = prior.Rp(i,j);  // Rp (prior rotation)
                axb_.R1[i][j] = Ri(i,j);         // Ri (current estimate)
            }
            axb_.t0[i] = prior.tp(i);  // tp (prior translation)
            axb_.t1[i] = ti(i);        // ti (current estimate)
        }
        
        axb_.bundle_end = is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0;
        {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << std::hexfloat;
            oss << "PRIOR_FACTOR pose=" << prior.pose_id
                << " last=" << is_last_in_bundle;
            for (int i=0; i<6; ++i) {
                oss << " alpha[" << i << "]=" << axb_.alpha[i];
            }
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
        axb_.factor_valid = 0;
        axb_.bundle_end = 0;
    }
    
// makeImuConstraint implementation
ImuConstraint VariableEliminationDriver::makeImuConstraint(
        int pose_i_id,
        int pose_j_id,
        const std::vector<ImuPreprocessorGTSAM::ImuMeasurement>& imu_segment,
        double dt_total
    ) {
        // Input validation
        if (imu_segment.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Empty IMU segment");
        }
        if (dt_total <= 0.0) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid dt_total: " + std::to_string(dt_total));
        }
        
        // Get current estimate for Ri (needed for g compensation)
        Eigen::Matrix3d Ri_d = getPoseRotationInternal(pose_i_id).cast<double>();
        
        // Call GTSAM preprocessor
        auto imu_output = imu_preprocessor_.getRelativePose(imu_segment, Ri_d, dt_total);
        
        // Convert to ImuConstraint
        ImuConstraint imu;
        imu.pose_i_id = pose_i_id;
        imu.pose_j_id = pose_j_id;
        imu.deltaR = imu_output.deltaR;
        imu.deltaT = imu_output.deltaT;
        imu.sigma = imu_output.sigma;
        
        return imu;
    }
// backsubstitute implementation
std::map<int, Eigen::VectorXf> VariableEliminationDriver::backsubstitute(const Eigen::VectorXf& x_final) {
        std::map<int, Eigen::VectorXf> solution;
        
        // Solve in reverse order
        for (auto it = backsub_stack_.rbegin(); it != backsub_stack_.rend(); ++it) {
            int dim = it->is_landmark ? 3 : 6;
            Eigen::VectorXf delta_var(dim);
            
            // R11 * delta_var = z1 - R12 * (already_solved_vars)
            // Simplified: assume R12 part handled by trail updates
            Eigen::FullPivLU<Eigen::MatrixXf> lu(it->R11);
            if (!lu.isInvertible()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("R11 matrix is singular for variable " + std::to_string(it->var_id));
            }
            delta_var = lu.solve(it->z1);
            solution[it->var_id] = delta_var;
        }
        
        return solution;
    }

// Helper: SO(3) exponential map (Rodriguez formula)
Eigen::Matrix3f so3Exp(const Eigen::Vector3f& omega) {
    float theta = omega.norm();
    if (theta < 1e-6) {
        return Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity();
    }
    
    Eigen::Vector3f axis = omega / theta;
    Eigen::Matrix3f K;
    K << 0, -axis(2), axis(1),
         axis(2), 0, -axis(0),
         -axis(1), axis(0), 0;
    
    return Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity() + 
           std::sin(theta) * K + 
           (1 - std::cos(theta)) * K * K;
}
```

```cpp
/**
 * Variable-wise Elimination Driver Implementation
 * Implements the elimination sequence shown in your diagrams
 */
#include "VariableEliminationDriver.h"
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <cstring>

constexpr bool kEnableStimulusDumpDefault = false;

// Helper: Convert float to IEEE 754 hex string (8 chars, uppercase)
static std::string floatToHex(float f) {
    uint32_t bits;
    std::memcpy(&bits, &f, sizeof(bits));
    char buf[16];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%08X", bits);
    return std::string(buf);
}

// Helper: Write a 32-bit value as hex (for integers)
static std::string uint32ToHex(uint32_t v) {
    char buf[16];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%08X", v);
    return std::string(buf);
}

// Helper: Write a 3x3 matrix as 9 hex floats (row-major)
static std::string mat3ToHex(const float m[3][3]) {
    std::string s;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
            s += floatToHex(m[i][j]) + " ";
    return s;
}

// Helper: Write a 3-element vector as 3 hex floats
static std::string vec3ToHex(const float v[3]) {
    return floatToHex(v[0]) + " " + floatToHex(v[1]) + " " + floatToHex(v[2]) + " ";
}

// Public accessor implementations
void VariableEliminationDriver::setPose(int pose_id, const Eigen::Matrix3f& R, const Eigen::Vector3f& t) {
    poses_R_[pose_id] = R;
    poses_t_[pose_id] = t;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::setLandmark(int landmark_id, const Eigen::Vector3f& pos) {
    landmarks_[landmark_id] = pos;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::enableStimulusDump(const std::string& file_path) {
    stimulus_stream_.open(file_path);
    if (!stimulus_stream_) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Failed to open stimulus dump file: " + file_path);
    }
    dump_enabled_ = true;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::disableStimulusDump() {
    if (stimulus_stream_.is_open()) {
        stimulus_stream_.close();
    }
    dump_enabled_ = false;
}

const Eigen::Matrix3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseRotation(int pose_id) const {
    return poses_R_.at(pose_id);
}

const Eigen::Vector3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseTranslation(int pose_id) const {
    return poses_t_.at(pose_id);
}

const Eigen::Vector3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getLandmark(int landmark_id) const {
    return landmarks_.at(landmark_id);
}

// Private helper implementations
void VariableEliminationDriver::wait_clock() { 
    /* hardware simulation - busy wait to simulate compute cost */ 
    volatile int dummy = 0;
    for(int i=0; i<1000; i++) dummy++;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::wait_until(bool& signal) { 
    while(!signal) wait_clock(); 
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::writeStimulus(const std::string& line) {
    if (dump_enabled_ && stimulus_stream_) {
        stimulus_stream_ << line << "\n";
    }
}

Eigen::Matrix3f VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseRotationInternal(int pose_id) const {
    auto it = poses_R_.find(pose_id);
    if (it == poses_R_.end()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Pose rotation not found for pose_id: " + std::to_string(pose_id));
    }
    return it->second;
}

Eigen::Vector3f VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseTranslationInternal(int pose_id) const {
    auto it = poses_t_.find(pose_id);
    if (it == poses_t_.end()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Pose translation not found for pose_id: " + std::to_string(pose_id));
    }
    return it->second;
}

// eliminateLandmark implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::eliminateLandmark(
        int landmark_id,
        const std::vector<CameraObservation>& observations,
        float huber_delta
    ) {
        // Input validation
        if (observations.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("No observations provided for landmark " + std::to_string(landmark_id));
        }
        if (huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Huber delta must be positive");
        }
        
        // 1. Collect connected poses
        std::vector<int> connected_poses;
        std::map<int, int> pose_to_trail_slot;
        for (auto& obs : observations) {
            if (std::find(connected_poses.begin(), connected_poses.end(), obs.pose_id) == connected_poses.end()) {
                pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id] = connected_poses.size();
                connected_poses.push_back(obs.pose_id);
            }
        }
        
        int num_trails = connected_poses.size();
        int local_cols = 3 + 6 * num_trails;
        int local_rows = observations.size() * 2;
        
        // 2. Bundle begin
        axb_.bundle_begin = 1;
        axb_.bundle_panel_cols = 3;
        axb_.bundle_trails_count = num_trails;
        axb_.bundle_local_cols = local_cols;
        axb_.bundle_id = landmark_id;
        // HEX format: BUNDLE_BEGIN <type:L/P> <id> <panel_cols> <trail_count> <local_cols>
        if (dump_enabled_) {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << "# BUNDLE_BEGIN LANDMARK id=" << landmark_id 
                << " panel=3 trails=" << num_trails << " lcols=" << local_cols << "\n";
            oss << "BB " << uint32ToHex(0) << " " << uint32ToHex(landmark_id) << " "
                << uint32ToHex(3) << " " << uint32ToHex(num_trails) << " " << uint32ToHex(local_cols);
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_clock();
        axb_.bundle_begin = 0;
        
        // 3. Feed each observation
        int local_row = 0;
        for (int k=0; k<observations.size(); k++) {
            auto& obs = observations[k];
            bool is_last = (k == observations.size() - 1);
            
            // Compute Pc and invZ
            Eigen::Vector3f Pc = obs.Rcw * obs.lw + obs.tcw;
            float Pc_z = Pc.z();
            if (std::abs(Pc_z) < 1e-6f) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Point behind camera or at infinity (Pc.z = " + std::to_string(Pc_z) + ")");
            }
            float invZ = 1.0f / Pc_z;
            
            // Compute residual for Huber weight (CPU side)
            Eigen::Vector2f z_pred;
            z_pred << obs.fx * Pc.x() * invZ + obs.cx,
                     obs.fy * Pc.y() * invZ + obs.cy;
            Eigen::Vector2f r = obs.pixel - z_pred;
            float sigma_pixel = obs.sigma_pixel;
            if (sigma_pixel <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid sigma_pixel: " + std::to_string(sigma_pixel));
            }
            Eigen::Vector2f r_hat = r / sigma_pixel;
            float rho = r_hat.norm();
            float w = (rho <= huber_delta) ? 1.0f : (huber_delta / rho);
            float alpha0 = w / sigma_pixel;
            float alpha1 = w / sigma_pixel;
            
            // Feed to Axb
            axb_.factor_valid = 1;
            axb_.factor_type = 0; // Camera
            axb_.local_col_panel = 0;  // landmark panel at local[0:2]
            axb_.local_col_trail = 3 + 6 * pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id]; // pose trail slot
            axb_.alpha[0] = alpha0;
            axb_.alpha[1] = alpha1;
            axb_.cam_fx = obs.fx;
            axb_.cam_fy = obs.fy;
            axb_.cam_cx = obs.cx;
            axb_.cam_cy = obs.cy;
            axb_.cam_z_u = obs.pixel.x();
            axb_.cam_z_v = obs.pixel.y();
            axb_.cam_Pc_X = Pc.x();
            axb_.cam_Pc_Y = Pc.y();
            axb_.cam_Pc_Z = Pc.z();
            axb_.cam_Pc_invZ = invZ;
            for (int i=0; i<3; i++)
                for (int j=0; j<3; j++)
                    axb_.cam_Rcw[i][j] = obs.Rcw(i,j);
            axb_.bundle_end = is_last ? 1 : 0;
            // HEX format for Camera factor:
            // CAM <factor_type=0> <local_col_panel> <local_col_trail> <alpha0..5> <cam_fx..cam_Rcw[2][2]> <bundle_end>
            if (dump_enabled_) {
                std::ostringstream oss;
                oss << "# CAM lm=" << landmark_id << " pose=" << obs.pose_id << " last=" << is_last << "\n";
                oss << "FA 00000000 " // factor_type = 0 (Camera)
                    << uint32ToHex(axb_.local_col_panel) << " "
                    << uint32ToHex(axb_.local_col_trail) << " ";
                // Alpha[0..5]
                for (int ai = 0; ai < 6; ++ai) oss << floatToHex(axb_.alpha[ai]) << " ";
                // Camera payload: fx, fy, cx, cy, z_u, z_v, Pc_X, Pc_Y, Pc_Z, Pc_invZ
                oss << floatToHex(axb_.cam_fx) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_fy) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_cx) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_cy) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_z_u) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_z_v) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_X) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_Y) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_Z) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_invZ) << " ";
                // Rcw[3][3]
                for (int ri = 0; ri < 3; ++ri)
                    for (int rj = 0; rj < 3; ++rj)
                        oss << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Rcw[ri][rj]) << " ";
                oss << uint32ToHex(is_last ? 1 : 0);
                writeStimulus(oss.str());
            }
            
            wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
            local_row += 2;
        }
        
        // 4. RowBuffer assembles local matrix and feeds systolicarray
        // (hardware automatic, CPU waits for completion)
        
        // 5. Collect new factor from RowBuffer
        wait_until(rowbuf_.new_factor_valid);
        
        // Extract R11 (3x3) and z1 (3) for backsubstitution
        BacksubEntry entry;
        entry.var_id = landmark_id;
        entry.is_landmark = true;
        entry.R11.resize(3, 3);
        entry.z1.resize(3);
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++)
                entry.R11(i,j) = rowbuf_.new_factor_R[i][j];
            entry.z1(i) = rowbuf_.new_factor_z[i];
        }
        backsub_stack_.push_back(entry);
        
        // Extract R22 and z2 (trailing blocks) as new factor connecting poses
        // Store to graph for next round elimination
        // (simplified: assume CPU maintains new factor list)
        
        rowbuf_.new_factor_ready = 1;
    }
    
// eliminatePose implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::eliminatePose(
        int pose_id,
        const std::vector<ImuConstraint>& imu_constraints,
        const std::vector<PriorConstraint>& prior_constraints
    ) {
        // 1. Collect connected poses via IMU
        std::vector<int> connected_poses;
        std::map<int, int> pose_to_trail_slot;
        
        for (auto& imu : imu_constraints) {
            int other_pose = (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id) ? imu.pose_j_id : imu.pose_i_id;
            if (std::find(connected_poses.begin(), connected_poses.end(), other_pose) 
                == connected_poses.end()) {
                pose_to_trail_slot[other_pose] = connected_poses.size();
                connected_poses.push_back(other_pose);
            }
        }
        
        int num_trails = connected_poses.size();
        int local_cols = 6 + 6 * num_trails;  // Panel(6) + Trails(6×N)
        
        // 2. Bundle begin
        axb_.bundle_begin = 1;
        axb_.bundle_panel_cols = 6;  // pose panel is 6 cols
        axb_.bundle_trails_count = num_trails;
        axb_.bundle_local_cols = local_cols;
        axb_.bundle_id = pose_id;
        writeStimulus("BUNDLE_BEGIN POSE " + std::to_string(pose_id) +
                      " PANEL=6 TRAIL=" + std::to_string(num_trails) +
                      " LCOLS=" + std::to_string(local_cols));
        wait_clock();
        axb_.bundle_begin = 0;
        
        // 3. Feed IMU factors
        for (size_t k=0; k<imu_constraints.size(); k++) {
            auto& imu = imu_constraints[k];
            bool is_last = (k == imu_constraints.size()-1) && prior_constraints.empty();
            
            uint8_t col_i = (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id) ? 0 : (6 + 6*pose_to_trail_slot[imu.pose_i_id]);
            uint8_t col_j = (imu.pose_j_id == pose_id) ? 0 : (6 + 6*pose_to_trail_slot[imu.pose_j_id]);
            
            sendImuFactor(imu, col_i, col_j, is_last);
        }
        
        // 4. Feed Prior factors (if any)
        for (size_t k=0; k<prior_constraints.size(); k++) {
            auto& prior = prior_constraints[k];
            bool is_last = (k == prior_constraints.size()-1);
            
            sendPriorFactor(prior, 0, is_last);  // pose_id is panel (col 0-5)
        }
        
        // 5. Collect QR result
        wait_until(rowbuf_.new_factor_valid);
        
        BacksubEntry entry;
        entry.var_id = pose_id;
        entry.is_landmark = false;  // pose is 6 cols
        entry.R11.resize(6, 6);
        entry.z1.resize(6);
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<6; j++)
                entry.R11(i,j) = rowbuf_.new_factor_R[i][j];
            entry.z1(i) = rowbuf_.new_factor_z[i];
        }
        backsub_stack_.push_back(entry);
        
        rowbuf_.new_factor_ready = 1;
    }
// sendImuFactor implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::sendImuFactor(
        const ImuConstraint& imu,
        uint8_t local_col_i,  // pose_i column in local matrix
        uint8_t local_col_j,  // pose_j column in local matrix
        bool is_last_in_bundle
    ) {
        // Get current pose estimates (with safety checks)
        Eigen::Matrix3f Ri = getPoseRotationInternal(imu.pose_i_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f ti = getPoseTranslationInternal(imu.pose_i_id);
        Eigen::Matrix3f Rj = getPoseRotationInternal(imu.pose_j_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f tj = getPoseTranslationInternal(imu.pose_j_id);
        
        // Set factor type
        axb_.factor_valid = 1;
        axb_.factor_type = 1; // IMU
        axb_.local_col_panel = local_col_i;  // pose_i is panel
        axb_.local_col_trail = local_col_j;  // pose_j is trail
        
        // Set whitening coefficients (from IMU covariance)
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            float sigma_val = imu.sigma(i);
            if (sigma_val <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid IMU sigma[" + std::to_string(i) + "] = " + std::to_string(sigma_val));
            }
            axb_.alpha[i] = 1.0f / sigma_val;  // sigma is stddev
        }
        
        // Set IMU payload (matching Axb.sv naming)
        // R0 = Ri, R1 = Rj, Rd = deltaR
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
                axb_.R0[i][j] = Ri(i,j);
                axb_.R1[i][j] = Rj(i,j);
                axb_.Rd[i][j] = imu.deltaR(i,j);
            }
            axb_.t0[i] = ti(i);
            axb_.t1[i] = tj(i);
            axb_.td[i] = imu.deltaT(i);
        }
        
        axb_.bundle_end = is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0;
        {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << std::hexfloat;
            oss << "IMU_FACTOR pose_i=" << imu.pose_i_id
                << " pose_j=" << imu.pose_j_id
                << " col_i=" << static_cast<int>(local_col_i)
                << " col_j=" << static_cast<int>(local_col_j)
                << " last=" << is_last_in_bundle;
            for (int i=0; i<6; ++i) {
                oss << " alpha[" << i << "]=" << axb_.alpha[i];
            }
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
        axb_.factor_valid = 0;
        axb_.bundle_end = 0;
    }
// sendPriorFactor implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::sendPriorFactor(
        const PriorConstraint& prior,
        uint8_t local_col_pose,  // pose column in local matrix
        bool is_last_in_bundle
    ) {
        // Get current pose estimate (with safety checks)
        Eigen::Matrix3f Ri = getPoseRotationInternal(prior.pose_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f ti = getPoseTranslationInternal(prior.pose_id);
        
        // Set factor type
        axb_.factor_valid = 1;
        axb_.factor_type = 2; // Prior
        axb_.local_col_panel = local_col_pose;  // pose is panel
        axb_.local_col_trail = 0;  // No trail for Prior (prior is observation, not variable)
        
        // Set whitening coefficients
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            float sigma_val = prior.sigma(i);
            if (sigma_val <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid Prior sigma[" + std::to_string(i) + "] = " + std::to_string(sigma_val));
            }
            axb_.alpha[i] = 1.0f / sigma_val;
        }
        
        // Set Prior payload
        // Ri = current estimate, Rp/tp = prior observation
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
                axb_.R0[i][j] = prior.Rp(i,j);  // Rp (prior rotation)
                axb_.R1[i][j] = Ri(i,j);         // Ri (current estimate)
            }
            axb_.t0[i] = prior.tp(i);  // tp (prior translation)
            axb_.t1[i] = ti(i);        // ti (current estimate)
        }
        
        axb_.bundle_end = is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0;
        {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << std::hexfloat;
            oss << "PRIOR_FACTOR pose=" << prior.pose_id
                << " last=" << is_last_in_bundle;
            for (int i=0; i<6; ++i) {
                oss << " alpha[" << i << "]=" << axb_.alpha[i];
            }
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
        axb_.factor_valid = 0;
        axb_.bundle_end = 0;
    }
    
// makeImuConstraint implementation
ImuConstraint VariableEliminationDriver::makeImuConstraint(
        int pose_i_id,
        int pose_j_id,
        const std::vector<ImuPreprocessorGTSAM::ImuMeasurement>& imu_segment,
        double dt_total
    ) {
        // Input validation
        if (imu_segment.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Empty IMU segment");
        }
        if (dt_total <= 0.0) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid dt_total: " + std::to_string(dt_total));
        }
        
        // Get current estimate for Ri (needed for g compensation)
        Eigen::Matrix3d Ri_d = getPoseRotationInternal(pose_i_id).cast<double>();
        
        // Call GTSAM preprocessor
        auto imu_output = imu_preprocessor_.getRelativePose(imu_segment, Ri_d, dt_total);
        
        // Convert to ImuConstraint
        ImuConstraint imu;
        imu.pose_i_id = pose_i_id;
        imu.pose_j_id = pose_j_id;
        imu.deltaR = imu_output.deltaR;
        imu.deltaT = imu_output.deltaT;
        imu.sigma = imu_output.sigma;
        
        return imu;
    }
// backsubstitute implementation
std::map<int, Eigen::VectorXf> VariableEliminationDriver::backsubstitute(const Eigen::VectorXf& x_final) {
        std::map<int, Eigen::VectorXf> solution;
        
        // Solve in reverse order
        for (auto it = backsub_stack_.rbegin(); it != backsub_stack_.rend(); ++it) {
            int dim = it->is_landmark ? 3 : 6;
            Eigen::VectorXf delta_var(dim);
            
            // R11 * delta_var = z1 - R12 * (already_solved_vars)
            // Simplified: assume R12 part handled by trail updates
            Eigen::FullPivLU<Eigen::MatrixXf> lu(it->R11);
            if (!lu.isInvertible()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("R11 matrix is singular for variable " + std::to_string(it->var_id));
            }
            delta_var = lu.solve(it->z1);
            solution[it->var_id] = delta_var;
        }
        
        return solution;
    }

// Helper: SO(3) exponential map (Rodriguez formula)
Eigen::Matrix3f so3Exp(const Eigen::Vector3f& omega) {
    float theta = omega.norm();
    if (theta < 1e-6) {
        return Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity();
    }
    
    Eigen::Vector3f axis = omega / theta;
    Eigen::Matrix3f K;
    K << 0, -axis(2), axis(1),
         axis(2), 0, -axis(0),
         -axis(1), axis(0), 0;
    
    return Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity() + 
           std::sin(theta) * K + 
           (1 - std::cos(theta)) * K * K;
}

/**
```
```cpp
 * Variable-wise Elimination Driver Implementation
 * Implements the elimination sequence shown in your diagrams
 */
#include "VariableEliminationDriver.h"
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <cstring>

constexpr bool kEnableStimulusDumpDefault = false;

// Helper: Convert float to IEEE 754 hex string (8 chars, uppercase)
static std::string floatToHex(float f) {
    uint32_t bits;
    std::memcpy(&bits, &f, sizeof(bits));
    char buf[16];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%08X", bits);
    return std::string(buf);
}

// Helper: Write a 32-bit value as hex (for integers)
static std::string uint32ToHex(uint32_t v) {
    char buf[16];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%08X", v);
    return std::string(buf);
}

// Helper: Write a 3x3 matrix as 9 hex floats (row-major)
static std::string mat3ToHex(const float m[3][3]) {
    std::string s;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
            s += floatToHex(m[i][j]) + " ";
    return s;
}

// Helper: Write a 3-element vector as 3 hex floats
static std::string vec3ToHex(const float v[3]) {
    return floatToHex(v[0]) + " " + floatToHex(v[1]) + " " + floatToHex(v[2]) + " ";
}

// Public accessor implementations
void VariableEliminationDriver::setPose(int pose_id, const Eigen::Matrix3f& R, const Eigen::Vector3f& t) {

    poses_t_[pose_id] = t;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::setLandmark(int landmark_id, const Eigen::Vector3f& pos) {

}

void VariableEliminationDriver::enableStimulusDump(const std::string& file_path) {
    stimulus_stream_.open(file_path);
    if (!stimulus_stream_) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Failed to open stimulus dump file: " + file_path);
    }
    dump_enabled_ = true;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::disableStimulusDump() {
    if (stimulus_stream_.is_open()) {
        stimulus_stream_.close();
    }
    dump_enabled_ = false;
}

const Eigen::Matrix3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseRotation(int pose_id) const {
    return poses_R_.at(pose_id);
}

    return poses_t_.at(pose_id);
}

const Eigen::Vector3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getLandmark(int landmark_id) const {
```
