```cpp
}

// Private helper implementations
void VariableEliminationDriver::wait_clock() { 
    /* hardware simulation - busy wait to simulate compute cost */ 
    volatile int dummy = 0;
    for(int i=0; i<1000; i++) dummy++;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::wait_until(bool& signal) { 
    while(!signal) wait_clock(); 
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::writeStimulus(const std::string& line) {
    if (dump_enabled_ && stimulus_stream_) {
        stimulus_stream_ << line << "\n";
    }
}

Eigen::Matrix3f VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseRotationInternal(int pose_id) const {
    auto it = poses_R_.find(pose_id);
    if (it == poses_R_.end()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Pose rotation not found for pose_id: " + std::to_string(pose_id));
    }
    return it->second;
}

Eigen::Vector3f VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseTranslationInternal(int pose_id) const {
    auto it = poses_t_.find(pose_id);
    if (it == poses_t_.end()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Pose translation not found for pose_id: " + std::to_string(pose_id));
    }
    return it->second;
}

// eliminateLandmark implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::eliminateLandmark(
        int landmark_id,
        const std::vector<CameraObservation>& observations,
        float huber_delta
    ) {
        // Input validation
        if (observations.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("No observations provided for landmark " + std::to_string(landmark_id));
        }
        if (huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Huber delta must be positive");
        }
        
        // 1. Collect connected poses
        std::vector<int> connected_poses;
        std::map<int, int> pose_to_trail_slot;
        for (auto& obs : observations) {
            if (std::find(connected_poses.begin(), connected_poses.end(), obs.pose_id) == connected_poses.end()) {
                pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id] = connected_poses.size();
                connected_poses.push_back(obs.pose_id);
            }
        }
        
        int num_trails = connected_poses.size();
        int local_cols = 3 + 6 * num_trails;
        int local_rows = observations.size() * 2;
        
        // 2. Bundle begin
        axb_.bundle_begin = 1;
        axb_.bundle_panel_cols = 3;
        axb_.bundle_trails_count = num_trails;
        axb_.bundle_local_cols = local_cols;
        axb_.bundle_id = landmark_id;
        // HEX format: BUNDLE_BEGIN <type:L/P> <id> <panel_cols> <trail_count> <local_cols>
        if (dump_enabled_) {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << "# BUNDLE_BEGIN LANDMARK id=" << landmark_id 
                << " panel=3 trails=" << num_trails << " lcols=" << local_cols << "\n";
            oss << "BB " << uint32ToHex(0) << " " << uint32ToHex(landmark_id) << " "
                << uint32ToHex(3) << " " << uint32ToHex(num_trails) << " " << uint32ToHex(local_cols);
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_clock();
        axb_.bundle_begin = 0;
        
        // 3. Feed each observation
        int local_row = 0;
        for (int k=0; k<observations.size(); k++) {
            auto& obs = observations[k];
            bool is_last = (k == observations.size() - 1);
            
            // Compute Pc and invZ
            Eigen::Vector3f Pc = obs.Rcw * obs.lw + obs.tcw;
            float Pc_z = Pc.z();
            if (std::abs(Pc_z) < 1e-6f) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Point behind camera or at infinity (Pc.z = " + std::to_string(Pc_z) + ")");
            }
            float invZ = 1.0f / Pc_z;
            
            // Compute residual for Huber weight (CPU side)
            Eigen::Vector2f z_pred;
            z_pred << obs.fx * Pc.x() * invZ + obs.cx,
                     obs.fy * Pc.y() * invZ + obs.cy;
            Eigen::Vector2f r = obs.pixel - z_pred;
            float sigma_pixel = obs.sigma_pixel;
            if (sigma_pixel <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid sigma_pixel: " + std::to_string(sigma_pixel));
            }
            Eigen::Vector2f r_hat = r / sigma_pixel;
            float rho = r_hat.norm();
            float w = (rho <= huber_delta) ? 1.0f : (huber_delta / rho);
            float alpha0 = w / sigma_pixel;
            float alpha1 = w / sigma_pixel;
            
            // Feed to Axb
            axb_.factor_valid = 1;
            axb_.factor_type = 0; // Camera
            axb_.local_col_panel = 0;  // landmark panel at local[0:2]
            axb_.local_col_trail = 3 + 6 * pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id]; // pose trail slot
            axb_.alpha[0] = alpha0;
            axb_.alpha[1] = alpha1;
            axb_.cam_fx = obs.fx;
            axb_.cam_fy = obs.fy;
            axb_.cam_cx = obs.cx;
            axb_.cam_cy = obs.cy;
            axb_.cam_z_u = obs.pixel.x();
            axb_.cam_z_v = obs.pixel.y();
            axb_.cam_Pc_X = Pc.x();
            axb_.cam_Pc_Y = Pc.y();
            axb_.cam_Pc_Z = Pc.z();
            axb_.cam_Pc_invZ = invZ;
            for (int i=0; i<3; i++)
                for (int j=0; j<3; j++)
                    axb_.cam_Rcw[i][j] = obs.Rcw(i,j);
            axb_.bundle_end = is_last ? 1 : 0;
            // HEX format for Camera factor:
            // CAM <factor_type=0> <local_col_panel> <local_col_trail> <alpha0..5> <cam_fx..cam_Rcw[2][2]> <bundle_end>
            if (dump_enabled_) {
                std::ostringstream oss;
                oss << "# CAM lm=" << landmark_id << " pose=" << obs.pose_id << " last=" << is_last << "\n";
                oss << "FA 00000000 " // factor_type = 0 (Camera)
                    << uint32ToHex(axb_.local_col_panel) << " "
                    << uint32ToHex(axb_.local_col_trail) << " ";
                // Alpha[0..5]
                for (int ai = 0; ai < 6; ++ai) oss << floatToHex(axb_.alpha[ai]) << " ";
                // Camera payload: fx, fy, cx, cy, z_u, z_v, Pc_X, Pc_Y, Pc_Z, Pc_invZ
                oss << floatToHex(axb_.cam_fx) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_fy) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_cx) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_cy) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_z_u) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_z_v) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_X) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_Y) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_Z) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_invZ) << " ";
                // Rcw[3][3]
                for (int ri = 0; ri < 3; ++ri)
                    for (int rj = 0; rj < 3; ++rj)
                        oss << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Rcw[ri][rj]) << " ";
                oss << uint32ToHex(is_last ? 1 : 0);
                writeStimulus(oss.str());
            }
            
            wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
            local_row += 2;
        }
        
        // 4. RowBuffer assembles local matrix and feeds systolicarray
        // (hardware automatic, CPU waits for completion)
        
        // 5. Collect new factor from RowBuffer
        wait_until(rowbuf_.new_factor_valid);
        
        // Extract R11 (3x3) and z1 (3) for backsubstitution
        BacksubEntry entry;
        entry.var_id = landmark_id;
        entry.is_landmark = true;
        entry.R11.resize(3, 3);
        entry.z1.resize(3);
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++)
                entry.R11(i,j) = rowbuf_.new_factor_R[i][j];
            entry.z1(i) = rowbuf_.new_factor_z[i];
        }
        backsub_stack_.push_back(entry);
        
        // Extract R22 and z2 (trailing blocks) as new factor connecting poses
        // Store to graph for next round elimination
        // (simplified: assume CPU maintains new factor list)
        
        rowbuf_.new_factor_ready = 1;
    }
    
// eliminatePose implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::eliminatePose(
        int pose_id,
        const std::vector<ImuConstraint>& imu_constraints,
        const std::vector<PriorConstraint>& prior_constraints
    ) {
        // 1. Collect connected poses via IMU
        std::vector<int> connected_poses;
        std::map<int, int> pose_to_trail_slot;
        
        for (auto& imu : imu_constraints) {
            int other_pose = (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id) ? imu.pose_j_id : imu.pose_i_id;
            if (std::find(connected_poses.begin(), connected_poses.end(), other_pose) 
                == connected_poses.end()) {
                pose_to_trail_slot[other_pose] = connected_poses.size();
                connected_poses.push_back(other_pose);
            }
        }
        
        int num_trails = connected_poses.size();
        int local_cols = 6 + 6 * num_trails;  // Panel(6) + Trails(6×N)
        
        // 2. Bundle begin
        axb_.bundle_begin = 1;
        axb_.bundle_panel_cols = 6;  // pose panel is 6 cols
        axb_.bundle_trails_count = num_trails;
        axb_.bundle_local_cols = local_cols;
        axb_.bundle_id = pose_id;
        // HEX format: BUNDLE_BEGIN <type:1=pose> <id> <panel_cols> <trail_count> <local_cols>
        if (dump_enabled_) {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << "# BUNDLE_BEGIN POSE id=" << pose_id 
                << " panel=6 trails=" << num_trails << " lcols=" << local_cols << "\n";
            oss << "BB " << uint32ToHex(1) << " " << uint32ToHex(pose_id) << " "
                << uint32ToHex(6) << " " << uint32ToHex(num_trails) << " " << uint32ToHex(local_cols);
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_clock();
        axb_.bundle_begin = 0;
        
        // 3. Feed IMU factors
        for (size_t k=0; k<imu_constraints.size(); k++) {
            auto& imu = imu_constraints[k];
            bool is_last = (k == imu_constraints.size()-1) && prior_constraints.empty();
            
            uint8_t col_i = (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id) ? 0 : (6 + 6*pose_to_trail_slot[imu.pose_i_id]);
            uint8_t col_j = (imu.pose_j_id == pose_id) ? 0 : (6 + 6*pose_to_trail_slot[imu.pose_j_id]);
            
            sendImuFactor(imu, col_i, col_j, is_last);
        }
        
        // 4. Feed Prior factors (if any)
        for (size_t k=0; k<prior_constraints.size(); k++) {
            auto& prior = prior_constraints[k];
            bool is_last = (k == prior_constraints.size()-1);
            
            sendPriorFactor(prior, 0, is_last);  // pose_id is panel (col 0-5)
        }
        
        // 5. Collect QR result
        wait_until(rowbuf_.new_factor_valid);
        
        BacksubEntry entry;
        entry.var_id = pose_id;
        entry.is_landmark = false;  // pose is 6 cols
        entry.R11.resize(6, 6);
        entry.z1.resize(6);
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<6; j++)
                entry.R11(i,j) = rowbuf_.new_factor_R[i][j];
            entry.z1(i) = rowbuf_.new_factor_z[i];
        }
        backsub_stack_.push_back(entry);
        
        rowbuf_.new_factor_ready = 1;
    }
// sendImuFactor implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::sendImuFactor(
        const ImuConstraint& imu,
        uint8_t local_col_i,  // pose_i column in local matrix
        uint8_t local_col_j,  // pose_j column in local matrix
        bool is_last_in_bundle
    ) {
        // Get current pose estimates (with safety checks)
        Eigen::Matrix3f Ri = getPoseRotationInternal(imu.pose_i_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f ti = getPoseTranslationInternal(imu.pose_i_id);
        Eigen::Matrix3f Rj = getPoseRotationInternal(imu.pose_j_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f tj = getPoseTranslationInternal(imu.pose_j_id);
        
        // Set factor type
        axb_.factor_valid = 1;
        axb_.factor_type = 1; // IMU
        axb_.local_col_panel = local_col_i;  // pose_i is panel
        axb_.local_col_trail = local_col_j;  // pose_j is trail
        
        // Set whitening coefficients (from IMU covariance)
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            float sigma_val = imu.sigma(i);
            if (sigma_val <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid IMU sigma[" + std::to_string(i) + "] = " + std::to_string(sigma_val));
            }
            axb_.alpha[i] = 1.0f / sigma_val;  // sigma is stddev
        }
        
        // Set IMU payload (matching Axb.sv naming)
        // R0 = Ri, R1 = Rj, Rd = deltaR
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
                axb_.R0[i][j] = Ri(i,j);
                axb_.R1[i][j] = Rj(i,j);
                axb_.Rd[i][j] = imu.deltaR(i,j);
            }
            axb_.t0[i] = ti(i);
            axb_.t1[i] = tj(i);
            axb_.td[i] = imu.deltaT(i);
        }
        
        axb_.bundle_end = is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0;
        {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << std::hexfloat;
            oss << "IMU_FACTOR pose_i=" << imu.pose_i_id
                << " pose_j=" << imu.pose_j_id
                << " col_i=" << static_cast<int>(local_col_i)
                << " col_j=" << static_cast<int>(local_col_j)
                << " last=" << is_last_in_bundle;
            for (int i=0; i<6; ++i) {
                oss << " alpha[" << i << "]=" << axb_.alpha[i];
            }
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
        axb_.factor_valid = 0;
        axb_.bundle_end = 0;
    }
// sendPriorFactor implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::sendPriorFactor(
        const PriorConstraint& prior,
        uint8_t local_col_pose,  // pose column in local matrix
        bool is_last_in_bundle
    ) {
        // Get current pose estimate (with safety checks)
        Eigen::Matrix3f Ri = getPoseRotationInternal(prior.pose_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f ti = getPoseTranslationInternal(prior.pose_id);
        
        // Set factor type
        axb_.factor_valid = 1;
        axb_.factor_type = 2; // Prior
        axb_.local_col_panel = local_col_pose;  // pose is panel
        axb_.local_col_trail = 0;  // No trail for Prior (prior is observation, not variable)
        
        // Set whitening coefficients
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            float sigma_val = prior.sigma(i);
            if (sigma_val <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid Prior sigma[" + std::to_string(i) + "] = " + std::to_string(sigma_val));
            }
            axb_.alpha[i] = 1.0f / sigma_val;
        }
        
        // Set Prior payload
        // Ri = current estimate, Rp/tp = prior observation
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
                axb_.R0[i][j] = prior.Rp(i,j);  // Rp (prior rotation)
                axb_.R1[i][j] = Ri(i,j);         // Ri (current estimate)
            }
            axb_.t0[i] = prior.tp(i);  // tp (prior translation)
            axb_.t1[i] = ti(i);        // ti (current estimate)
        }
        
        axb_.bundle_end = is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0;
        {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << std::hexfloat;
            oss << "PRIOR_FACTOR pose=" << prior.pose_id
                << " last=" << is_last_in_bundle;
            for (int i=0; i<6; ++i) {
                oss << " alpha[" << i << "]=" << axb_.alpha[i];
            }
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
        axb_.factor_valid = 0;
        axb_.bundle_end = 0;
    }
    
// makeImuConstraint implementation
ImuConstraint VariableEliminationDriver::makeImuConstraint(
        int pose_i_id,
        int pose_j_id,
        const std::vector<ImuPreprocessorGTSAM::ImuMeasurement>& imu_segment,
        double dt_total
    ) {
        // Input validation
        if (imu_segment.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Empty IMU segment");
        }
        if (dt_total <= 0.0) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid dt_total: " + std::to_string(dt_total));
        }
        
        // Get current estimate for Ri (needed for g compensation)
        Eigen::Matrix3d Ri_d = getPoseRotationInternal(pose_i_id).cast<double>();
        
        // Call GTSAM preprocessor
        auto imu_output = imu_preprocessor_.getRelativePose(imu_segment, Ri_d, dt_total);
        
        // Convert to ImuConstraint
        ImuConstraint imu;
        imu.pose_i_id = pose_i_id;
        imu.pose_j_id = pose_j_id;
        imu.deltaR = imu_output.deltaR;
        imu.deltaT = imu_output.deltaT;
        imu.sigma = imu_output.sigma;
        
        return imu;
    }
// backsubstitute implementation
std::map<int, Eigen::VectorXf> VariableEliminationDriver::backsubstitute(const Eigen::VectorXf& x_final) {
        std::map<int, Eigen::VectorXf> solution;
        
        // Solve in reverse order
        for (auto it = backsub_stack_.rbegin(); it != backsub_stack_.rend(); ++it) {
            int dim = it->is_landmark ? 3 : 6;
            Eigen::VectorXf delta_var(dim);
            
            // R11 * delta_var = z1 - R12 * (already_solved_vars)
            // Simplified: assume R12 part handled by trail updates
            Eigen::FullPivLU<Eigen::MatrixXf> lu(it->R11);
            if (!lu.isInvertible()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("R11 matrix is singular for variable " + std::to_string(it->var_id));
            }
            delta_var = lu.solve(it->z1);
            solution[it->var_id] = delta_var;
        }
        
        return solution;
    }

// Helper: SO(3) exponential map (Rodriguez formula)
Eigen::Matrix3f so3Exp(const Eigen::Vector3f& omega) {
    float theta = omega.norm();
    if (theta < 1e-6) {
        return Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity();
    }
    
    Eigen::Vector3f axis = omega / theta;
    Eigen::Matrix3f K;
    K << 0, -axis(2), axis(1),
         axis(2), 0, -axis(0),
         -axis(1), axis(0), 0;
    
    return Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity() + 
           std::sin(theta) * K + 
           (1 - std::cos(theta)) * K * K;
}
```

```cpp
/**
 * Variable-wise Elimination Driver Implementation
 * Implements the elimination sequence shown in your diagrams
 */
#include "VariableEliminationDriver.h"
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <cstring>

constexpr bool kEnableStimulusDumpDefault = false;

// Helper: Convert float to IEEE 754 hex string (8 chars, uppercase)
static std::string floatToHex(float f) {
    uint32_t bits;
    std::memcpy(&bits, &f, sizeof(bits));
    char buf[16];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%08X", bits);
    return std::string(buf);
}

// Helper: Write a 32-bit value as hex (for integers)
static std::string uint32ToHex(uint32_t v) {
    char buf[16];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%08X", v);
    return std::string(buf);
}

// Helper: Write a 3x3 matrix as 9 hex floats (row-major)
static std::string mat3ToHex(const float m[3][3]) {
    std::string s;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
            s += floatToHex(m[i][j]) + " ";
    return s;
}

// Helper: Write a 3-element vector as 3 hex floats
static std::string vec3ToHex(const float v[3]) {
    return floatToHex(v[0]) + " " + floatToHex(v[1]) + " " + floatToHex(v[2]) + " ";
}

// Public accessor implementations
void VariableEliminationDriver::setPose(int pose_id, const Eigen::Matrix3f& R, const Eigen::Vector3f& t) {
    poses_R_[pose_id] = R;
    poses_t_[pose_id] = t;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::setLandmark(int landmark_id, const Eigen::Vector3f& pos) {
    landmarks_[landmark_id] = pos;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::enableStimulusDump(const std::string& file_path) {
    stimulus_stream_.open(file_path);
    if (!stimulus_stream_) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Failed to open stimulus dump file: " + file_path);
    }
    dump_enabled_ = true;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::disableStimulusDump() {
    if (stimulus_stream_.is_open()) {
        stimulus_stream_.close();
    }
    dump_enabled_ = false;
}

const Eigen::Matrix3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseRotation(int pose_id) const {
    return poses_R_.at(pose_id);
}

const Eigen::Vector3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseTranslation(int pose_id) const {
    return poses_t_.at(pose_id);
}

const Eigen::Vector3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getLandmark(int landmark_id) const {
    return landmarks_.at(landmark_id);
}

// Private helper implementations
void VariableEliminationDriver::wait_clock() { 
    /* hardware simulation - busy wait to simulate compute cost */ 
    volatile int dummy = 0;
    for(int i=0; i<1000; i++) dummy++;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::wait_until(bool& signal) { 
    while(!signal) wait_clock(); 
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::writeStimulus(const std::string& line) {
    if (dump_enabled_ && stimulus_stream_) {
        stimulus_stream_ << line << "\n";
    }
}

Eigen::Matrix3f VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseRotationInternal(int pose_id) const {
    auto it = poses_R_.find(pose_id);
    if (it == poses_R_.end()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Pose rotation not found for pose_id: " + std::to_string(pose_id));
    }
    return it->second;
}

Eigen::Vector3f VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseTranslationInternal(int pose_id) const {
    auto it = poses_t_.find(pose_id);
    if (it == poses_t_.end()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Pose translation not found for pose_id: " + std::to_string(pose_id));
    }
    return it->second;
}

// eliminateLandmark implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::eliminateLandmark(
        int landmark_id,
        const std::vector<CameraObservation>& observations,
        float huber_delta
    ) {
        // Input validation
        if (observations.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("No observations provided for landmark " + std::to_string(landmark_id));
        }
        if (huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Huber delta must be positive");
        }
        
        // 1. Collect connected poses
        std::vector<int> connected_poses;
        std::map<int, int> pose_to_trail_slot;
        for (auto& obs : observations) {
            if (std::find(connected_poses.begin(), connected_poses.end(), obs.pose_id) == connected_poses.end()) {
                pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id] = connected_poses.size();
                connected_poses.push_back(obs.pose_id);
            }
        }
        
        int num_trails = connected_poses.size();
        int local_cols = 3 + 6 * num_trails;
        int local_rows = observations.size() * 2;
        
        // 2. Bundle begin
        axb_.bundle_begin = 1;
        axb_.bundle_panel_cols = 3;
        axb_.bundle_trails_count = num_trails;
        axb_.bundle_local_cols = local_cols;
        axb_.bundle_id = landmark_id;
        // HEX format: BUNDLE_BEGIN <type:L/P> <id> <panel_cols> <trail_count> <local_cols>
        if (dump_enabled_) {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << "# BUNDLE_BEGIN LANDMARK id=" << landmark_id 
                << " panel=3 trails=" << num_trails << " lcols=" << local_cols << "\n";
            oss << "BB " << uint32ToHex(0) << " " << uint32ToHex(landmark_id) << " "
                << uint32ToHex(3) << " " << uint32ToHex(num_trails) << " " << uint32ToHex(local_cols);
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_clock();
        axb_.bundle_begin = 0;
        
        // 3. Feed each observation
        int local_row = 0;
        for (int k=0; k<observations.size(); k++) {
            auto& obs = observations[k];
            bool is_last = (k == observations.size() - 1);
            
            // Compute Pc and invZ
            Eigen::Vector3f Pc = obs.Rcw * obs.lw + obs.tcw;
            float Pc_z = Pc.z();
            if (std::abs(Pc_z) < 1e-6f) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Point behind camera or at infinity (Pc.z = " + std::to_string(Pc_z) + ")");
            }
            float invZ = 1.0f / Pc_z;
            
            // Compute residual for Huber weight (CPU side)
            Eigen::Vector2f z_pred;
            z_pred << obs.fx * Pc.x() * invZ + obs.cx,
                     obs.fy * Pc.y() * invZ + obs.cy;
            Eigen::Vector2f r = obs.pixel - z_pred;
            float sigma_pixel = obs.sigma_pixel;
            if (sigma_pixel <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid sigma_pixel: " + std::to_string(sigma_pixel));
            }
            Eigen::Vector2f r_hat = r / sigma_pixel;
            float rho = r_hat.norm();
            float w = (rho <= huber_delta) ? 1.0f : (huber_delta / rho);
            float alpha0 = w / sigma_pixel;
            float alpha1 = w / sigma_pixel;
            
            // Feed to Axb
            axb_.factor_valid = 1;
            axb_.factor_type = 0; // Camera
            axb_.local_col_panel = 0;  // landmark panel at local[0:2]
            axb_.local_col_trail = 3 + 6 * pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id]; // pose trail slot
            axb_.alpha[0] = alpha0;
            axb_.alpha[1] = alpha1;
            axb_.cam_fx = obs.fx;
            axb_.cam_fy = obs.fy;
            axb_.cam_cx = obs.cx;
            axb_.cam_cy = obs.cy;
            axb_.cam_z_u = obs.pixel.x();
            axb_.cam_z_v = obs.pixel.y();
            axb_.cam_Pc_X = Pc.x();
            axb_.cam_Pc_Y = Pc.y();
            axb_.cam_Pc_Z = Pc.z();
            axb_.cam_Pc_invZ = invZ;
            for (int i=0; i<3; i++)
                for (int j=0; j<3; j++)
                    axb_.cam_Rcw[i][j] = obs.Rcw(i,j);
            axb_.bundle_end = is_last ? 1 : 0;
            // HEX format for Camera factor:
            // CAM <factor_type=0> <local_col_panel> <local_col_trail> <alpha0..5> <cam_fx..cam_Rcw[2][2]> <bundle_end>
            if (dump_enabled_) {
                std::ostringstream oss;
                oss << "# CAM lm=" << landmark_id << " pose=" << obs.pose_id << " last=" << is_last << "\n";
                oss << "FA 00000000 " // factor_type = 0 (Camera)
                    << uint32ToHex(axb_.local_col_panel) << " "
                    << uint32ToHex(axb_.local_col_trail) << " ";
                // Alpha[0..5]
                for (int ai = 0; ai < 6; ++ai) oss << floatToHex(axb_.alpha[ai]) << " ";
                // Camera payload: fx, fy, cx, cy, z_u, z_v, Pc_X, Pc_Y, Pc_Z, Pc_invZ
                oss << floatToHex(axb_.cam_fx) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_fy) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_cx) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_cy) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_z_u) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_z_v) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_X) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_Y) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_Z) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_invZ) << " ";
                // Rcw[3][3]
                for (int ri = 0; ri < 3; ++ri)
                    for (int rj = 0; rj < 3; ++rj)
                        oss << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Rcw[ri][rj]) << " ";
                oss << uint32ToHex(is_last ? 1 : 0);
                writeStimulus(oss.str());
            }
            
            wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
            local_row += 2;
        }
        
        // 4. RowBuffer assembles local matrix and feeds systolicarray
        // (hardware automatic, CPU waits for completion)
        
        // 5. Collect new factor from RowBuffer
        wait_until(rowbuf_.new_factor_valid);
        
        // Extract R11 (3x3) and z1 (3) for backsubstitution
        BacksubEntry entry;
        entry.var_id = landmark_id;
        entry.is_landmark = true;
        entry.R11.resize(3, 3);
        entry.z1.resize(3);
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++)
                entry.R11(i,j) = rowbuf_.new_factor_R[i][j];
            entry.z1(i) = rowbuf_.new_factor_z[i];
        }
        backsub_stack_.push_back(entry);
        
        // Extract R22 and z2 (trailing blocks) as new factor connecting poses
        // Store to graph for next round elimination
        // (simplified: assume CPU maintains new factor list)
        
        rowbuf_.new_factor_ready = 1;
    }
    
// eliminatePose implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::eliminatePose(
        int pose_id,
        const std::vector<ImuConstraint>& imu_constraints,
        const std::vector<PriorConstraint>& prior_constraints
    ) {
        // 1. Collect connected poses via IMU
        std::vector<int> connected_poses;
        std::map<int, int> pose_to_trail_slot;
        
        for (auto& imu : imu_constraints) {
            int other_pose = (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id) ? imu.pose_j_id : imu.pose_i_id;
            if (std::find(connected_poses.begin(), connected_poses.end(), other_pose) 
                == connected_poses.end()) {
                pose_to_trail_slot[other_pose] = connected_poses.size();
                connected_poses.push_back(other_pose);
            }
        }
        
        int num_trails = connected_poses.size();
        int local_cols = 6 + 6 * num_trails;  // Panel(6) + Trails(6×N)
        
        // 2. Bundle begin
        axb_.bundle_begin = 1;
        axb_.bundle_panel_cols = 6;  // pose panel is 6 cols
        axb_.bundle_trails_count = num_trails;
        axb_.bundle_local_cols = local_cols;
        axb_.bundle_id = pose_id;
        // HEX format: BUNDLE_BEGIN <type:1=pose> <id> <panel_cols> <trail_count> <local_cols>
        if (dump_enabled_) {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << "# BUNDLE_BEGIN POSE id=" << pose_id 
                << " panel=6 trails=" << num_trails << " lcols=" << local_cols << "\n";
            oss << "BB " << uint32ToHex(1) << " " << uint32ToHex(pose_id) << " "
                << uint32ToHex(6) << " " << uint32ToHex(num_trails) << " " << uint32ToHex(local_cols);
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_clock();
        axb_.bundle_begin = 0;
        
        // 3. Feed IMU factors
        for (size_t k=0; k<imu_constraints.size(); k++) {
            auto& imu = imu_constraints[k];
            bool is_last = (k == imu_constraints.size()-1) && prior_constraints.empty();
            
            uint8_t col_i = (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id) ? 0 : (6 + 6*pose_to_trail_slot[imu.pose_i_id]);
            uint8_t col_j = (imu.pose_j_id == pose_id) ? 0 : (6 + 6*pose_to_trail_slot[imu.pose_j_id]);
            
            sendImuFactor(imu, col_i, col_j, is_last);
        }
        
        // 4. Feed Prior factors (if any)
        for (size_t k=0; k<prior_constraints.size(); k++) {
            auto& prior = prior_constraints[k];
            bool is_last = (k == prior_constraints.size()-1);
            
            sendPriorFactor(prior, 0, is_last);  // pose_id is panel (col 0-5)
        }
        
        // 5. Collect QR result
        wait_until(rowbuf_.new_factor_valid);
        
        BacksubEntry entry;
        entry.var_id = pose_id;
        entry.is_landmark = false;  // pose is 6 cols
        entry.R11.resize(6, 6);
        entry.z1.resize(6);
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<6; j++)
                entry.R11(i,j) = rowbuf_.new_factor_R[i][j];
            entry.z1(i) = rowbuf_.new_factor_z[i];
        }
        backsub_stack_.push_back(entry);
        
        rowbuf_.new_factor_ready = 1;
    }
// sendImuFactor implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::sendImuFactor(
        const ImuConstraint& imu,
        uint8_t local_col_i,  // pose_i column in local matrix
        uint8_t local_col_j,  // pose_j column in local matrix
        bool is_last_in_bundle
    ) {
        // Get current pose estimates (with safety checks)
        Eigen::Matrix3f Ri = getPoseRotationInternal(imu.pose_i_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f ti = getPoseTranslationInternal(imu.pose_i_id);
        Eigen::Matrix3f Rj = getPoseRotationInternal(imu.pose_j_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f tj = getPoseTranslationInternal(imu.pose_j_id);
        
        // Set factor type
        axb_.factor_valid = 1;
        axb_.factor_type = 1; // IMU
        axb_.local_col_panel = local_col_i;  // pose_i is panel
        axb_.local_col_trail = local_col_j;  // pose_j is trail
        
        // Set whitening coefficients (from IMU covariance)
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            float sigma_val = imu.sigma(i);
            if (sigma_val <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid IMU sigma[" + std::to_string(i) + "] = " + std::to_string(sigma_val));
            }
            axb_.alpha[i] = 1.0f / sigma_val;  // sigma is stddev
        }
        
        // Set IMU payload (matching Axb.sv naming)
        // R0 = Ri, R1 = Rj, Rd = deltaR
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
                axb_.R0[i][j] = Ri(i,j);
                axb_.R1[i][j] = Rj(i,j);
                axb_.Rd[i][j] = imu.deltaR(i,j);
            }
            axb_.t0[i] = ti(i);
            axb_.t1[i] = tj(i);
            axb_.td[i] = imu.deltaT(i);
        }
        
        axb_.bundle_end = is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0;
        // HEX format for IMU factor:
        // FA <factor_type=1> <local_col_panel> <local_col_trail> <alpha[0..5]> <R0[3x3]> <R1[3x3]> <Rd[3x3]> <t0[3]> <t1[3]> <td[3]> <bundle_end>
        if (dump_enabled_) {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << "# IMU pose_i=" << imu.pose_i_id << " pose_j=" << imu.pose_j_id << " last=" << is_last_in_bundle << "\n";
            oss << "FA 00000001 " // factor_type = 1 (IMU)
                << uint32ToHex(local_col_i) << " "
                << uint32ToHex(local_col_j) << " ";
            // Alpha[0..5]
            for (int ai = 0; ai < 6; ++ai) oss << floatToHex(axb_.alpha[ai]) << " ";
            // R0, R1, Rd (each 3x3)
            oss << mat3ToHex(axb_.R0) << mat3ToHex(axb_.R1) << mat3ToHex(axb_.Rd);
            // t0, t1, td (each 3)
            oss << vec3ToHex(axb_.t0) << vec3ToHex(axb_.t1) << vec3ToHex(axb_.td);
            oss << uint32ToHex(is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0);
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
        axb_.factor_valid = 0;
        axb_.bundle_end = 0;
    }
// sendPriorFactor implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::sendPriorFactor(
        const PriorConstraint& prior,
        uint8_t local_col_pose,  // pose column in local matrix
        bool is_last_in_bundle
    ) {
        // Get current pose estimate (with safety checks)
        Eigen::Matrix3f Ri = getPoseRotationInternal(prior.pose_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f ti = getPoseTranslationInternal(prior.pose_id);
        
        // Set factor type
        axb_.factor_valid = 1;
        axb_.factor_type = 2; // Prior
        axb_.local_col_panel = local_col_pose;  // pose is panel
        axb_.local_col_trail = 0;  // No trail for Prior (prior is observation, not variable)
        
        // Set whitening coefficients
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            float sigma_val = prior.sigma(i);
            if (sigma_val <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid Prior sigma[" + std::to_string(i) + "] = " + std::to_string(sigma_val));
            }
            axb_.alpha[i] = 1.0f / sigma_val;
        }
        
        // Set Prior payload
        // Ri = current estimate, Rp/tp = prior observation
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
                axb_.R0[i][j] = prior.Rp(i,j);  // Rp (prior rotation)
                axb_.R1[i][j] = Ri(i,j);         // Ri (current estimate)
            }
            axb_.t0[i] = prior.tp(i);  // tp (prior translation)
            axb_.t1[i] = ti(i);        // ti (current estimate)
        }
        
        axb_.bundle_end = is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0;
        // HEX format for Prior factor:
        // FA <factor_type=2> <local_col_panel> <local_col_trail=0> <alpha[0..5]> <R0[3x3]> <R1[3x3]> <t0[3]> <t1[3]> <bundle_end>
        if (dump_enabled_) {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << "# PRIOR pose=" << prior.pose_id << " last=" << is_last_in_bundle << "\n";
            oss << "FA 00000002 " // factor_type = 2 (Prior)
                << uint32ToHex(local_col_pose) << " "
                << uint32ToHex(0) << " "; // trail = 0 for prior
            // Alpha[0..5]
            for (int ai = 0; ai < 6; ++ai) oss << floatToHex(axb_.alpha[ai]) << " ";
            // R0 (Rp), R1 (Ri)
            oss << mat3ToHex(axb_.R0) << mat3ToHex(axb_.R1);
            // t0 (tp), t1 (ti)
            oss << vec3ToHex(axb_.t0) << vec3ToHex(axb_.t1);
            oss << uint32ToHex(is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0);
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
        axb_.factor_valid = 0;
        axb_.bundle_end = 0;
    }
    
// makeImuConstraint implementation
ImuConstraint VariableEliminationDriver::makeImuConstraint(
        int pose_i_id,
        int pose_j_id,
        const std::vector<ImuPreprocessorGTSAM::ImuMeasurement>& imu_segment,
        double dt_total
    ) {
        // Input validation
        if (imu_segment.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Empty IMU segment");
        }
        if (dt_total <= 0.0) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid dt_total: " + std::to_string(dt_total));
        }
        
        // Get current estimate for Ri (needed for g compensation)
        Eigen::Matrix3d Ri_d = getPoseRotationInternal(pose_i_id).cast<double>();
        
        // Call GTSAM preprocessor
        auto imu_output = imu_preprocessor_.getRelativePose(imu_segment, Ri_d, dt_total);
        
        // Convert to ImuConstraint
        ImuConstraint imu;
        imu.pose_i_id = pose_i_id;
        imu.pose_j_id = pose_j_id;
        imu.deltaR = imu_output.deltaR;
        imu.deltaT = imu_output.deltaT;
        imu.sigma = imu_output.sigma;
        
        return imu;
    }
// backsubstitute implementation
std::map<int, Eigen::VectorXf> VariableEliminationDriver::backsubstitute(const Eigen::VectorXf& x_final) {
        std::map<int, Eigen::VectorXf> solution;
        
        // Solve in reverse order
        for (auto it = backsub_stack_.rbegin(); it != backsub_stack_.rend(); ++it) {
            int dim = it->is_landmark ? 3 : 6;
            Eigen::VectorXf delta_var(dim);
            
            // R11 * delta_var = z1 - R12 * (already_solved_vars)
            // Simplified: assume R12 part handled by trail updates
            Eigen::FullPivLU<Eigen::MatrixXf> lu(it->R11);
            if (!lu.isInvertible()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("R11 matrix is singular for variable " + std::to_string(it->var_id));
            }
            delta_var = lu.solve(it->z1);
            solution[it->var_id] = delta_var;
        }
        
        return solution;
    }

// Helper: SO(3) exponential map (Rodriguez formula)
Eigen::Matrix3f so3Exp(const Eigen::Vector3f& omega) {
    float theta = omega.norm();
    if (theta < 1e-6) {
        return Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity();
    }
    
    Eigen::Vector3f axis = omega / theta;
    Eigen::Matrix3f K;
    K << 0, -axis(2), axis(1),
         axis(2), 0, -axis(0),
         -axis(1), axis(0), 0;
    
    return Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity() + 
           std::sin(theta) * K + 
           (1 - std::cos(theta)) * K * K;
}

void runVariableElimination(
    const std::vector<CameraObservation>& camera_obs,
    const std::vector<ImuConstraint>& imu_factors,
    const std::vector<PriorConstraint>& priors
) {
    VariableEliminationDriver driver;
    
    // Phase 1: Eliminate all landmarks
    std::set<int> unique_landmarks;
    for (auto& obs : camera_obs)
        unique_landmarks.insert(obs.landmark_id);
    
    for (int lm_id : unique_landmarks) {
        std::vector<CameraObservation> lm_obs;
        for (auto& obs : camera_obs)
            if (obs.landmark_id == lm_id)
                lm_obs.push_back(obs);
        
        driver.eliminateLandmark(lm_id, lm_obs);

    // Phase 2: Eliminate old poses (keep last K poses for sliding window)

        for (auto& imu : imu_factors) {
```

**Cursor**

慢的原因是 `wait_clock()` 里有一个模拟硬件延迟的循环（1000 次空循环），每个 factor 都要调用多次。对于 59979 个观测，这会非常慢。

让我来：
1. 把模拟延迟去掉或大幅减少
2. 加一个进度条

```cpp
/**
 * Variable-wise Elimination Driver Implementation
 * Implements the elimination sequence shown in your diagrams
 */
#include "VariableEliminationDriver.h"
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <cstring>

constexpr bool kEnableStimulusDumpDefault = false;

// Helper: Convert float to IEEE 754 hex string (8 chars, uppercase)
static std::string floatToHex(float f) {
    uint32_t bits;
    std::memcpy(&bits, &f, sizeof(bits));
    char buf[16];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%08X", bits);
    return std::string(buf);
}

// Helper: Write a 32-bit value as hex (for integers)
static std::string uint32ToHex(uint32_t v) {
    char buf[16];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%08X", v);
    return std::string(buf);
}

// Helper: Write a 3x3 matrix as 9 hex floats (row-major)
static std::string mat3ToHex(const float m[3][3]) {
    std::string s;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
            s += floatToHex(m[i][j]) + " ";
    return s;
}

// Helper: Write a 3-element vector as 3 hex floats
static std::string vec3ToHex(const float v[3]) {
    return floatToHex(v[0]) + " " + floatToHex(v[1]) + " " + floatToHex(v[2]) + " ";
}

// Public accessor implementations
void VariableEliminationDriver::setPose(int pose_id, const Eigen::Matrix3f& R, const Eigen::Vector3f& t) {
    poses_R_[pose_id] = R;
    poses_t_[pose_id] = t;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::setLandmark(int landmark_id, const Eigen::Vector3f& pos) {
    landmarks_[landmark_id] = pos;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::enableStimulusDump(const std::string& file_path) {
    stimulus_stream_.open(file_path);
    if (!stimulus_stream_) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Failed to open stimulus dump file: " + file_path);
    }
    dump_enabled_ = true;
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::disableStimulusDump() {
    if (stimulus_stream_.is_open()) {
        stimulus_stream_.close();
    }
    dump_enabled_ = false;
}

const Eigen::Matrix3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseRotation(int pose_id) const {
    return poses_R_.at(pose_id);
}

const Eigen::Vector3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseTranslation(int pose_id) const {
    return poses_t_.at(pose_id);
}

const Eigen::Vector3f& VariableEliminationDriver::getLandmark(int landmark_id) const {
    return landmarks_.at(landmark_id);
}

// Private helper implementations
void VariableEliminationDriver::wait_clock() { 
    /* hardware simulation - no delay for stimulus generation mode */ 
    // (Actual hardware latency will be measured in RTL simulation)
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::wait_until(bool& signal) { 
    while(!signal) wait_clock(); 
}

void VariableEliminationDriver::writeStimulus(const std::string& line) {
    if (dump_enabled_ && stimulus_stream_) {
        stimulus_stream_ << line << "\n";
    }
}

Eigen::Matrix3f VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseRotationInternal(int pose_id) const {
    auto it = poses_R_.find(pose_id);
    if (it == poses_R_.end()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Pose rotation not found for pose_id: " + std::to_string(pose_id));
    }
    return it->second;
}

Eigen::Vector3f VariableEliminationDriver::getPoseTranslationInternal(int pose_id) const {
    auto it = poses_t_.find(pose_id);
    if (it == poses_t_.end()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Pose translation not found for pose_id: " + std::to_string(pose_id));
    }
    return it->second;
}

// eliminateLandmark implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::eliminateLandmark(
        int landmark_id,
        const std::vector<CameraObservation>& observations,
        float huber_delta
    ) {
        // Input validation
        if (observations.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("No observations provided for landmark " + std::to_string(landmark_id));
        }
        if (huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Huber delta must be positive");
        }
        
        // 1. Collect connected poses
        std::vector<int> connected_poses;
        std::map<int, int> pose_to_trail_slot;
        for (auto& obs : observations) {
            if (std::find(connected_poses.begin(), connected_poses.end(), obs.pose_id) == connected_poses.end()) {
                pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id] = connected_poses.size();
                connected_poses.push_back(obs.pose_id);
            }
        }
        
        int num_trails = connected_poses.size();
        int local_cols = 3 + 6 * num_trails;
        int local_rows = observations.size() * 2;
        
        // 2. Bundle begin
        axb_.bundle_begin = 1;
        axb_.bundle_panel_cols = 3;
        axb_.bundle_trails_count = num_trails;
        axb_.bundle_local_cols = local_cols;
        axb_.bundle_id = landmark_id;
        // HEX format: BUNDLE_BEGIN <type:L/P> <id> <panel_cols> <trail_count> <local_cols>
        if (dump_enabled_) {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << "# BUNDLE_BEGIN LANDMARK id=" << landmark_id 
                << " panel=3 trails=" << num_trails << " lcols=" << local_cols << "\n";
            oss << "BB " << uint32ToHex(0) << " " << uint32ToHex(landmark_id) << " "
                << uint32ToHex(3) << " " << uint32ToHex(num_trails) << " " << uint32ToHex(local_cols);
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_clock();
        axb_.bundle_begin = 0;
        
        // 3. Feed each observation
        int local_row = 0;
        for (int k=0; k<observations.size(); k++) {
            auto& obs = observations[k];
            bool is_last = (k == observations.size() - 1);
            
            // Compute Pc and invZ
            Eigen::Vector3f Pc = obs.Rcw * obs.lw + obs.tcw;
            float Pc_z = Pc.z();
            if (std::abs(Pc_z) < 1e-6f) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Point behind camera or at infinity (Pc.z = " + std::to_string(Pc_z) + ")");
            }
            float invZ = 1.0f / Pc_z;
            
            // Compute residual for Huber weight (CPU side)
            Eigen::Vector2f z_pred;
            z_pred << obs.fx * Pc.x() * invZ + obs.cx,
                     obs.fy * Pc.y() * invZ + obs.cy;
            Eigen::Vector2f r = obs.pixel - z_pred;
            float sigma_pixel = obs.sigma_pixel;
            if (sigma_pixel <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid sigma_pixel: " + std::to_string(sigma_pixel));
            }
            Eigen::Vector2f r_hat = r / sigma_pixel;
            float rho = r_hat.norm();
            float w = (rho <= huber_delta) ? 1.0f : (huber_delta / rho);
            float alpha0 = w / sigma_pixel;
            float alpha1 = w / sigma_pixel;
            
            // Feed to Axb
            axb_.factor_valid = 1;
            axb_.factor_type = 0; // Camera
            axb_.local_col_panel = 0;  // landmark panel at local[0:2]
            axb_.local_col_trail = 3 + 6 * pose_to_trail_slot[obs.pose_id]; // pose trail slot
            axb_.alpha[0] = alpha0;
            axb_.alpha[1] = alpha1;
            axb_.cam_fx = obs.fx;
            axb_.cam_fy = obs.fy;
            axb_.cam_cx = obs.cx;
            axb_.cam_cy = obs.cy;
            axb_.cam_z_u = obs.pixel.x();
            axb_.cam_z_v = obs.pixel.y();
            axb_.cam_Pc_X = Pc.x();
            axb_.cam_Pc_Y = Pc.y();
            axb_.cam_Pc_Z = Pc.z();
            axb_.cam_Pc_invZ = invZ;
            for (int i=0; i<3; i++)
                for (int j=0; j<3; j++)
                    axb_.cam_Rcw[i][j] = obs.Rcw(i,j);
            axb_.bundle_end = is_last ? 1 : 0;
            // HEX format for Camera factor:
            // CAM <factor_type=0> <local_col_panel> <local_col_trail> <alpha0..5> <cam_fx..cam_Rcw[2][2]> <bundle_end>
            if (dump_enabled_) {
                std::ostringstream oss;
                oss << "# CAM lm=" << landmark_id << " pose=" << obs.pose_id << " last=" << is_last << "\n";
                oss << "FA 00000000 " // factor_type = 0 (Camera)
                    << uint32ToHex(axb_.local_col_panel) << " "
                    << uint32ToHex(axb_.local_col_trail) << " ";
                // Alpha[0..5]
                for (int ai = 0; ai < 6; ++ai) oss << floatToHex(axb_.alpha[ai]) << " ";
                // Camera payload: fx, fy, cx, cy, z_u, z_v, Pc_X, Pc_Y, Pc_Z, Pc_invZ
                oss << floatToHex(axb_.cam_fx) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_fy) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_cx) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_cy) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_z_u) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_z_v) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_X) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_Y) << " "
                    << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_Z) << " " << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Pc_invZ) << " ";
                // Rcw[3][3]
                for (int ri = 0; ri < 3; ++ri)
                    for (int rj = 0; rj < 3; ++rj)
                        oss << floatToHex(axb_.cam_Rcw[ri][rj]) << " ";
                oss << uint32ToHex(is_last ? 1 : 0);
                writeStimulus(oss.str());
            }
            
            wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
            local_row += 2;
        }
        
        // 4. RowBuffer assembles local matrix and feeds systolicarray
        // (hardware automatic, CPU waits for completion)
        
        // 5. Collect new factor from RowBuffer
        wait_until(rowbuf_.new_factor_valid);
        
        // Extract R11 (3x3) and z1 (3) for backsubstitution
        BacksubEntry entry;
        entry.var_id = landmark_id;
        entry.is_landmark = true;
        entry.R11.resize(3, 3);
        entry.z1.resize(3);
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++)
                entry.R11(i,j) = rowbuf_.new_factor_R[i][j];
            entry.z1(i) = rowbuf_.new_factor_z[i];
        }
        backsub_stack_.push_back(entry);
        
        // Extract R22 and z2 (trailing blocks) as new factor connecting poses
        // Store to graph for next round elimination
        // (simplified: assume CPU maintains new factor list)
        
        rowbuf_.new_factor_ready = 1;
    }
    
// eliminatePose implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::eliminatePose(
        int pose_id,
        const std::vector<ImuConstraint>& imu_constraints,
        const std::vector<PriorConstraint>& prior_constraints
    ) {
        // 1. Collect connected poses via IMU
        std::vector<int> connected_poses;
        std::map<int, int> pose_to_trail_slot;
        
        for (auto& imu : imu_constraints) {
            int other_pose = (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id) ? imu.pose_j_id : imu.pose_i_id;
            if (std::find(connected_poses.begin(), connected_poses.end(), other_pose) 
                == connected_poses.end()) {
                pose_to_trail_slot[other_pose] = connected_poses.size();
                connected_poses.push_back(other_pose);
            }
        }
        
        int num_trails = connected_poses.size();
        int local_cols = 6 + 6 * num_trails;  // Panel(6) + Trails(6×N)
        
        // 2. Bundle begin
        axb_.bundle_begin = 1;
        axb_.bundle_panel_cols = 6;  // pose panel is 6 cols
        axb_.bundle_trails_count = num_trails;
        axb_.bundle_local_cols = local_cols;
        axb_.bundle_id = pose_id;
        // HEX format: BUNDLE_BEGIN <type:1=pose> <id> <panel_cols> <trail_count> <local_cols>
        if (dump_enabled_) {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << "# BUNDLE_BEGIN POSE id=" << pose_id 
                << " panel=6 trails=" << num_trails << " lcols=" << local_cols << "\n";
            oss << "BB " << uint32ToHex(1) << " " << uint32ToHex(pose_id) << " "
                << uint32ToHex(6) << " " << uint32ToHex(num_trails) << " " << uint32ToHex(local_cols);
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_clock();
        axb_.bundle_begin = 0;
        
        // 3. Feed IMU factors
        for (size_t k=0; k<imu_constraints.size(); k++) {
            auto& imu = imu_constraints[k];
            bool is_last = (k == imu_constraints.size()-1) && prior_constraints.empty();
            
            uint8_t col_i = (imu.pose_i_id == pose_id) ? 0 : (6 + 6*pose_to_trail_slot[imu.pose_i_id]);
            uint8_t col_j = (imu.pose_j_id == pose_id) ? 0 : (6 + 6*pose_to_trail_slot[imu.pose_j_id]);
            
            sendImuFactor(imu, col_i, col_j, is_last);
        }
        
        // 4. Feed Prior factors (if any)
        for (size_t k=0; k<prior_constraints.size(); k++) {
            auto& prior = prior_constraints[k];
            bool is_last = (k == prior_constraints.size()-1);
            
            sendPriorFactor(prior, 0, is_last);  // pose_id is panel (col 0-5)
        }
        
        // 5. Collect QR result
        wait_until(rowbuf_.new_factor_valid);
        
        BacksubEntry entry;
        entry.var_id = pose_id;
        entry.is_landmark = false;  // pose is 6 cols
        entry.R11.resize(6, 6);
        entry.z1.resize(6);
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<6; j++)
                entry.R11(i,j) = rowbuf_.new_factor_R[i][j];
            entry.z1(i) = rowbuf_.new_factor_z[i];
        }
        backsub_stack_.push_back(entry);
        
        rowbuf_.new_factor_ready = 1;
    }
// sendImuFactor implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::sendImuFactor(
        const ImuConstraint& imu,
        uint8_t local_col_i,  // pose_i column in local matrix
        uint8_t local_col_j,  // pose_j column in local matrix
        bool is_last_in_bundle
    ) {
        // Get current pose estimates (with safety checks)
        Eigen::Matrix3f Ri = getPoseRotationInternal(imu.pose_i_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f ti = getPoseTranslationInternal(imu.pose_i_id);
        Eigen::Matrix3f Rj = getPoseRotationInternal(imu.pose_j_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f tj = getPoseTranslationInternal(imu.pose_j_id);
        
        // Set factor type
        axb_.factor_valid = 1;
        axb_.factor_type = 1; // IMU
        axb_.local_col_panel = local_col_i;  // pose_i is panel
        axb_.local_col_trail = local_col_j;  // pose_j is trail
        
        // Set whitening coefficients (from IMU covariance)
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            float sigma_val = imu.sigma(i);
            if (sigma_val <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid IMU sigma[" + std::to_string(i) + "] = " + std::to_string(sigma_val));
            }
            axb_.alpha[i] = 1.0f / sigma_val;  // sigma is stddev
        }
        
        // Set IMU payload (matching Axb.sv naming)
        // R0 = Ri, R1 = Rj, Rd = deltaR
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
                axb_.R0[i][j] = Ri(i,j);
                axb_.R1[i][j] = Rj(i,j);
                axb_.Rd[i][j] = imu.deltaR(i,j);
            }
            axb_.t0[i] = ti(i);
            axb_.t1[i] = tj(i);
            axb_.td[i] = imu.deltaT(i);
        }
        
        axb_.bundle_end = is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0;
        // HEX format for IMU factor:
        // FA <factor_type=1> <local_col_panel> <local_col_trail> <alpha[0..5]> <R0[3x3]> <R1[3x3]> <Rd[3x3]> <t0[3]> <t1[3]> <td[3]> <bundle_end>
        if (dump_enabled_) {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << "# IMU pose_i=" << imu.pose_i_id << " pose_j=" << imu.pose_j_id << " last=" << is_last_in_bundle << "\n";
            oss << "FA 00000001 " // factor_type = 1 (IMU)
                << uint32ToHex(local_col_i) << " "
                << uint32ToHex(local_col_j) << " ";
            // Alpha[0..5]
            for (int ai = 0; ai < 6; ++ai) oss << floatToHex(axb_.alpha[ai]) << " ";
            // R0, R1, Rd (each 3x3)
            oss << mat3ToHex(axb_.R0) << mat3ToHex(axb_.R1) << mat3ToHex(axb_.Rd);
            // t0, t1, td (each 3)
            oss << vec3ToHex(axb_.t0) << vec3ToHex(axb_.t1) << vec3ToHex(axb_.td);
            oss << uint32ToHex(is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0);
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
        axb_.factor_valid = 0;
        axb_.bundle_end = 0;
    }
// sendPriorFactor implementation
void VariableEliminationDriver::sendPriorFactor(
        const PriorConstraint& prior,
        uint8_t local_col_pose,  // pose column in local matrix
        bool is_last_in_bundle
    ) {
        // Get current pose estimate (with safety checks)
        Eigen::Matrix3f Ri = getPoseRotationInternal(prior.pose_id);
        Eigen::Vector3f ti = getPoseTranslationInternal(prior.pose_id);
        
        // Set factor type
        axb_.factor_valid = 1;
        axb_.factor_type = 2; // Prior
        axb_.local_col_panel = local_col_pose;  // pose is panel
        axb_.local_col_trail = 0;  // No trail for Prior (prior is observation, not variable)
        
        // Set whitening coefficients
        for (int i=0; i<6; i++) {
            float sigma_val = prior.sigma(i);
            if (sigma_val <= 0.0f) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid Prior sigma[" + std::to_string(i) + "] = " + std::to_string(sigma_val));
            }
            axb_.alpha[i] = 1.0f / sigma_val;
        }
        
        // Set Prior payload
        // Ri = current estimate, Rp/tp = prior observation
        for (int i=0; i<3; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<3; j++) {
                axb_.R0[i][j] = prior.Rp(i,j);  // Rp (prior rotation)
                axb_.R1[i][j] = Ri(i,j);         // Ri (current estimate)
            }
            axb_.t0[i] = prior.tp(i);  // tp (prior translation)
            axb_.t1[i] = ti(i);        // ti (current estimate)
        }
        
        axb_.bundle_end = is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0;
        // HEX format for Prior factor:
        // FA <factor_type=2> <local_col_panel> <local_col_trail=0> <alpha[0..5]> <R0[3x3]> <R1[3x3]> <t0[3]> <t1[3]> <bundle_end>
        if (dump_enabled_) {
            std::ostringstream oss;
            oss << "# PRIOR pose=" << prior.pose_id << " last=" << is_last_in_bundle << "\n";
            oss << "FA 00000002 " // factor_type = 2 (Prior)
                << uint32ToHex(local_col_pose) << " "
                << uint32ToHex(0) << " "; // trail = 0 for prior
            // Alpha[0..5]
            for (int ai = 0; ai < 6; ++ai) oss << floatToHex(axb_.alpha[ai]) << " ";
            // R0 (Rp), R1 (Ri)
            oss << mat3ToHex(axb_.R0) << mat3ToHex(axb_.R1);
            // t0 (tp), t1 (ti)
            oss << vec3ToHex(axb_.t0) << vec3ToHex(axb_.t1);
            oss << uint32ToHex(is_last_in_bundle ? 1 : 0);
            writeStimulus(oss.str());
        }
        wait_until(axb_.factor_ready);
        axb_.factor_valid = 0;
        axb_.bundle_end = 0;
    }
    
// makeImuConstraint implementation
ImuConstraint VariableEliminationDriver::makeImuConstraint(
        int pose_i_id,
        int pose_j_id,
        const std::vector<ImuPreprocessorGTSAM::ImuMeasurement>& imu_segment,
        double dt_total
    ) {
        // Input validation
        if (imu_segment.empty()) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Empty IMU segment");
        }
        if (dt_total <= 0.0) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid dt_total: " + std::to_string(dt_total));
        }
        
        // Get current estimate for Ri (needed for g compensation)
        Eigen::Matrix3d Ri_d = getPoseRotationInternal(pose_i_id).cast<double>();
        
        // Call GTSAM preprocessor
        auto imu_output = imu_preprocessor_.getRelativePose(imu_segment, Ri_d, dt_total);
        
        // Convert to ImuConstraint
        ImuConstraint imu;
        imu.pose_i_id = pose_i_id;
        imu.pose_j_id = pose_j_id;
        imu.deltaR = imu_output.deltaR;
        imu.deltaT = imu_output.deltaT;
        imu.sigma = imu_output.sigma;
        
        return imu;
    }
// backsubstitute implementation
std::map<int, Eigen::VectorXf> VariableEliminationDriver::backsubstitute(const Eigen::VectorXf& x_final) {
        std::map<int, Eigen::VectorXf> solution;
        
        // Solve in reverse order
        for (auto it = backsub_stack_.rbegin(); it != backsub_stack_.rend(); ++it) {
            int dim = it->is_landmark ? 3 : 6;
            Eigen::VectorXf delta_var(dim);
            
            // R11 * delta_var = z1 - R12 * (already_solved_vars)
            // Simplified: assume R12 part handled by trail updates
            Eigen::FullPivLU<Eigen::MatrixXf> lu(it->R11);
            if (!lu.isInvertible()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("R11 matrix is singular for variable " + std::to_string(it->var_id));
            }
            delta_var = lu.solve(it->z1);
            solution[it->var_id] = delta_var;
        }
        
        return solution;
    }

// Helper: SO(3) exponential map (Rodriguez formula)
Eigen::Matrix3f so3Exp(const Eigen::Vector3f& omega) {
    float theta = omega.norm();
    if (theta < 1e-6) {
        return Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity();
    }
    
    Eigen::Vector3f axis = omega / theta;
    Eigen::Matrix3f K;
    K << 0, -axis(2), axis(1),
         axis(2), 0, -axis(0),
         -axis(1), axis(0), 0;
    
    return Eigen::Matrix3f::Identity() + 
           std::sin(theta) * K + 
           (1 - std::cos(theta)) * K * K;
}

void runVariableElimination(
    const std::vector<CameraObservation>& camera_obs,
    const std::vector<ImuConstraint>& imu_factors,
    const std::vector<PriorConstraint>& priors
) {
    VariableEliminationDriver driver;
    
    // Phase 1: Eliminate all landmarks
    std::set<int> unique_landmarks;
    for (auto& obs : camera_obs)
        unique_landmarks.insert(obs.landmark_id);
    
    for (int lm_id : unique_landmarks) {
        std::vector<CameraObservation> lm_obs;
        for (auto& obs : camera_obs)
```

```cpp
// Simple progress bar helper
inline void PrintProgress(const char* label, std::size_t current, std::size_t total) {
    if (total == 0) return;
    static std::size_t last_percent = 999;
    std::size_t percent = (current * 100) / total;
    if (percent != last_percent) {
        last_percent = percent;
        std::cout << "\r[" << label << "] " << percent << "% (" << current << "/" << total << ")   " << std::flush;
        if (current == total) {
            std::cout << "\n";
            last_percent = 999;  // Reset for next use
        }
    }
}

    bool run_elimination = true;
    std::size_t window_size = 10;
    OrderingMode ordering_mode = OrderingMode::kSequential;
    CostWeights cost_weights;
    std::string dump_path;
};

std::string JoinPath(const std::string& dir, const std::string& filename) {
    if (dir.empty()) {
        return filename;
    }
    if (dir.back() == '/' || dir.back() == '\\') {
        return dir + filename;
    }
    return dir + "/" + filename;
}

void PrintUsage(const char* prog_name) {
    std::cerr << "Usage: " << prog_name
              << " <json_directory> [--huber=2.5] [--window=10] [--ordering=sequential|cost]\n"
              << "       [--cost-weights=ws,wr,wb] [--dump-stimulus=path] [--no-elim]\n"
              << "  <json_directory> should contain poses.json / camera_observations.json / "
              << "imu_edges.json / priors.json\n"
              << "  --huber=VAL    Set the camera Huber delta (default 2.5)\n"
              << "  --window=N     Keep last N poses (default 10) instead of eliminating them\n"
              << "  --ordering=MODE   Choose elimination order (sequential or cost, default sequential)\n"
              << "  --cost-weights=a,b,c   Weights for structure/resource/benefit costs (default 1,1,1)\n"
              << "  --no-elim      Load factors only, skip elimination\n";
}

PipelineOptions ParseArguments(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Missing json_directory argument");
    }

    PipelineOptions opts;
    opts.json_dir = argv[1];
    opts.poses_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "poses.json");
    opts.observations_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "camera_observations.json");
    opts.imu_edges_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "imu_edges.json");
    opts.priors_path = JoinPath(opts.json_dir, "priors.json");

    for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i) {
        std::string arg = argv[i];
        if (arg.rfind("--huber=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.huber_delta = std::stof(arg.substr(8));
        } else if (arg.rfind("--window=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.window_size = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::stoul(arg.substr(9)));
        } else if (arg.rfind("--ordering=", 0) == 0) {
            const std::string value = arg.substr(11);
            if (value == "sequential") {
                opts.ordering_mode = OrderingMode::kSequential;
            } else if (value == "cost") {
                opts.ordering_mode = OrderingMode::kCost;
            } else {
                throw std::runtime_error("Unknown ordering mode: " + value);
            }
        } else if (arg.rfind("--cost-weights=", 0) == 0) {
            const std::string weights_str = arg.substr(15);
            std::stringstream ss(weights_str);
            std::string token;
            std::vector<double> weights;
            while (std::getline(ss, token, ',')) {
                if (token.empty()) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Invalid --cost-weights format");
                }
                weights.push_back(std::stod(token));
            }
            if (weights.size() != 3) {
                throw std::runtime_error("--cost-weights requires three comma-separated numbers");
            }
            if (weights[0] < 0.0 || weights[1] < 0.0 || weights[2] < 0.0) {
                throw std::runtime_error("--cost-weights must be non-negative");
            }
            opts.cost_weights.structure = weights[0];
            opts.cost_weights.resource = weights[1];
            opts.cost_weights.benefit = weights[2];
        } else if (arg.rfind("--dump-stimulus=", 0) == 0) {
            opts.dump_path = arg.substr(16);
        } else if (arg == "--no-elim") {
            opts.run_elimination = false;
        } else {
            throw std::runtime_error("Unknown argument: " + arg);
        }
    }

    if (opts.huber_delta <= 0.0f) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Huber delta must be positive");
    }
    if (opts.window_size == 0) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Window size must be positive");
    }

    return opts;
}

template <typename Duration>
double ToMilliseconds(Duration d) {
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>>(d).count();
}

double NormalizeValue(double value, double min_v, double max_v) {
    const double range = max_v - min_v;
    if (range < 1e-9) {
        return 0.0;
    }
    return (value - min_v) / range;
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    try {
        const auto opts = ParseArguments(argc, argv);

        const auto t0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        auto poses = JsonLoader::LoadPoses(opts.poses_path);
        auto observations = JsonLoader::LoadObservations(opts.observations_path);
        auto imu_edges = JsonLoader::LoadImuEdges(opts.imu_edges_path);
        auto priors = JsonLoader::LoadPriors(opts.priors_path);
        const auto t1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] JSON loading completed\n"
                  << "  poses: " << poses.size() << "\n"
                  << "  observations: " << observations.size() << "\n"
                  << "  imu_edges: " << imu_edges.size() << "\n"
                  << "  priors: " << priors.size() << "\n"
                  << "  elapsed: " << ToMilliseconds(t1 - t0) << " ms\n";

        VariableEliminationDriver driver;
        if (!opts.dump_path.empty()) {
            driver.enableStimulusDump(opts.dump_path);
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Stimulus dump enabled: "
                      << opts.dump_path << "\n";
        }
        ORBSLAM3Exporter exporter(driver);

        std::unordered_set<int> initialized_landmarks;
        initialized_landmarks.reserve(observations.size());

        for (const auto& pose : poses) {
            driver.setPose(pose.pose_id, pose.Rcw, pose.tcw);
        }

        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            if (initialized_landmarks.insert(obs.landmark_id).second) {
                driver.setLandmark(obs.landmark_id, obs.landmark_w);
            }
        }

        exporter.addObservations(observations);
        exporter.addImuEdges(imu_edges);
        for (const auto& prior : priors) {
            exporter.addPrior(prior);
        }

        if (!opts.run_elimination) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Factors loaded (--no-elim).\n"
                      << "  pending landmarks: " << exporter.pendingLandmarkIds().size() << "\n"
                      << "  pending poses: " << exporter.pendingPoseIds().size() << "\n";
            return 0;
        }

        // Sort poses by timestamp to obtain temporal order
        std::sort(poses.begin(), poses.end(),
                  [](const JsonLoader::PoseRecord& a, const JsonLoader::PoseRecord& b) {
                      if (a.timestamp == b.timestamp) {
                          return a.pose_id < b.pose_id;
                      }
                      return a.timestamp < b.timestamp;
                  });
        std::vector<int> pose_sequence;
        pose_sequence.reserve(poses.size());
        std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> pose_rank;
        pose_rank.reserve(poses.size());
        for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < poses.size(); ++idx) {
            pose_sequence.push_back(poses[idx].pose_id);
            pose_rank[poses[idx].pose_id] = idx;
        }

        // Pre-compute the latest pose rank that observes each landmark
        std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> landmark_max_rank;
        landmark_max_rank.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());
        for (const auto& obs : observations) {
            const auto rank_it = pose_rank.find(obs.pose_id);
            if (rank_it == pose_rank.end()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Observation references unknown pose_id: " +
                                         std::to_string(obs.pose_id));
            }
            const std::size_t rank = rank_it->second;
            auto [it, inserted] = landmark_max_rank.emplace(obs.landmark_id, rank);
            if (!inserted && rank > it->second) {
                it->second = rank;
            }
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<int>> landmarks_by_rank(pose_sequence.size());
        for (const auto& kv : landmark_max_rank) {
            const int landmark_id = kv.first;
            const std::size_t rank = kv.second;
            landmarks_by_rank.at(rank).push_back(landmark_id);
        }

        const std::size_t pose_window =
            std::min<std::size_t>(opts.window_size, pose_sequence.size());
        if (pose_window == pose_sequence.size()) {
            std::cout << "[Pipeline-BlitzCrankStyle] Window size >= pose count; "
                      << "no pose will be eliminated. Use --window=<smaller value> if needed.\n";
        }

        const std::size_t cutoff =
            (pose_sequence.size() > pose_window) ? (pose_sequence.size() - pose_window) : 0;

        std::size_t eliminated_landmarks = 0;
        std::size_t eliminated_poses = 0;

        const auto t2 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        if (opts.ordering_mode == OrderingMode::kSequential) {
            std::unordered_set<int> eliminated_landmarks_set;
            eliminated_landmarks_set.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());

            for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < cutoff; ++idx) {
                if (idx < landmarks_by_rank.size()) {
                    for (int lm_id : landmarks_by_rank[idx]) {
                        if (eliminated_landmarks_set.insert(lm_id).second) {
                            if (exporter.eliminateLandmark(lm_id, opts.huber_delta)) {
                                ++eliminated_landmarks;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                int pose_id = pose_sequence[idx];
                if (exporter.eliminatePose(pose_id)) {
                    ++eliminated_poses;
                }
            }
        } else {
            struct LandmarkAccum {
                std::size_t obs_count = 0;
                std::size_t latest_rank = 0;
                std::unordered_set<int> pose_ids;
            };

            std::unordered_map<int, LandmarkAccum> landmark_stats;
            landmark_stats.reserve(initialized_landmarks.size());
            for (const auto& obs : observations) {
                auto& acc = landmark_stats[obs.landmark_id];
                acc.obs_count++;
                acc.pose_ids.insert(obs.pose_id);
                const std::size_t rank = pose_rank.at(obs.pose_id);
                if (acc.obs_count == 1 || rank > acc.latest_rank) {
                    acc.latest_rank = rank;
                }
            }

            struct LandmarkTempData {
                int landmark_id;
                std::size_t latest_rank;
                double structure_raw;
                double resource_raw;
                double benefit_raw;
                int anchor_pose_id;
            };

            std::vector<LandmarkTempData> ready_landmarks;
            ready_landmarks.reserve(landmark_stats.size());

            auto init_min = []() { return std::numeric_limits<double>::max(); };
            auto init_max = []() { return std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest(); };
            auto update_range = [](double value, double& min_v, double& max_v) {
                if (value < min_v) {
                    min_v = value;
                }
                if (value > max_v) {
                    max_v = value;
                }
            };

            double lm_struct_min = init_min();
            double lm_struct_max = init_max();
            double lm_resource_min = init_min();
            double lm_resource_max = init_max();
            double lm_benefit_min = init_min();
            double lm_benefit_max = init_max();

            std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> pose_pending_landmarks;

            for (const auto& kv : landmark_stats) {
                const auto& acc = kv.second;
                if (acc.latest_rank >= cutoff) {
                    continue;
                }
                LandmarkTempData temp;
                temp.landmark_id = kv.first;
                temp.latest_rank = acc.latest_rank;
                const double unique_pose_count = static_cast<double>(acc.pose_ids.size());
                temp.structure_raw = unique_pose_count;
                temp.resource_raw = 3.0 + 6.0 * unique_pose_count;
                if (cutoff > 0) {
                    temp.benefit_raw =
                        std::max(0.0, static_cast<double>(cutoff - 1) - static_cast<double>(temp.latest_rank));
                } else {
                    temp.benefit_raw = 0.0;
                }
                temp.anchor_pose_id = pose_sequence.at(temp.latest_rank);
                ready_landmarks.push_back(temp);

                update_range(temp.structure_raw, lm_struct_min, lm_struct_max);
                update_range(temp.resource_raw, lm_resource_min, lm_resource_max);
                update_range(temp.benefit_raw, lm_benefit_min, lm_benefit_max);
                pose_pending_landmarks[temp.anchor_pose_id]++;
            }

            if (ready_landmarks.empty()) {
                lm_struct_min = lm_struct_max = 0.0;
                lm_resource_min = lm_resource_max = 0.0;
                lm_benefit_min = lm_benefit_max = 0.0;
            } else {
                if (lm_struct_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    lm_struct_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (lm_struct_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    lm_struct_max = lm_struct_min;
                }
                if (lm_resource_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    lm_resource_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (lm_resource_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    lm_resource_max = lm_resource_min;
                }
                if (lm_benefit_min == std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
                    lm_benefit_min = 0.0;
                }
                if (lm_benefit_max == std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()) {
                    lm_benefit_max = lm_benefit_min;
                }
            }

            struct LandmarkCostInfo {
                double score = 0.0;
                std::size_t latest_rank = 0;
                int anchor_pose_id = -1;
                bool eliminated = false;
            };
            std::unordered_map<int, LandmarkCostInfo> landmark_costs;
            landmark_costs.reserve(ready_landmarks.size());

            struct LandmarkHeapEntry {
                double score;
                int landmark_id;
            };
            auto landmark_cmp = [](const LandmarkHeapEntry& a, const LandmarkHeapEntry& b) {
                if (a.score == b.score) {
                    return a.landmark_id > b.landmark_id;
                }
                return a.score > b.score;
            };
            std::priority_queue<LandmarkHeapEntry, std::vector<LandmarkHeapEntry>, decltype(landmark_cmp)>
                landmark_heap(landmark_cmp);

            for (const auto& temp : ready_landmarks) {
                const double structure_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.structure_raw, lm_struct_min, lm_struct_max);
                const double resource_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.resource_raw, lm_resource_min, lm_resource_max);
                const double benefit_norm = NormalizeValue(temp.benefit_raw, lm_benefit_min, lm_benefit_max);
                const double score = opts.cost_weights.structure * structure_norm +
                                     opts.cost_weights.resource * resource_norm -
                                     opts.cost_weights.benefit * benefit_norm;
                LandmarkCostInfo info;
                info.score = score;
                info.latest_rank = temp.latest_rank;
                info.anchor_pose_id = temp.anchor_pose_id;
                landmark_costs.emplace(temp.landmark_id, info);
                landmark_heap.push({score, temp.landmark_id});
            }

            struct PoseTempData {
                int pose_id = -1;
                std::size_t rank = 0;
                std::size_t imu_degree = 0;
                std::unordered_set<int> imu_neighbors;
                std::size_t pending_landmarks = 0;
            };
            std::unordered_map<int, PoseTempData> pose_stats;
            pose_stats.reserve(pose_sequence.size());
            for (const auto& pose : poses) {
                PoseTempData data;
                data.pose_id = pose.pose_id;
                data.rank = pose_rank.at(pose.pose_id);
                pose_stats[pose.pose_id] = data;
            }

            for (const auto& kv : pose_pending_landmarks) {
                pose_stats[kv.first].pending_landmarks = kv.second;
            }

            for (const auto& edge : imu_edges) {
                auto& pose_i = pose_stats[edge.pose_i_id];
                auto& pose_j = pose_stats[edge.pose_j_id];
                pose_i.imu_degree++;
                pose_j.imu_degree++;
                pose_i.imu_neighbors.insert(edge.pose_j_id);
                pose_j.imu_neighbors.insert(edge.pose_i_id);
            }

            struct PoseCostInfo {
                double score = 0.0;
                std::size_t rank = 0;
                std::size_t pending_landmarks = 0;
```
